130.t: asa(n)bh roop anabhai prabhaa at balisaT jal thal karan ||
130.e: He is an Unborn Entity, His Glory is manifested through knowledge, He is most powerful and cause of the creation of water and land.

130.g: ਅਚੁਤ ਅਨੰਤ ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਮਿਤ ਨਾਥ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਤਵ ਸਰਣ ॥੧॥੩੨॥
130.t: achut ana(n)t adhavai amit naath nira(n)jan tav saran ||1||32||
130.e: He is imperishable, boundless, Non-dual, Unlimited and the Transcendent Lord, I am in Thy Refuge. 1 .32

130.g: ਅਚੁਤ ਅਭੈ ਅਭੇਦ ਅਮਿਤ ਆਖੰਡ ਅਤੁਲ ਬਲ ॥
130.t: achut abhai abhedh amit aakha(n)dd atul bal ||
130.e: He is imperishable, boundless, Non-dual, Unlimited, Indivisible, and hath Unweighable Strenght.

130.g: ਅਟਲ ਅਨੰਤ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਖੈ ਅਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਦਲ ॥
130.t: aTal ana(n)t anaadh akhai akha(n)dd prabal dhal ||
130.e: He is Eternal, Infinite, Beginningless, Indivisible, and Master of Mighty forces.

130.g: ਅਮਿਤ ਅਮਿਤ ਅਨਤੋਲ ਅਭੂ ਅਨਭੇਦ ਅਭੰਜਨ ॥
130.t: amit amit anatol abhoo anabhedh abha(n)jan ||
130.e: He is Limits Boundless, Unweighable, elementless, indiscriminated and Invincible.

130.g: ਅਨਬਿਕਾਰ ਆਤਮ ਸਰੂਪ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਨ ਰੰਜਨ ॥
130.t: anabikaar aatam saroop sur nar mun ra(n)jan ||
130.e: He is Spiritual Entity without vices, pleasing to gods, men and sages.

130.g: ਅਬਿਕਾਰ ਰੂਪ ਅਨਭੈ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਨ ਜਨ ਗਨ ਬੰਦਤ ਚਰਨ ॥
130.t: abikaar roop anabhai sadhaa mun jan gan ba(n)dhat charan ||
130.e: He is and Entity without vices, always Fearless, the assemblies of sages and men bow at His Feet.

130.g: ਭਵ ਭਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਦੋਖ ਹਰਨ ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ॥੨॥੩੩॥
130.t: bhav bharan karan dhukh dhokh haran at prataap bhram bhai haran ||2||33||
130.e: He pervades the world, removes the sufferings and blemishes, Supremely Glorious and effacer of illusions and fears.2.33.

130.g: ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥ ਤ੍ਵਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
130.t: chhapai chha(n)dh || tavaiprasaadh ||
130.e: CHHAPAI STANZA : BY THY GRACE

130.g: ਮੁਖ ਮੰਡਲ ਪਰ ਲਸਤ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਦੋਤ ਅਮਿਤ ਗਤਿ ॥
130.t: mukh ma(n)ddal par lasat jot udhot amit gat ||
130.e: On his facial sphere glistens the brilliant light of infinite movement.

130.g: ਜਟਤ ਜੋਤ ਜਗਮਗਤ ਲਜਤ ਲਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਿਖਤਿ ਪਤਿ ॥
130.t: jaTat jot jagamagat lajat lakh koT nikhat pat ||
130.e: Such is the setting and illumination of that Light that lakhs and millions of moon feel shy before it.

130.g: ਚਕ੍ਰਵਰਤੀ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਚਕ੍ਰਤ ਚਉਚਕ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
130.t: chakravaratee chakravai chakrat chauchakr kar dhar ||
130.e: He carries the four corners of the world on His hand and thus the universal monarchs are amazed.

130.g: ਪਦਮ ਨਾਥ ਪਦਮਾਛ ਨਵਲ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਨਰਿਹਰਿ ॥
130.t: padham naath padhamaachh naval naarain narihar ||
130.e: The Ever-new Lord with lotus-eyes, He is the Lord of men.

130.g: ਕਾਲਖ ਬਿਹੰਡਣ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਹਰਣ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਮੁਨ ਬੰਦਤ ਚਰਣ ॥
130.t: kaalakh biha(n)ddan kilavikh haran sur nar mun ba(n)dhat charan ||
130.e: Remover of darkness and destroyer of sins, all the gods, men and sages bow at His Feet.

130.g: ਖੰਡਣ ਅਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਣ ਅਭੈ ਨਮੋ ਨਾਥ ਭਉ ਭੈ ਹਰਣ ॥੩॥੩੪॥
130.t: kha(n)ddan akha(n)dd ma(n)ddan abhai namo naath bhau bhai haran ||3||34||
130.e: He is breaker of the unbreakable He is the establisher on the Fearless position Salutation to Thee, O Lord, the remover of fear.3.34.

130.g: ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥
130.t: chhapai chha(n)dh ||
130.e: CHHAPAI STANZA

130.g: ਨਮੋ ਨਾਥ ਨ੍ਰਿਦਾਇਕ ਨਮੋ ਨਿਮ ਰੂਪ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ॥
130.t: namo naath niradhaik namo nim roop nira(n)jan ||
130.e: Salutation to Him the Merciful Donor Lord! Salutation to Him, the Transcendent and Modest Lord!

130.g: ਅਗੰਜਾਣ ਅਗੰਜਣ ਅਭੰਜ ਅਨਭੇਦ ਅਭੰਜਨ ॥
130.t: aga(n)jaan aga(n)jan abha(n)j anabhedh abha(n)jan ||
130.e: The Destroyer of Indestructible, Invincible, Indiscriminate and Imperishable Lord.

130.g: ਅਛੈ ਅਖੈ ਅਬਿਕਾਰ ਅਭੈ ਅਨਭਿਜ ਅਭੇਦਨ ॥
130.t: achhai akhai abikaar abhai anabhij abhedhan ||
130.e: Inassailable, Incorruptible, Devoid of vices, Fearless, unattached and Undistinguishable Lord.

130.g: ਅਖੈਦਾਨ ਖੇਦਨ ਅਖਿਜ ਅਨਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਅਛੇਦਨ ॥
130.t: akhaidhaan khedhan akhij anachhidhr achhedhan ||
130.e: Affliction of the Unafflicted, Blissful without blemish and the Unassailable.

131.g: ਆਜਾਨ ਬਾਹੁ ਸਾਰੰਗਧਰ ਖੜਗਪਾਣ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਦਲਣ ॥
131.t: aajaan baahu saara(n)gadhar khaRagapaan dhurajan dhalan ||
131.e: The Lord with long arms upto knees, wearer of the bow and the sword for vanquishing the enemies.

131.g: ਨਰ ਵਰ ਨਰੇਸ ਨਾਇਕ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਣਿ ਨਮੋ ਨਵਲ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਰਵਣਿ ॥੪॥੩੫॥
131.t: nar var nares naik nirapan namo naval jal thal ravan ||4||35||
131.e: The Sovereign of good people, hero and Master of armies Salutation to Him who Pervades water and lands.4.35.

131.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਯਾਲ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਣ ਦੁਰਮਤ ਹੰਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਖੰਡਣ ॥
131.t: dheen dhayaal dhukh haran dhuramat ha(n)taa dhukh kha(n)ddan ||
131.e: He is the Merciful Lord of the lowly, destroyer of suffering, and vicious intellect and the refuter of suffering.

131.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਨ ਮਨ ਹਰਨ ਮਦਨ ਮੂਰਤ ਮਹਿ ਮੰਡਨ ॥
131.t: mahaa mon man haran madhan moorat meh ma(n)ddan ||
131.e: He is greatly peaceful, captivator of the heart, alluring like Cupid and Creator of the world.

131.g: ਅਮਿਤ ਤੇਜ ਅਬਿਕਾਰ ਅਖੈ ਆਭੰਜ ਅਮਿਤ ਬਲ ॥
131.t: amit tej abikaar akhai aabha(n)j amit bal ||
131.e: He is the Lord of Limitless Glory, without vices, indestructible, Invincible having Boundless Power.

131.g: ਨਿਰਭੰਜ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਨਿਰਜੁਰ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਜਲ ਥਲ ॥
131.t: nirabha(n)j nirabhau niravair nirajur nirap jal thal ||
131.e: He is Unbreakable, without fear and enmity, without malice and the monarch of waters and lands.

131.g: ਅਛੈ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਛੂ ਅਛਿਤ ਅਛੈ ਅਛਾਨ ਅਛਰ ॥
131.t: achhai saroop achhoo achhit achhai achhaan achhar ||
131.e: He is unassailable Entity, Untouchable, Eternal, Imperishable, Unhidden and without deception.

131.g: ਅਦ੍ਵੈ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਦ੍ਵਿਯ ਅਮਰ ਅਭਿਬੰਦਤ ਸੁਰ ਨਰ ਅਸੁਰ ॥੫॥੩੬॥
131.t: adhavai saroop adhaviaiy amar abhiba(n)dhat sur nar asur ||5||36||
131.e: He is Non-dual Entity, Unique, Immortal and is deeply abored by gods, men and demons.5.36.

131.g: ਕੁਲ ਕਲੰਕ ਕਰਿ ਹੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਕਰ ॥
131.t: kul kala(n)k kar heen kirapaa saagar karunaa kar ||
131.e: He is the ocean and source of Mercy and remover of blemishes from all.

131.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੀ ਸੂਰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਰ ॥
131.t: karan kaaran samarath kirapaa kee soorat kirat dhar ||
131.e: He is the cause of causes, Powerful, Merciful Entity and prop of creation.

131.g: ਕਾਲ ਕਰਮ ਕਰ ਹੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ॥
131.t: kaal karam kar heen kriaa jeh koi na bujhai ||
131.e: He is the destroyer of the actions of death and none knows His doning.

131.g: ਕਹਾ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਿ ਕਰੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਾਲਨ ਕੈ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
131.t: kahaa kahai keh karai kahaa kaalan kai sujhai ||
131.e: What doth he say and do? What facts doth reveal Him?

131.g: ਕੰਜਲਕ ਨੈਨ ਕੰਬੂ ਗ੍ਰੀਵਹਿ ਕਟਿ ਕੇਹਰ ਕੁੰਜਰ ਗਵਨ ॥
131.t: ka(n)jalak nain ka(n)boo greeveh kaT kehar ku(n)jar gavan ||
131.e: His eyes are like lotus, neck like conchshell, waist like lion and gait like elephant.

131.g: ਕਦਲੀ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਕਰਪੂਰ ਗਤ ਬਿਨ ਅਕਾਲ ਦੁਜੋ ਕਵਨ ॥੬॥੩੭॥
131.t: kadhalee kura(n)k karapoor gat bin akaal dhujo kavan ||6||37||
131.e: Legs like banana, swiftness like deer and fragrance like camphor, O non-temporal Lord! Who else can be without thee with such attributes?6.37.

131.g: ਅਲਖ ਰੂਪ ਅਲੇਖ ਅਬੈ ਅਨਭੂਤ ਅਭੰਜਨ ॥
131.t: alakh roop alekh abai anabhoot abha(n)jan ||
131.e: He is an Incomprehensible Entity, accountless, valueless, elementless and Unbreakable.

131.g: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਬਿਕਾਰ ਅਜੈ ਅਨਗਾਧ ਅਗੰਜਨ ॥
131.t: aadh purakh abikaar ajai anagaadh aga(n)jan ||
131.e: He is the Primal Purusha, without vices, Unconquerable, Unfathomable and Invincible.

131.g: ਨਿਰਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਿਰਜੁਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਨਿਰ ਦ੍ਵੈਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ॥
131.t: nirabikaar nirajur saroop nir dhavaikh nira(n)jan ||
131.e: He is without vices, Unmalicious Entity, Unblemished and transcendent.

131.g: ਅਭੰਜਾਨ ਭੰਜਨ ਅਨਭੇਦ ਅਨਭੂਤ ਅਭੰਜਨ ॥
131.t: abha(n)jaan bha(n)jan anabhedh anabhoot abha(n)jan ||
131.e: He is the Breaker of the Unbreakable, Indiscriminate, Elementless and Infrangible.

131.g: ਸਾਹਾਨ ਸਾਹ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਮਤ ਬਡ ਸਰੂਪ ਬਡਵੈ ਬਖਤ ॥
131.t: saahaan saeh su(n)dhar sumat badd saroop baddavai bakhat ||
131.e: He is the king of kings, Beautiful, of propitious intellect, of handsome countenance and Most Fortunate.

131.g: ਕੋਟਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਭੂਅ ਭਾਨ ਜਿਮ ਤਪਤ ਤੇਜ ਇਸਥਿਤ ਤਖਤ ॥੭॥੩੮॥
131.t: koTak prataap bhooa bhaan jim tapat tej isathit takhat ||7||38||
131.e: He is seated on His throne with the effulgence of millions of earthly suns.7.38.

131.g: ਛਪੈ ਛੰਦ ॥ ਤ੍ਵਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
131.t: chhapai chha(n)dh || tavaiprasaadh ||
131.e: CHHAPAI STANZA : BY THY GRACE

131.g: ਚਕ੍ਰਤ ਚਾਰ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੈ ਚਕ੍ਰਤ ਚਉਕੁੰਟ ਚਵਗਨ ॥
131.t: chakrat chaar chakravai chakrat chauku(n)T chavagan ||
131.e: Visualizing the Beauty of the Universal monarch all the four directions seem stunned.

131.g: ਕੋਟ ਸੂਰ ਸਮ ਤੇਜ ਤੇਜ ਨਹੀ ਦੂਨ ਚਵਗਨ ॥
131.t: koT soor sam tej tej nahee dhoon chavagan ||
131.e: He hath the light of millions of suns, nay, even the light is two four times.

131.g: ਕੋਟ ਚੰਦ ਚਕ ਪਰੈ ਤੁਲ ਨਹੀ ਤੇਜ ਬਿਚਾਰਤ ॥
131.t: koT cha(n)dh chak parai tul nahee tej bichaarat ||
131.e: A million moons are astonished to fine their light very dim as compared to His Light.

131.g: ਬਿਆਸ ਪਰਾਸਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭੇਦ ਨਹਿ ਬੇਦ ਉਚਾਰਤ ॥
131.t: biaas paraasar braham bhedh neh bedh uchaarat ||
131.e: Vyas, Parshar, Brahma and Vedas cannot describe His mystery.

131.g: ਸਾਹਾਨ ਸਾਹ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੁਘਰਿ ਅਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਬਲ ॥
131.t: saahaan saeh saahib sughar at prataap su(n)dhar sabal ||
131.e: He is the king of kings, the Lord of Wisdom, Supremely Glorious, Beautiful and Powerful.

131.g: ਰਾਜਾਨ ਰਾਜ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਬਲ ਅਮਿਤ ਤੇਜ ਅਛੈ ਅਛਲ ॥੮॥੩੯॥
131.t: raajaan raaj saahib sabal amit tej achhai achhal ||8||39||
131.e: He is the monarch of monarchs, the Lord of the Mighty having Unlimited Splendour, Unassailable and without deceprion.8.39.

131.g: ਕਬਿਤੁ ॥ ਤ੍ਵਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
131.t: kabit || tavaiprasaadh ||
131.e: KABIT : BY THY GRACE

131.g: ਗਹਿਓ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਅਗਾਹ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਗਾਈਅਤੁ ਛੇਦਿਓ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਅਛੇਦ ਕੈ ਪਛਾਨੀਐ ॥
131.t: gahio jo na jai so agaeh kai kai gaieeat chhedhio jo na jai so achhedh kai pachhaaneeaai ||
131.e: He, who cannot be grasped, He is called Inaccessible and He, who cannot be assailed is recognized as unassailable.

131.g: ਗੰਜਿਓ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਅਗੰਜ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਅਤੁ ਭੰਜਿਓ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਅਭੰਜ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
131.t: ga(n)jio jo na jai so aga(n)j kai kai jaaneeat bha(n)jio jo na jai so abha(n)j kai kai maaneeaai ||
131.e: He who cannot be destroyed is known as indestructible and He, who cannot be divided in considered as indivisible.

131.g: ਸਾਧਿਓ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਅਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਸਾਧ ਕਰ ਛਲਿਓ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਅਛਲ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
131.t: saadhio jo na jai so asaadh kai kai saadh kar chhalio jo na jai so achhal kai pramaaneeaai ||
131.e: He, who cannot be disciplined, may be called incorrigible and He, who cannot be deceived is considered as Undeceivable.

131.g: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਅਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਨ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਅਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੧॥੪੦॥
131.t: ma(n)tr mai na aavai so ama(n)tr kai kai maan man ja(n)tr mai na aavai so aja(n)tr kai kai jaaneeaai ||1||40||
131.e: He, who is without the impact of mantras (incantations) may be considered as Unspellable and He, who is without the impact of Yantras (mystical diagrams) may be known as Unmagical.1.40.

131.g: ਜਾਤ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਅਜਾਤ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਨ ਜੀਅ ਪਾਤ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਅਪਾਤ ਕੈ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥
131.t: jaat mai na aavai so ajaat kai kai jaan jeea paat mai na aavai so apaat kai bulaieeaai ||
131.e: Consider Him as casteless in Thy mind, Who is devoid of caste, call Him lineageless who is devoid of lineage.

131.g: ਭੇਦ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਅਭੇਦ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਭਾਖੀਅਤੁ ਛੇਦ੍ਯੋ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਅਛੇਦ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਾਈਐ ॥
131.t: bhedh mai na aavai so abhedh kai kai bhaakheeat chhedhayo jo na jai so achhedh kai sunaieeaai ||
131.e: He may be called as Indiscriminate, who is devoid of discriminations He, who cannot be assailed, may be spoken as Unassailable.

131.g: ਖੰਡਿਓ ਜੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਅਖੰਡ ਜੂ ਕੋ ਖਿਆਲੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਖਿਆਲ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਗਮੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
131.t: kha(n)ddio jo na jai so akha(n)dd joo ko khiaal keejai khiaal mai na aavai gam taa ko sadhaa khaieeaai ||
131.e: He, who cannot be divided, may be considered as indivisible He, who cannot be grasped in thought, always makes us sorrowful.

131.g: ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਪੀਅਤੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਮੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੨॥੪੧॥
131.t: ja(n)tr mai na aavai aja(n)tr kai kai jaapeeat dhiaan mai na aavai taa ko dhiaan keejai dhiaaieeaai ||2||41||
131.e: He, who is without the impact of mystical diagrams, may be muttered as Unmagical He who doth not come in contemplation, may be contemplated upon and meditated.2.41.

131.g: ਛਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ਛਤ੍ਰੀਪਤਿ ਛੈਲ ਰੂਪ ਛਿਤਨਾਥ ਛੌਣੀ ਕਰ ਛਾਇਆ ਬਰ ਛਤ੍ਰੀਪਤ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
131.t: chhatradhaaree chhatreepat chhail roop chhitanaath chhauanee kar chhaiaa bar chhatreepat gaieeaai ||
131.e: He is sung as the canopied monarch, the Lord of canopies, a winsome entity, the Master and Creator of the earth and the superb support.

131.g: ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਨਾਥ ਬਿਸ੍ਵੰਭਰ ਬੇਦਨਾਥ ਬਾਲਾਕਰ ਬਾਜੀਗਰਿ ਬਾਨਧਾਰੀ ਬੰਧ ਨ ਬਤਾਈਐ ॥
131.t: bisavai naath bisavai(n)bhar bedhanaath baalaakar baajeegar baanadhaaree ba(n)dh na bataieeaai ||
131.e: He is the Lord Sustainer of the Universe, Master of Vedas depicted as Lord having discipline.

131.g: ਨਿਉਲੀ ਕਰਮ ਦੂਧਾਧਾਰੀ ਬਿਦਿਆਧਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੋ ਲਗਾਵੈ ਨੈਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੂੰ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
131.t: niaulee karam dhoodhaadhaaree bidhiaadhar brahamachaaree dhiaan ko lagaavai naik dhiaan hoo(n) na paieeaai ||
131.e: The Yogis performing Neoli Karma (cleansing of intestines), those subsisting only on milk, learned and celibates, all meditate upon Him, but without an iota of getting His comprehension.

131.g: ਰਾਜਨ ਕੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਮਹਾਰਾਜਨ ਕੇ ਮਹਾਰਾਜਾ ਐਸੋ ਰਾਜ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਉਰ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਉਨ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੩॥੪੨॥
131.t: raajan ke raajaa mahaaraajan ke mahaaraajaa aaiso raaj chhodd aaur dhoojaa kaun dhiaaieeaai ||3||42||
131.e: He is the king of kings and emperor of emperors, Who else should be meditated upon, forsaking such a Supreme monarch?.3.42.

131.g: ਜੁਧ ਕੇ ਜਿਤਈਆ ਰੰਗ ਭੂਮ ਕੇ ਭਵਈਆ ਭਾਰ ਭੂਮ ਕੇ ਮਿਟਈਆ ਨਾਥ ਤੀਨ ਲੋਕ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
131.t: judh ke jitieeaa ra(n)g bhoom ke bhavieeaa bhaar bhoom ke miTieeaa naath teen lok gaieeaai ||
131.e: His Name is sung in all the three worlds, who is the conqueror of wars, the mover on the stage and the effacer of the burden of earth.

131.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਤਨਈਆ ਹੈ ਨ ਮਈਆ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਈਆ ਕੋਊ ਛਉਨੀ ਹੂ ਕੇ ਛਈਆ ਛੋਡ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
131.t: kaahoo ke tanieeaa hai na mieeaa jaa ke bhieeaa kouoo chhaunee hoo ke chhieeaa chhodd kaa siau preet laieeaai ||
131.e: He hath neither a son, nor mother non brother He is the Support of the earth, forsaking such Lord whom should we love?

131.g: ਸਾਧਨਾ ਸਧਈਆ ਧੂਲ ਧਾਨੀ ਕੇ ਧੁਜਈਆ ਧੋਮ ਧਾਰ ਕੇ ਧਰਈਆ ਧਿਆਨ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
131.t: saadhanaa sadhieeaa dhool dhaanee ke dhujieeaa dhom dhaar ke dharieeaa dhiaan taa ko sadhaa laieeaai ||
131.e: We should always meditate upon Him who is instrumental in all accomplishments, establisher of the earth and Support of the sky.

131.g: ਆਉ ਕੇ ਬਢਈਆ ਏਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਜਪਈਆ ਅਉਰ ਕਾਮ ਕੇ ਕਰਈਆ ਛੋਡ ਅਉਰ ਕਉਨ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੪॥੪੩॥
131.t: aau ke baddieeaa ek naam ke japieeaa aaur kaam ke karieeaa chhodd aaur kaun dhiaaieeaai ||4||43||
131.e: When should we meditate upon forsaking the Lord who prolongs the age of our life, who causes the Name to be repeated and all other works to be done?4.43.

131.g: ਕਾਮ ਕੋ ਕੁਨਿੰਦਾ ਖੈਰ ਖੂਬੀ ਕੋ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ ਗਜ ਗਾਜੀ ਕੋ ਗਜਿੰਦਾ ਸੋ ਕੁਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੈ ਬਤਾਈਐ ॥
131.t: kaam ko kuni(n)dhaa khair khoobee ko dhiha(n)dhaa gaj gaajee ko gaji(n)dhaa so kuni(n)dhaa kai bataieeaai ||
131.e: He is called the creator, who completes all the errands, who gives the comfort and honour and who is the destroyer of warriors stout like elephants.

131.g: ਚਾਮ ਕੇ ਚਲਿੰਦਾ ਘਾਉ ਘਾਮ ਤੇ ਬਚਿੰਦਾ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਛੈਨੀ ਕੇ ਛਲਿੰਦਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਾਈਐ ॥
131.t: chaam ke chali(n)dhaa ghaau ghaam te bachi(n)dhaa chhatr chhainee ke chhali(n)dhaa so dhiha(n)dhaa kai manaieeaai ||
131.e: He is the wielder of bow, the Protector from all types of afflictions, Deceiver of the universal monarchs and Donor of everything without asking. He should be worshipped with diligence.

131.g: ਜਰ ਕੇ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ ਜਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਕੋ ਜਨਿੰਦਾ ਜੋਤ ਜੇਬ ਕੋ ਗਜਿੰਦਾ ਜਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਜਾਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
131.t: jar ke dhiha(n)dhaa jaan maan ko jani(n)dhaa jot jeb ko gaji(n)dhaa jaan maan jaan gaieeaai ||
131.e: He is the Giver of wealth, Knower of life and honour and sorter of light and reputation His Praises should be sung.

131.g: ਦੋਖ ਕੇ ਦਲਿੰਦਾ ਦੀਨ ਦਾਨਸ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ ਦੋਖ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਦਲਿੰਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਦੂਜੋ ਕਉਨ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੫॥੪੪॥
131.t: dhokh ke dhali(n)dhaa dheen dhaanas dhiha(n)dhaa dhokh dhurajan dhali(n)dhaa dhiaai dhoojo kaun dhiaaieeaai ||5||44||
131.e: He is the effacer of blemishes, the giver of religious discipline and wisdom and the destroyer of vicious people. Whom else should we remember?5.44.

132.g: ਸਾਲਿਸ ਸਹਿੰਦਾ ਸਿਧਤਾਈ ਕੋ ਸਧਿੰਦਾ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਮੈ ਅਵਿੰਦਾ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਥ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
132.t: saalis sahi(n)dhaa sidhataiee ko sadhi(n)dhaa a(n)g a(n)g mai avi(n)dhaa ek eko naath jaaneeaai ||
132.e: He endures everything peacefully, He is engrossed in attainment of perfection, and He is the Only Lord who pervades in all limbs.

132.g: ਕਾਲਖ ਕਟਿੰਦਾ ਖੁਰਾਸਾਨ ਕੋ ਖੁਨਿੰਦਾ ਗ੍ਰਬ ਗਾਫਲ ਗਿਲਿੰਦਾ ਗੋਲ ਗੰਜਖ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥
132.t: kaalakh kaTi(n)dhaa khuraasaan ko khuni(n)dhaa grab gaafal gili(n)dhaa gol ga(n)jakh bakhaaneeaai ||
132.e: He is the remover of darkness, the masher of the Pathans of Khorasan, perisher of the egoists and idlers, He is described as the destroyer of people full of vices.

132.g: ਗਾਲਬ ਗਰੰਦਾ ਜੀਤ ਤੇਜ ਕੇ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਾਪ ਕੇ ਚਲਿੰਦਾ ਛੋਡ ਅਉਰ ਕਉਨ ਆਨੀਐ ॥
132.t: gaalab gara(n)dhaa jeet tej ke dhiha(n)dhaa chitr chaap ke chali(n)dhaa chhodd aaur kaun aaneeaai ||
132.e: Whom should we worship except the Lord who is the Vanquisher of the Conquerors, giver of the Glory of conquest and who shoots the miraculous arrows from His bow.

132.g: ਸਤਤਾ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ ਸਤਤਾਈ ਕੋ ਸੁਖਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਾਮ ਕੋ ਕੁਨਿੰਦਾ ਛੋਡ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਉਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੬॥੪੫॥
132.t: satataa dhiha(n)dhaa satataiee ko sukhi(n)dhaa karam kaam ko kuni(n)dhaa chhodd dhoojaa kaun maaneeaai ||6||45||
132.e: Whom else should we adore except him who is the Giver of Truth and Drier of falsehood and performer of Graceful acts?6.45.

132.g: ਜੋਤ ਕੋ ਜਗਿੰਦਾ ਜੰਗੇ ਜਾਫਰੀ ਦਿਹੰਦਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਰੀ ਕੇ ਮਲਿੰਦਾ ਪੈ ਕੁਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੈ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥
132.t: jot ko jagi(n)dhaa ja(n)ge jaafaree dhiha(n)dhaa mitr maaree ke mali(n)dhaa pai kuni(n)dhaa kai bakhaaneeaai ||
132.e: He is the Enlightener of the light, Giver of the victory in wars and is known as the Destroyer of the murderer of the friends.

132.g: ਪਾਲਕ ਪੁਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰਮ ਪਾਰਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਿੰਦਾ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਗ ਕੇ ਸੁਨਿੰਦਾ ਪੈ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਤੇਜ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
132.t: paalak puni(n)dhaa param paarasee pragi(n)dhaa ra(n)g raag ke suni(n)dhaa pai ana(n)dhaa tej maaneeaai ||
132.e: He is the Sustainer, Giver of shelter, Far-sighted and knower, He is considered as listener of entertaining modes of music and full of blissful splendour.

132.g: ਜਾਪ ਕੇ ਜਪਿੰਦਾ ਖੈਰ ਖੂਬੀ ਕੇ ਦਹਿੰਦਾ ਖੂਨ ਮਾਫ ਕੋ ਕੁਨਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਭਿਜ ਰੂਪ ਠਾਨੀਐ ॥
132.t: jaap ke japi(n)dhaa khair khoobee ke dhahi(n)dhaa khoon maaf ko kuni(n)dhaa hai abhij roop Thaaneeaai ||
132.e: He is cause of the repetition of His Name and Giver of peace and hounour He is the forgiver of the blemishes and is considered as Unattached.

132.g: ਆਰਜਾ ਦਹਿੰਦਾ ਰੰਗ ਰਾਗ ਕੋ ਬਿਢੰਦਾ ਦੁਸਟ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੇ ਦਲਿੰਦਾ ਛੋਡ ਦੂਜੋ ਕੌਨ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੭॥੪੬॥
132.t: aarajaa dhahi(n)dhaa ra(n)g raag ko bidda(n)dhaa dhusaT dhroh ke dhali(n)dhaa chhodd dhoojo kauan maaneeaai ||7||46||
132.e: He is the prolonger of life, the Promoter of the entertainments of music and the masher of tyrants and malevolent, whom else should we then ADORE? 7.46.

132.g: ਆਤਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਜਾਹ ਸਿਧਤਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਤਾਹ ਬੁਧਤਾ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਜਾਹ ਸਿਧਤਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਹੈ ॥
132.t: aatamaa pradhaan jaeh sidhataa saroop taeh budhataa bibhoot jaeh sidhataa subhaau hai ||
132.e: His Self is Supreme, He is Power-incarnate, His wealth is His Intellect and His Nature is that of a Redeemer.

132.g: ਰਾਗ ਭੀ ਨ ਰੰਗ ਤਾਹਿ ਰੂਪ ਭੀ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਜਾਹਿ ਅੰਗ ਭੀ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਤਾਹ ਰੰਗ ਕੇ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਹੈ ॥
132.t: raag bhee na ra(n)g taeh roop bhee na rekh jaeh a(n)g bhee sura(n)g taeh ra(n)g ke subhaau hai ||
132.e: He is without affection, colour, form and mark, still He hath beautiful limbs and His Nature is that of Love.

132.g: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੋ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਪਰਮਤਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਸੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਕੋ ਉਪਾਉ ਹੈ ॥
132.t: chitr so bachitr hai paramataa pavitr hai su mitr hoo(n) ke mitr hai bibhoot ko upaau hai ||
132.e: His painting of the universe is Wonderful and Supremely Spotless He is friend of friends and Supreme Donor of wealth.

132.g: ਦੇਵਨ ਕੇ ਦੇਵ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਸਾਹਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਹ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਰਾਜਨ ਕੋ ਰਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਰਾਵਨ ਕੋ ਰਾਉ ਹੈ ॥੮॥੪੭॥
132.t: dhevan ke dhev hai k saahan ke saeh hai k raajan ko raaj hai k raavan ko raau hai ||8||47||
132.e: He is the god of gods monarch of monarch He is the king of kings and chieftain of the chiefs.8.47.
BAHIR TAVEEL STANZA, PASCHAMI, BY THY GRACE
That Lord is devoid of service
That Lord is devoid of contemplation.

133.e: That Lord is not affected by might (or musical tunes)
That Lord is not affected by Site.
That Lord is not affected by Strife
That Lord is not affected by senses.12.59.
That Lord cannot be absorbed in senses
That Lord is unaffected by the waves.14.61.
That Lord is Perfect in Learning.
That is not effected by the Potent warriors
That Lord is full of all above- mentioned attributes
That Lord is Fearless( Or garbless).
That Lord is in male body
That Lord is also in female body.16.63.
That Lord is Aumkar (the One and only one)
That Lord is Akar i.e. Pervasive in all forms.
That Lord is beyond all devices.17.64.
That Lord is not affected by strife
ARDH NARAAJ STANZA: BY THY GRACE
Thou art the Banner of Honuor.

134.e: Thy winsome luster astonishes the moonlight
The clique of tyrants is suppressed
Such is the glamour of Thy metropolis (world).1.79.
Moving like Chandika (Goddess) in the battlefield

135.e: Thou destroyest in an instant seemingly imperishable warriors.
Thou movest like the fire of lightning
O Infinite Lord! Thy Thorne is visualized in all directions.2.80.
Thy Pure emotions gleam
And destroy the forces of suffering.
The row of Thy horses looks graceful
Seeing which the horse of the Ocean gets angry.3.81.
Thou art radiant like the great ball of the Sun
Beyond the tunes of worldly joys.
Thou art everlasting like the Bunyan-seed
And art Blissful ever perfectly.4.82.
The Treasure of Thy wealth is inexhaustible
O Immaculate Lord! Thou art not united with anyone.
Thy seat is eternal
Thou art accountless, guiseless and Imperishable.5.83.
The row of thy teeth looks graceful
Seeing which the dark clouds feel jealous.
The small bells look elegant in the string round Thy waist
Seeing Thy effulgence the splendour of the Sun feels jealous.6.84.
The crest on Thy head seems splendid
Like the shaft high up in the clouds.
The Crown on Thy head looks elegant
Seeing which the moon feels shy.7.85.
The rows of demons are moving
And both the armies are running.
When Thou usest Thy arms and weapons
And Thy disc moves in all the four directions.8.86.
Thy Inaccesible Glory looks elegant
Therefore the great sages and Shiva are covetous to have Thy Sight.
They remember Thy Name many times
Even then they have not been able go know Thy limits.9.87.
Many with faces upside down light the fire
Many ascetics roam forsaking their sleep.
Many perform austerity of five fires
Even they have not been able to know thy limits.10.88.
The performance of Neoli Karma (cleansing of intestines): the innumerable religious acts of giving charities
Abiding at pilgrim-stations for numberless times
All these acts do not equal do not equal the merit of the remembrance of the Name of One Lord.11.89.
The performance of innumerable acts of sacrifices
The performance of the religious act of giving elephants etc. in charity
Wandering in many countries
All these acts do not equal the merit of the remembrance of the Name of One Lord.12.90.
Dwelling in solitary confinement
Wandering in millions of forests
Becoming unattached many recite mantras
Many roam like hermits.13.91.
Many move in various guises and adopt several postures

136.e: Millions hold million types of fasts.
One may roam in many directions
He may observe many types of guises.14.92.
One may perform m,illions of types of charities
He may perform many types of sacrifices and actions.
One may adopt the religious garb of mendicant
He may perform many rituals of a hermit. 15.93.
One may read the religious texts continuously
He may perform many ostentations.
None of them equals the Name of One Lord
They are all an illusion like the world.16.94.
One may perform the religious acts of the ancient ages
He may perform the ascetic and monastic works.
He may perform the works of mercy etc., and magic
They are all wworks of great restraint, prevalent from times immemorial.17.95.
One may wander in many countries
He may adopt the discipline of giving million of charities.
Many songs of knowledge are sung
He may be proficient in innumerable types of knowledge and contemplation.18.96.
Those who are superb by achieving millions of types of knowledge
They are also observing many good actions.
Like Vyas, Narad etc.,
they even have not been able to know the secret of a Brahman.19.97.
Though millions of yantras and mantras may be practiced
And innumerable Tantras may be made.
One may even sit on the seat of Vyas
And forsake many types of food.20.98.
All the gods and demons remember Him
All the Yakshas and Gandharvas worship Him.
The Visyadhars sing His Prises
The reamaing categories including Nagas remember His Name.21.99.
He is remembered by all in this and other worlds
He hath put the seven oceans at their places.
He is known in all the four directions
The wheel of His Discipline keeps moving.22.100.
He is remembered by serpents and octopus
The vegetation narrates His Praises.
The beings of sky, earth and water remember Him
The beings in water and on land repeat His Name.23.101.
Millions of four-headed Brahmas
Recite the four Vedas.
Millions of Shiva worship that Wonderful Entity
Millions of Vishnus adore Him.24.102.
Innumerable Sarswatis goddess and Satis (Parvati-goddess)
And Lakshmis goddess and Satis (Parvati-goddess) and Lakshmis goddess sing His Praises.
Innumerable Sheshanaga eulogize Him
That Lord is comprehended as infinite ultimeately.25.103.
BRIDH NARAAJ STANZA

137.g: ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਆਦਿ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਮਨਾਈਐ ॥
137.t: anaadh agaadh biaadh aadh anaadh ko manaieeaai ||
137.e: He is Beginningless, Unfathomable and Source of all beings that Beginningless Lord be worshipped.

137.g: ਅਗੰਜ ਅਭੰਜ ਅਰੰਜ ਅਗੰਜ ਗੰਜ ਕਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
137.t: aga(n)j abha(n)j ara(n)j aga(n)j ga(n)j kau dhiaaieeaai ||
137.e: He is Indestructible, Unbreakable, griefless and Inexhaustible teasure, He should be meditated upon.

137.g: ਅਲੇਖ ਅਭੇਖ ਅਦ੍ਵੈਖ ਅਰੇਖ ਅਸੇਖ ਕੋ ਪਛਾਨੀਐ ॥
137.t: alekh abhekh adhavaikh arekh asekh ko pachhaaneeaai ||
137.e: He is accountless, guiseless, without blemish, without mark nd without a remander, He should be recognized.

137.g: ਨ ਭੂਲ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਭਰਮ ਭੇਖ ਠਾਨੀਐ ॥੧॥੧੦੪॥
137.t: n bhool ja(n)tr ta(n)tr ma(n)tr bharam bhekh Thaaneeaai ||1||104||
137.e: Even by mistake He should not be considered in Yantras, tantrasa, mantras, illusions and guises.1.104.

137.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਲਾਲ ਅਕਾਲ ਅਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੋ ਉਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
137.t: kirapaal laal akaal apaal dhiaal ko uchaareeaai ||
137.e: The Name of that Lord be uttered who is Merciful, Beloved, deathless, Patronless and Compassionate.

137.g: ਅਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਮੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੀਐ ॥
137.t: adharam karam dharam bharam karam mai bichaareeaai ||
137.e: We should reflect upon Him in all works whether irreligious, or fallacious.

137.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਦਾਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨਵਾਨ ਪੇਖੀਐ ॥
137.t: ana(n)t dhaan dhiaan giaan dhiaanavaan pekheeaai ||
137.e: We should visualize Him in Infinite charities, in contemplation, in knowledge and in those who contemplate.

137.g: ਅਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੇ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਲੇਖੀਐ ॥੨॥੧੦੫॥
137.t: adharam karam ke binaa su dharam karam lekheeaai ||2||105||
137.e: Forsaking the irreligious Karms, we should comprehend the Karms that are religious and spiritual.2.105.

137.g: ਬ੍ਰਤਾਦਿ ਦਾਨ ਸੰਜਮਾਦਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵ ਕਰਮਣੰ ॥
137.t: brataadh dhaan sa(n)jamaadh teerath dhev karamana(n) ||
137.e: The Karmas which come in the categories of fasts etc., charities, restraints etc., bathing at pilgrim-stations and worship of gods

137.g: ਹੈ ਆਦਿ ਕੁੰਜਮੇਦ ਰਾਜਸੂ ਬਿਨਾ ਨ ਭਰਮਣੰ ॥
137.t: hai aadh ku(n)jamedh raajasoo binaa na bharamana(n) ||
137.e: Which are to be performed without illusion including the horse-sacrifice, elephant-sacrifice and Rajsu sacrifice performed by a universal monarch

137.g: ਨਿਵਲ ਆਦਿ ਕਰਮ ਭੇਖ ਅਨੇਕ ਭੇਖ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
137.t: nival aadh karam bhekh anek bhekh maaneeaai ||
137.e: And the Neoli Karma of Yogis (cleansing of intestines) etc., may all be considered as Karmas of various sects and guises.

137.g: ਅਦੇਖ ਭੇਖ ਕੇ ਬਿਨਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਮ ਭਰਮ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੩॥੧੦੬॥
137.t: adhekh bhekh ke binaa su karam bharam jaaneeaai ||3||106||
137.e: In the absence of the pure Karmas related to the Invisible Lord, all the other Karmas he considered as illusion and hyposcrisy.3.106.

137.g: ਅਜਾਤ ਪਾਤ ਅਮਾਤ ਤਾਤ ਅਜਾਤ ਸਿਧ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ॥
137.t: ajaat paat amaat taat ajaat sidh hai sadhaa ||
137.e: He is without caste and lineage, without mother and father He is Unborn and ever perfect.

137.g: ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਪਉਤ੍ਰ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਸਰਬਦਾ ॥
137.t: asatr mitr putr pautr jatr tatr sarabadhaa ||
137.e: He is without enemy and friend, without son and grandson and He is always everywhere.

137.g: ਅਖੰਡ ਮੰਡ ਚੰਡ ਉਦੰਡ ਅਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਭਾਖੀਐ ॥
137.t: akha(n)dd ma(n)dd cha(n)dd udha(n)dd akha(n)dd kha(n)dd bhaakheeaai ||
137.e: He is Supremely Glorious and is called the crusher and breaker of the Unbreakable.

137.g: ਨ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਰੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ ਭੇਖ ਮੈ ਨ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥੪॥੧੦੭॥
137.t: n roop ra(n)g rekh alekh bhekh mai na raakheeaai ||4||107||
137.e: He cannot be placed in the garb of form, colour, mark and calculation.4.107.

137.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਤੀਰਥ ਆਦਿ ਆਸਨਾਦਿ ਨਾਰਦ ਆਸਨੰ ॥
137.t: ana(n)t teerath aadh aasanaadh naaradh aasana(n) ||
137.e: Bathing at innumerable pilgrim-stations etc., adopting various postures etc., following the discipline of worship according to Narad Pancharatra

137.g: ਬੈਰਾਗ ਅਉ ਸੰਨਿਆਸ ਅਉ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਜੋਗ ਪ੍ਰਾਸਨੰ ॥
137.t: bairaag aau sa(n)niaas aau anaadh jog praasana(n) ||
137.e: Adoption of Vairagya (monasticism and asceticlism) and Sannyas (renunciation) and observing yogic discipline of olden times:

137.g: ਅਨਾਦਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੰਜਮਾਦਿ ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਪੇਖੀਐ ॥
137.t: anaadh teerath sa(n)jamaadh barat nem pekheeaai ||
137.e: Visiting ancient pilgrim-stations and observing restraints etc., fasts and other rules

137.g: ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕੇ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਮਸਤ ਭਰਮ ਲੇਖੀਐ ॥੫॥੧੦੮॥
137.t: anaadh agaadh ke binaa samasat bharam lekheeaai ||5||108||
137.e: Without the Beginningless and Unfathomable Lord, all the above Karmas be considered as illusion.5.108.
RASAAVAL STANZA
The religious discipline like Mercy etc.,
The Karmas like Sannyas (renunciation) etc.,
The Charities of elephants etc.,
The places of sacrifice of horses etc.,1.109.
The charities like gold etc.,
The bath in the sea etc.,
Wanderings in the universe etc.,
The works of austerities etc.,2.110.
The Karma like Neoli (cleansing of intestines) etc.,
Wearing of blue clothes etc.,
Contemplation of Colourless etc.,
The Supreme Essence is the Remembrance of the Name.3.111.
O Lord! The types of Thy devotion are unlimited,
Thy affection is unmanifested.
Thou becomest apparent to the seeker
Thou art Unestablished by devotions.4.112.
Thou art the doer of all the works of Thy devotees
Thou art the destroyer of the sinners.
Thou art the illuminator of detachment
Thou art the destroyer of tyranny.5.113.
Thou art the Sumpreme Authority over all
Thou art the axle of the banner.
Thou art ever Unassailable
Thou art the only one Formless Lord.6.114.
Thou Thyself manifestest Thy Forms
Thou art Merciful to the deserving.
Thou pervadest the earth indivisibly

138.e: Thou canst not be attached with anything.7.115.
Thou art the superb Abode among abodes
Thou art the householder among householders.
Thou art conscious Entity devoid of ailments
Thou art there on the eath but hidden.8.116.
Thou art conqueror and without effect on muttering
Thou art Fearless and Invisible.
Thou art the Only One amongst many :
Thou art ever indivisble.9.117
Thou art beyond all ostentations
Thou art far away from all pressures.
Thou canst not be vanquished by anyone
Thy limits canst not be measured by anyone.10.118.
Thou art beyond all ailments and agonies
Thou canst not established.
Thou art the masher of all blemishes from the beginning
There is none other so extraordinary as Thou.11.119.
Thou art Most Holy
Thou promptest the flourishing of the world.
Distinctively Thou art Supporting
O guideless Lord! Thou art worshipped by all.12.120.
Thou art the sap in flowers and fruits
Thou art the inspirer in the hearts.
Thou art the one to resist among the resistant
Thou art the destroyer of the three worlds (or modes).13.121.
Thou art the colour as well as devoid of colour
Thou art the beauty as well as the lover of beauty.
Thou art the Only One and ONLY ONE like Thyself
Thou art the Only One now and shall be the Only One in future.14.122.
Thou art described as the Donor of boons
Thou art the Only One, the Only One.
Thou art affectionate and accountless
Thou art depicted as markless.15.123.
Thou art in the three worlds and also the destroyer of three modes
O Lord! Thou art in every colour.
Thou art the earth and also the Lord of the earth.
O Guiseless Lord! All adore Thee.16.124.
Thou art the Suprb of the eminent ones.
Thou art the Giver of reward in an instant.
Thou art the Sovereign of men.
Thou art the destroyer of the Masters of the armies.17.125.
PAADHRAI STANZA BY THY GRACE
On a day the curious soul (asked): The infinite and Desire less Lord, the Intuitive Entity.
Of everlasting Glory and long-armed
The King of kings and Emperor of emperors.1.126.
The soul said to the Higher Soul
The Germinating Entity, Unmanifested and Invincible

139.e: “What is this Soul Entity? Which hath indelible glory and which is of queer substance.”2.127.
The Higher Soul said:
“This Soul is itself Brahman
” Who is of Everlasting Glory and is Unmanisfested and Desireless.

139.g: ਜਿਹ ਭੇਦ ਭਰਮ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਾਲ ॥
139.t: jeh bhedh bharam nahee karam kaal ||
139.e: Who is indiscriminate, actionless and deathless
Who hath no enemy and friend and is Merciful towards all.3.1228.

139.g: ਡੋਬਿਯੋ ਨ ਡੁਬੈ ਸੋਖਿਯੋ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
139.t: ddobiyo na ddubai sokhiyo na jai ||
139.e: It is neither drowned nor soaked

139.g: ਕਟਿਯੋ ਨ ਕਟੈ ਨ ਬਾਰਿਯੋ ਬਰਾਇ ॥
139.t: kaTiyo na kaTai na baariyo barai ||
139.e: It can neither be chopped nor burnt.

139.g: ਛਿਜੈ ਨ ਨੈਕ ਸਤ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਤ ॥
139.t: chhijai na naik sat sasatr paat ||
139.e: It cannot be assailed by the blow of weapon

139.g: ਜਿਹ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਪਾਤ ॥੪॥੧੨੯॥
139.t: jeh satr mitr nahee jaat paat ||4||129||
139.e: It hath neither an enemy nor a friend, neither caste not lineage.4.129.

139.g: ਛਿਜੈ ਨ ਨੈਕ ਖੰਡਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
139.t: chhijai na naik kha(n)ddio na jai ||
139.e: By the blow of thousands of enemies, It is neither wasted away nor fragmented.

139.g: ਬੋਰੈ ਨ ਸਿੰਧ ਸੋਖੈ ਨ ਬ੍ਰਯਾਰ ॥੫॥੧੩੦॥
139.t: borai na si(n)dh sokhai na brayaar ||5||130||
139.e: It is not burnt even in the fire. It is neither drowned in the sea nor soaked by the air.5.130.
Then the Soul questioned the Lord thus : “O Lord! Thou art Invincible, Intuitive and Indiscriminate Entity
“This world mentions four categories of Charities
Which are these categories, tell me Graciously.”6.131.

139.g: ਇਕ ਰਾਜੁ ਧਰਮ ਇਕ ਦਾਨ ਧਰਮ ॥
139.t: eik raaj dharam ik dhaan dharam ||
139.e: One is political discipline, one is ascetic’s discipline

139.g: ਇਕ ਭੋਗ ਧਰਮ ਇਕ ਮੋਛ ਕਰਮ ॥
139.t: eik bhog dharam ik mochh karam ||
139.e: One is householder’s discipline, one is ascetic’s discipline.

139.g: ਇਕ ਚਤੁਰ ਵਰਗ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਭਣੰਤ ॥
139.t: eik chatur varag sabh jag bhana(n)t ||
139.e: All the world knows this one of four categories
That Soul makes enquiries from the Lord.7.132.

139.g: ਇਕ ਰਾਜ ਧਰਮ ਇਕ ਧਰਮ ਦਾਨ ॥
139.t: eik raaj dharam ik dharam dhaan ||
139.e: One is political discipline and one is religious discipline
One is householder’s discipline, one is ascetic’s discipline .
Tell me Graciously Thy thoughts about all the four:
And also tell me their originators in long ages in three epochs.8.133.
Describe to me the first discipline
How this religious discipline was observed by the kings.
In Satyuga charities were given by performing virtuous actions
Indescribable charities of lands etc  , were given.9.134.

139.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਜੁਗ ਮਹੀਪ ਬਰਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਤ ॥
139.t: trai jug maheep barane na jaat ||

139.e: It is difficult to describe the king of three ages, their story is endless and the Praise indescribable.

139.g: ਜੋ ਕੀਏ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਜਗ ਧਰਮ ॥
139.t: jo ke'ee jagat mai jag dharam ||

139.g: ਬਰਨੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਤੇ ਅਮਿਤ ਕਰਮ ॥੧੦॥੧੩੫॥
139.t: barane na jaeh te amit karam ||10||135||
139.e: By performing sacrifices, the religious discipline unlimited action.10.135.

139.g: ਕਲਜੁਗ ਤੇ ਆਦਿ ਜੋ ਭਏ ਮਹੀਪ ॥
139.t: kalajug te aadh jo bhe maheep ||

139.g: ਇਹਿ ਭਰਥ ਖੰਡਿ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਬੂ ਦੀਪ ॥
139.t: eeh bharath kha(n)dd meh ja(n)boo dheep ||
139.e: The kings that reigned before Kaliyuga, in the Jambu Dvipa in the Bharat Khand.

139.g: ਤ੍ਵ ਬਲ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਬਰਣੌ ਸੁ ਤ੍ਰੈਣ ॥
139.t: tavai bal prataap baranau su train ||

139.e: I describe them with Thy Strength and Glory, The king Yadhishtra was the unblemished Sustainer of the earth.11.136.
He (Yadhishtra) broke the unbreakable ones in the four khands (regions), He destroyed the Kauravas with great might in the war of Kurukshetra.
He conquered twice all the four directions. The mighty warriors like Arjuna and Bhim were his brothers.12.137.
He sent Arjuna toward the North for conquest, Bhim went for conquest to the east.
Sahdev was sent to the country in the South, Nakul was sent to the West.13.138.

140.g: ਜਿਤੇ ਅਜੀਤ ਮੰਡੇ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
140.t: jite ajeet ma(n)dde mahaan ||
140.e: The Kshatriya kings were mashed and destroyed. In the Great war the unconquerable were conquered.

140.g: ਖੰਡਿਯੋ ਸੁ ਉਤ੍ਰ ਖੁਰਾਸਾਨ ਦੇਸ ॥
140.t: kha(n)ddiyo su utr khuraasaan dhes ||

140.g: ਦਛਨ ਪੂਰਬ ਜੀਤੇ ਨਰੇਸ ॥੧੪॥੧੩੯॥
140.t: dhachhan poorab jeete nares ||14||139||
140.e: The Khorasan country in the North was destroyed, The kings of the South and East were conquered.14.139.

140.g: ਖਗ ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਜੀਤੇ ਮਹੀਪ ॥
140.t: khag kha(n)dd kha(n)dd jeete maheep ||

140.g: ਬਜਿਯੋ ਨਿਸਾਨ ਇਹ ਜੰਬੂਦੀਪ ॥
140.t: bajiyo nisaan ieh ja(n)boodheep ||
140.e: The kings of all the regions were defeated with the might of sword. In this Jambu Dvipa the trumpet (of Yudhishtra sounded.

140.g: ਇਕ ਠਉਰ ਕੀਏ ਸਬ ਦੇਸ ਰਾਉ ॥
140.t: eik Thaur ke'ee sab dhes raau ||

140.g: ਮਖ ਰਾਜਸੂਅ ਕੋ ਕੀਓ ਚਾਉ ॥੧੫॥੧੪੦॥
140.t: makh raajasooa ko keeo chaau ||15||140||
140.e: He gathered together the kings of various countries at one place. He expressed his wish for th performance of Rajsu sacrifice.15.140.

140.g: ਸਬ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਪਠੇ ਸੁ ਪਤ੍ਰ ॥
140.t: sab dhes dhes paThe su patr ||

140.g: ਜਿਤ ਜਿਤ ਗੁਨਾਢ ਕੀਏ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ॥
140.t: jit jit gunaadd ke'ee ikatr ||
140.e: He sent letters to all countries. All the qualified Brahmins were gathered together.

140.g: ਮਖ ਰਾਜਸੂਅ ਕੋ ਕੀਯੋ ਅਰੰਭ ॥
140.t: makh raajasooa ko keeyo ara(n)bh ||

140.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬਹੁਤ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਜਿਤੇ ਅਸੰਭ ॥੧੬॥੧੪੧॥
140.t: nirap bahut bulai jite asa(n)bh ||16||141||
140.e: The performance of Rajsu sacrifice was started. Many of the conquered kings were called.16.141.

140.g: ਰੂਆਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
140.t: rooaal chha(n)dh ||
140.e: ROOAAL STANZA

140.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਰਿਤਜ ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
140.t: koT koT bulai ritaj koT braham bulai ||
140.e: Million of ritual-conscious Brahmins were called.

140.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਬਨਾਇ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਭੋਗੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਇ ॥
140.t: koT koT banai bi(n)jan bhoge'eeh bahu bhai ||
140.e: Million of different foods were prepared which were enjoyed with relish.

140.g: ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਸਮਗ੍ਰਕਾ ਕਹੂੰ ਲਾਗ ਹੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਰਾਇ ॥
140.t: jatr tatr samagrakaa kahoo(n) laag hai niraparai ||
140.e: Many chief Sovereigns were busy in collecting required materials.

140.g: ਰਾਜਸੂਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਲਗੇ ਸਭ ਧਰਮ ਕੋ ਚਿਤ ਚਾਇ ॥੧॥੧੪੨॥
140.t: raajasooi kareh lage sabh dharam ko chit chai ||1||142||
140.e: Thus, the Rajsu sacrifice began to be performed with religious zeal.1.142.

140.g: ਏਕ ਏਕ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਕੋ ਦਿਜ ਏਕ ਦੀਜੈ ਭਾਰ ॥
140.t: ek ek suvaran ko dhij ek dheejai bhaar ||
140.e: The orders were given for giving one load of gold to each Brahmin.

140.g: ਏਕ ਸਉ ਗਜ ਏਕ ਸਉ ਰਥਿ ਦੁਇ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਤੁਖਾਰ ॥
140.t: ek sau gaj ek sau rath dhui saha(n)sr tukhaar ||
140.e: One hundred elephants, one hundred chariots and two thousand horses

140.g: ਸਹੰਸ ਚਤੁਰ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਸਿੰਗੀ ਮਹਿਖ ਦਾਨ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
140.t: saha(n)s chatur suvaran si(n)gee mahikh dhaan apaar ||
140.e: And also four thousand cow with gilded horns and innumerable buffalos in charity

140.g: ਏਕ ਏਕਹਿ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਸੁਨ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਜ ਅਉਤਾਰ ॥੨॥੧੪੩॥
140.t: ek ekeh dheejeeaai sun raaj raaj aautaar ||2||143||
140.e: Listen O Chief of the Kings, give these gifts to each Brahmin.2.143.

140.g: ਸੁਵਰਨ ਦਾਨ ਸੁ ਦਾਨ ਰੁਕਮ ਦਾਨ ਸੁ ਤਾਬ੍ਰ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
140.t: suvaran dhaan su dhaan rukam dhaan su taabr dhaan ana(n)t ||
140.e: Innumerable articles like gold, silver and copper were given in charity.

140.g: ਅੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੰਤ ਦੀਜਤ ਦੇਖ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥
140.t: a(n)n dhaan ana(n)t dheejat dhekh dheen dhura(n)t ||
140.e: Innumerable alms of grain were given to many gathered poor people.

140.g: ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਦਾਨ ਪਟੰਬ੍ਰ ਦਾਨ ਸੁ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਦਾਨ ਦਿਜੰਤ ॥
140.t: basatr dhaan paTa(n)br dhaan su sasatr dhaan dhija(n)t ||
140.e: Other items given in charity were the common clothes, silken clothes and weapons.

140.g: ਭੂਪ ਭਿਛਕ ਹੁਇ ਗਏ ਸਬ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥੩॥੧੪੪॥
140.t: bhoop bhichhak hui ge sab dhes dhes dhura(n)t ||3||144||
140.e: The beggars from many countries became well-off.3.144.

140.g: ਚਤ੍ਰ ਕੋਸ ਬਨਾਹਿ ਕੁੰਡਕ ਸਹਸ੍ਰ ਲਾਇ ਪਰਨਾਰ ॥
140.t: chatr kos banaeh ku(n)ddak sahasr lai paranaar ||
140.e: The fire-altar extended upto four kos and had one thousand drains.

140.g: ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਹੋਮ ਕਰੈ ਲਗੈ ਦਿਜ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਆਸ ਅਉਤਾਰ ॥
140.t: saha(n)sr hom karai lagai dhij bedh biaas aautaar ||
140.e: One thousand Brahmins, considered incarnations of Ved Vyas, began the performance of sacrifice.

140.g: ਹਸਤ ਸੁੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੀ ਪਰਤ ਧਾਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
140.t: hasat su(n)dd pramaan ghirat kee parat dhaar apaar ||
140.e: The continuous current of clarified butter of the size of elephant’s trunk fell in the pit.

140.g: ਹੋਤ ਭਸਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਲਪਟ ਝਪਟ ਕਰਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੪੫॥
140.t: hot bhasam anek bi(n)jan lapaT jhapaT karaal ||4||145||
140.e: Many materials were reduced to ashes by the dreadful flame.4.145.

140.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਤਕਾ ਸਭ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੋ ਲੈ ਬਾਰ ॥
140.t: mritakaa sabh teerath kee sabh teerath ko lai baar ||
140.e: The earth and water of all the pilgrim-stations was broutht.

140.g: ਕਾਸਟਕਾ ਸਭ ਦੇਸ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਦੇਸ ਕੀ ਜਿਉਨਾਰ ॥
140.t: kaasaTakaa sabh dhes kee sabh dhes kee jiaunaar ||
140.e: Also the fuel-wood and food-materials from all countries

140.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤਨ ਕੇ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਹੋਮੀਐ ਤਿਹ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
140.t: bhaat bhaatan ke mahaa ras homeeaai teh maeh ||
140.e: Various kids of tasteful foods were burnt in the alftar.

140.g: ਦੇਖ ਚਕ੍ਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਜੰਬਰ ਰੀਝ ਹੀ ਨਰ ਨਾਹ ॥੫॥੧੪੬॥
140.t: dhekh chakrat rahai dhija(n)bar reejh hee nar naeh ||5||146||
140.e: Seeing which the superb Brahmins were astonished and the kings pleased.5.146.

140.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਬਿਜੰਨ ਹੋਮੀਐ ਤਿਹ ਆਨ ॥
140.t: bhaat bhaat anek bija(n)n homeeaai teh aan ||
140.e: Many and various types of foods were burnt in the altar.

140.g: ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੜੈ ਚਤ੍ਰ ਸਭ ਬਿਪ ਬ੍ਯਾਸ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
140.t: chatur bedh paRai chatr sabh bip bayaas samaan ||
140.e: On all the four sides the learned Brahmins were reciting the four Vedas, like Vyas.

140.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਭੂਪਤ ਦੇਤ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
140.t: bhaat bhaat anek bhoopat dhet dhaan ana(n)t ||
140.e: Many kings were giving innumerable types of gifts in charity.

140.g: ਭੂਮ ਭੂਰ ਉਠੀ ਜਯਤ ਧੁਨ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥੬॥੧੪੭॥
140.t: bhoom bhoor uThee jayat dhun jatr tatr dhura(n)t ||6||147||
140.e: Here, there and everywhere on the earth infinite strain of victory was sounded.6.147.

140.g: ਜੀਤ ਜੀਤ ਮਵਾਸ ਆਸਨ ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬ ਛਿਨਾਇ ॥
140.t: jeet jeet mavaas aasan arab kharab chhinai ||
140.e: Counquering the rebel kings and seizing the unaccountable wealth and precious things

140.g: ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਦੀਏ ਦਿਜਾਨਨ ਜਗ ਮੈ ਕੁਰ ਰਾਇ ॥
140.t: aan aan dhe'ee dhijaanan jag mai kur rai ||
140.e: (Yusdhishtra) the king of Kuru country brought that wealth and distributed among the Brahmins.

140.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਧੂਪ ਸੁ ਧੂਪੀਐ ਤਿਹ ਆਨ ॥
140.t: bhaat bhaat anek dhoop su dhoopeeaai teh aan ||
140.e: Many types of fragrant materials were ignited there.

140.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਉਠੀ ਜਯ ਧੁਨਿ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਦਿਸਾਨ ॥੭॥੧੪੮॥
140.t: bhaat bhaat uThee jay dhun jatr tatr dhisaan ||7||148||
140.e: Here, there and everywhere in all directions many types of the strains of victory were sounded.7.148.

140.g: ਜਰਾਸੰਧਹ ਮਾਰ ਕੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਕੈਰਵਾ ਹਥਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
140.t: jaraasa(n)dheh maar kai pun kairavaa hath pai ||
140.e: After slaying Jarasandh and then conquering the Kauravas,

140.g: ਰਾਜਸੂਇ ਕੀਓ ਬਡੋ ਮਖਿ ਕਿਸਨ ਕੇ ਮਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
140.t: raajasooi keeo baddo makh kisan ke mat bhai ||
140.e: Yudhishtra performed the great Rajsu sacrifice in consultation with Krishna.

140.g: ਰਾਜਸੂਇ ਸੁ ਕੈ ਕਿਤੇ ਦਿਨ ਜੀਤ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
140.t: raajasooi su kai kite dhin jeet satr ana(n)t ||
140.e: Conquering innumerable enemies, for many days, he performed the Rajsu sacrifice.

140.g: ਬਾਜਮੇਧ ਅਰੰਭ ਕੀਨੋ ਬੇਦ ਬ੍ਯਾਸ ਮਤੰਤ ॥੮॥੧੪੯॥
140.t: baajamedh ara(n)bh keeno bedh bayaas mata(n)t ||8||149||
140.e: Then, with the advice of Ved Vyas, he began the performance of horse-sacrifice.8.149.

140.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਜਗ ਸਮਾਪਤਿਹ ॥
140.t: piratham jag samaapateh ||
140.e: Here ends the First Sacrifice.

140.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਰਣ ਬਧਹ ॥
140.t: sree baran badheh ||
140.e: The Slaying of Sri Baran:

140.g: ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਬਰਣੇ ਸੁਕਰਨਿ ਸਿਯਾਮ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਪੂਛ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
140.t: cha(n)dhr barane sukaran siyaam suvaran poochh samaan ||
140.e: (The Sacrificial horse) is of white colour, black ears having golden tail

140.g: ਰਤਨ ਤੁੰਗ ਉਤੰਗ ਬਾਜਤ ਉਚ ਸ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
140.t: ratan tu(n)g uta(n)g baajat uch sravaeh samaan ||
140.e: With eyes high and wide and lofty neck like Unhchyishravas

141.g: ਨਿਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਚਲੈ ਧਰਾ ਪਰਿ ਕਾਮ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਇ ॥
141.t: nirat karat chalai dharaa par kaam roop prabhai ||
141.e: He walks on the earth with dancing pose, glorious in beauty like Cupid.

141.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਛਕੈ ਸਭੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਰੀਝਿ ਇਉ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਰਾਇ ॥੯॥੧੫੦॥
141.t: dhekh dhekh chhakai sabhai nirap reejh iau niraparai ||9||150||
141.e: On seeing him all the kings are pleased and also (Yudhishtra) the king of king.9.150.

141.g: ਬੀਣ ਬੇਣ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਬਾਜਤ ਬਾਸੁਰੀ ਸੁਰਨਾਇ ॥
141.t: been ben miradha(n)g baajat baasuree suranai ||
141.e: Vina, Ven Mridang, Bansuri and Bheri are being played.

141.g: ਮੁਰਜ ਤੂਰ ਮੁਚੰਗ ਮੰਦਲ ਚੰਗ ਬੰਗ ਸਨਾਇ ॥
141.t: muraj toor mucha(n)g ma(n)dhal cha(n)g ba(n)g sanai ||
141.e: Innumerable Muj, Toor, Murchang, Mandal, Changbeg and sarnaaee

141.g: ਢੋਲ ਢੋਲਕ ਖੰਜਕਾ ਡਫ ਝਾਝ ਕੋਟ ਬਜੰਤ ॥
141.t: ddol ddolak kha(n)jakaa ddaf jhaajh koT baja(n)t ||
141.e: Dhol, Dholak, Khanjari, Daph and Jhaanjh are also being played.

141.g: ਜੰਗ ਘੁੰਘਰੂ ਟਲਕਾ ਉਪਜੰਤ ਰਾਗ ਅਨੰਤ ॥੧੦॥੧੫੧॥
141.t: ja(n)g ghu(n)gharoo Talakaa upaja(n)t raag ana(n)t ||10||151||
141.e: Big bell and small bells resound and innumerable modes of music are created.10.151.

141.g: ਅਮਿਤ ਸਬਦ ਬਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਭੇਰਿ ਹਰੰਤ ਬਾਜ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
141.t: amit sabadh baja(n)tr bher hara(n)t baaj apaar ||
141.e: Kettledrums when played produce unlimited sound and innumerable horses neigh.

141.g: ਜਾਤ ਜਉਨ ਦਿਸਾਨ ਕੇ ਪਛ ਲਾਗ ਹੀ ਸਿਰਦਾਰ ॥
141.t: jaat jaun dhisaan ke pachh laag hee siradhaar ||
141.e: Wherever the horse named Sri Barn goes, the army chiefs follow him.

141.g: ਜਉਨ ਬਾਧ ਤੁਰੰਗ ਜੂਝਤ ਜੀਤੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਜੁਧ ॥
141.t: jaun baadh tura(n)g joojhat jeeteeaai kar judh ||
141.e: Whosoever chains the horse, they fight with him and conquer him.

141.g: ਆਨ ਜੌਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਚੈ ਨਹਿ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ॥੧੧॥੧੫੨॥
141.t: aan jauan milai bachai neh maareeaai kar krudh ||11||152||
141.e: He who receives them, he is saved, otherwise one who confronts, is violently killed.11.152.

141.g: ਹੈਯ ਫੇਰ ਚਾਰ ਦਿਸਾਨ ਮੈ ਸਭ ਜੀਤ ਕੈ ਛਿਤਪਾਲ ॥
141.t: haiy fer chaar dhisaan mai sabh jeet kai chhitapaal ||
141.e: All the king were conquered by sending the horse in all the four directions.

141.g: ਬਾਜਮੇਧ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਸਪੂਰਨ ਅਮਿਤ ਜਗ ਰਿਸਾਲ ॥
141.t: baajamedh kariyo sapooran amit jag risaal ||
141.e: The horse-sacrifice was thus completed, it is very great and marvelous in the world.

141.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਦਾਨ ਸੁ ਦੀਜੀਅਹਿ ਦਿਜਰਾਜ ॥
141.t: bhaat bhaat anek dhaan su dheeje'eeh dhijaraaj ||
141.e: Various types of materials were given to the Brahmins in charity.

141.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਪਟੰਬਰਾਦਿਕ ਬਾਜਿਯੋ ਗਜਰਾਜ ॥੧੨॥੧੫੩॥
141.t: bhaat bhaat paTa(n)baraadhik baajiyo gajaraaj ||12||153||
141.e: Also many types of silken clothes, horses and great elephant.12.153.

141.g: ਅਨੇਕ ਦਾਨ ਦੀਏ ਦਿਜਾਨਨ ਅਮਿਤ ਦਰਬ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
141.t: anek dhaan dhe'ee dhijaanan amit dharab apaar ||
141.e: Many gifts and unaccountable wealth was given in charity to innumerable Brahmins.

141.g: ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਪਟੰਬਰਾਦਿ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰ ॥
141.t: heer cheer paTa(n)baraadh suvaran ke bahu bhaar ||
141.e: Including diamonds, common clothes, silken clothes and many loads of gold.

141.g: ਦੁਸਟ ਪੁਸਟ ਤ੍ਰਸੇ ਸਬੈ ਥਰਹਰਿਓ ਸੁਨਿ ਗਿਰਰਾਇ ॥
141.t: dhusaT pusaT trase sabai tharahario sun girarai ||
141.e: All the great enemies were horrified and even Sumeru, the king of mountain trembled on listening the details of charity.

141.g: ਕਾਟਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਨ ਦੈ ਦ੍ਵਿਜੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬਾਟ ਬਾਟ ਲੁਟਾਇ ॥੧੩॥੧੫੪॥
141.t: kaaT kaaT na dhai dhaviaijai nirap baaT baaT luTai ||13||154||
141.e: Fearing that the Chief Sovereign may not cut him into bits and then distribute the bits.13.154.

141.g: ਫੇਰ ਕੈ ਸਭ ਦੇਸ ਮੈ ਹਯ ਮਾਰਿਓ ਮਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
141.t: fer kai sabh dhes mai hay maario makh jai ||
141.e: Moving it throughout the country, the horse was ultimately killed in the sacrificial place

141.g: ਕਾਟਿ ਕੈ ਤਿਹ ਕੋ ਤਬੈ ਪਲ ਕੈ ਕਰੈ ਚਤੁ ਭਾਇ ॥
141.t: kaaT kai teh ko tabai pal kai karai chat bhai ||
141.e: Then it was cut into four pieces (parts).

141.g: ਏਕ ਬਿਪ੍ਰਨ ਏਕ ਛਤ੍ਰਨ ਏਕ ਇਸਤ੍ਰਿਨ ਦੀਨ ॥
141.t: ek bipran ek chhatran ek isatiran dheen ||
141.e: One part was given to the Brahmins, one to Kshatriyas and one to women.

141.g: ਚਤ੍ਰ ਅੰਸ ਬਚਿਯੋ ਜੁ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਮ ਮੈ ਵਹਿ ਕੀਨ ॥੧੪॥੧੫੫॥
141.t: chatr a(n)s bachiyo ju taa te hom mai veh keen ||14||155||
141.e: The remaining fourth part was burnt in the fire-altar.14.155.

141.g: ਪੰਚ ਸੈ ਬਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਸੁ ਰਾਜ ਕੈ ਇਹ ਦੀਪ ॥
141.t: pa(n)ch sai barakh pramaan su raaj kai ieh dheep ||
141.e: After ruling this Dvipa for five hundred years.

141.g: ਅੰਤ ਜਾਇ ਗਿਰੇ ਰਸਾਤਲ ਪੰਡ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮਹੀਪ ॥
141.t: a(n)t jai gire rasaatal pa(n)dd putr maheep ||
141.e: These sons of king Pandu ultimately fell in the himalayas (neither-world).

141.g: ਭੂਮ ਭਰਤ ਭਏ ਪਰੀਛਤ ਪਰਮ ਰੂਪ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
141.t: bhoom bharat bhe pareechhat param roop mahaan ||
141.e: After them Parikshat, who was most beautiful and mighty, (their grandson, the son of Abhimanya) became the king of Bharat.

141.g: ਅਮਿਤ ਰੂਪ ਉਦਾਰ ਦਾਨ ਅਛਿਜ ਤੇਜ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥੧੫॥੧੫੬॥
141.t: amit roop udhaar dhaan achhij tej nidhaan ||15||156||
141.e: He was man of boundless charm, a generous donor and a treasure of invincible glory.15.156.

141.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੋਧ ਪੋਥੀ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਜਗ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥
141.t: sree giaan prabodh pothee dhuteeaa jag samaapata(n) ||
141.e: This is the end of the Second Sacrifice in the book entitled SRI GYAN PRABODH.

141.g: ਅਥ ਰਾਜਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਛਤ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
141.t: ath raajaa preechhat ko raaj kathana(n) ||
141.e: Here begins the Description of the Rule of the King Parikshat :

141.g: ਰੁਆਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
141.t: ruaal chha(n)dh ||
141.e: ROOAAL STANZA

141.g: ਏਕ ਦਿਵਸ ਪਰੀਛਤਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੀਯੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
141.t: ek dhivas pareechhateh mil keeyo ma(n)tr mahaan ||
141.e: One day the King Parikshat consulted his ministers

141.g: ਗਜਾਮੇਧ ਸੁ ਜਗ ਕੋ ਕਿਉ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਸਵਧਾਨ ॥
141.t: gajaamedh su jag ko kiau keejeeaai savadhaan ||
141.e: As to how the elephant sacrifice be performed methodically?

141.g: ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਸੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਨ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਕੀਓ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
141.t: bol bol su mitr ma(n)tran ma(n)tr keeo bichaar ||
141.e: The friends and the ministers who spoke gave the idea

141.g: ਸੇਤ ਦੰਤ ਮੰਗਾਇ ਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਜੁਗਤ ਸੌ ਅਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੧॥੧੫੭॥
141.t: set dha(n)t ma(n)gai kai bahu jugat sau abichaar ||1||157||
141.e: That abandoning all other thoughts, the elephant of white teeth be sent for.1.157.

141.g: ਜਗ ਮੰਡਲ ਕੋ ਰਚਿਯੋ ਤਹਿ ਕੋਟ ਅਸਟ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ॥
141.t: jag ma(n)ddal ko rachiyo teh koT asaT pramaan ||
141.e: The sacrificial altar was constructed within eight kos

141.g: ਅਸਟ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਰਿਤੁਜੁ ਅਸਟ ਲਛ ਦਿਜਾਨ ॥
141.t: asaT saha(n)sr bulai rituj asaT lachh dhijaan ||
141.e: Eight thousand ritual-performing and eight lakh other Brahmins

141.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਬਨਾਇ ਕੈ ਤਹਾ ਅਸਟ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਨਾਰ ॥
141.t: bhaat bhaat banai kai tahaa asaT saha(n)sr pranaar ||
141.e: Eight thousand drain of various types were prepared.

141.g: ਹਸਤ ਸੁੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਮੀਐ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ॥੨॥੧੫੮॥
141.t: hasat su(n)dd pramaan taa meh homeeaai ghirat dhaar ||2||158||
141.e: Through which the continuous current of the clarified butter of the size of the elephant-trunk flowed.2.158.

141.g: ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
141.t: dhes dhes bulai kai bahu bhaat bhaat nirapaal ||
141.e: Various types of kings from various countries were called.

141.g: ਭਾਤ ਭਾਤਨ ਕੇ ਦੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਰਸਾਲ ॥
141.t: bhaat bhaatan ke dhe'ee bahu dhaan maan rasaal ||
141.e: They were given many gifts of various types with honour,

141.g: ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਪਟੰਬਰਾਦਿਕ ਬਾਜ ਅਉ ਗਜਰਾਜ ॥
141.t: heer cheer paTa(n)baraadhik baaj aau gajaraaj ||
141.e: Including diamonds, silken clothers etc., horses and big elephants.

141.g: ਸਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਸਬੈ ਦੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਕੌ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਰਾਜ ॥੩॥੧੫੯॥
141.t: saaj saaj sabai dhe'ee bahu raaj kau niraparaaj ||3||159||
141.e: The great Sovereign gave all the things highly decorated to the kings.3.159.

141.g: ਐਸਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਕੀਓ ਤਹਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਖ ਲਉ ਤਿਹ ਰਾਜ ॥
141.t: aais bhaat keeo tahaa bahu barakh lau teh raaj ||
141.e: In this way he ruled there for many years.

141.g: ਕਰਨ ਦੇਵ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਲਉ ਅਰ ਜੀਤ ਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਜ ॥
141.t: karan dhev pramaan lau ar jeet kai bahu saaj ||
141.e: Many eminent enemies like the king Karan were conquered alongwith many of their precious belongings.

141.g: ਏਕ ਦਿਵਸ ਚੜਿਓ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬਰ ਸੈਲ ਕਾਜ ਅਖੇਟ ॥
141.t: ek dhivas chaRio nirap bar sail kaaj akheT ||
141.e: On one day the king went on a merry-making trip and hunting.

141.g: ਦੇਖ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਭਇਓ ਤਹਾ ਮੁਨਰਾਜ ਸਿਉ ਭਈ ਭੇਟ ॥੪॥੧੬੦॥
141.t: dhekh mirag bhio tahaa munaraaj siau bhiee bheT ||4||160||
141.e: He saw and pursued a deer and met a great sage.4.160.

141.g: ਪੈਡ ਯਾਹਿ ਗਯੋ ਨਹੀ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਰੇ ਰਖੀਸਰ ਬੋਲ ॥
141.t: paidd yaeh gayo nahee mirag re rakheesar bol ||
141.e: (He said to the sage) “O great sage! Please speak, did the deer go this way ?”

141.g: ਉਤ੍ਰ ਭੂਪਹਿ ਨ ਦੀਓ ਮੁਨਿ ਆਖਿ ਭੀ ਇਕ ਖੋਲ ॥
141.t: autr bhoopeh na dheeo mun aakh bhee ik khol ||
141.e: The sage did not open his eye nor gave any answer to the king,

141.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਤਕ ਸਰਪ ਨਿਹਾਰ ਕੈ ਜਿਹ ਅਗ੍ਰ ਤਾਹ ਉਠਾਇ ॥
141.t: mritak sarap nihaar kai jeh agr taeh uThai ||
141.e: Seeing a dead snake, (the king) raised it with the tip of his bow

141.g: ਤਉਨ ਕੇ ਗਰ ਡਾਰ ਕੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਜਾਤ ਭਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਰਾਇ ॥੫॥੧੬੧॥
141.t: taun ke gar ddaar kai nirap jaat bhayo niraparai ||5||161||
141.e: Put it around the neck of the sage  then the Great Sovereign went away.5.161.

141.g: ਆਖ ਉਘਾਰ ਲਖੈ ਕਹਾ ਮੁਨ ਸਰਪ ਦੇਖ ਡਰਾਨ ॥
141.t: aakh ughaar lakhai kahaa mun sarap dhekh ddaraan ||
141.e: What did the sage see on opening his eyes? He was frightened to see the snake (around his neck).

141.g: ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕਰਤ ਭਯੋ ਤਹਾ ਦਿਜ ਰਕਤ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਚੁਚਾਨ ॥
141.t: krodh karat bhayo tahaa dhij rakat netr chuchaan ||
141.e: There he became very angry and the blood oozed out form the eyes of the Brahmin.

141.g: ਜਉਨ ਮੋ ਗਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਗਿਓ ਤਿਹ ਕਾਟਿ ਹੈ ਅਹਿਰਾਇ ॥
141.t: jaun mo gar ddaar gio teh kaaT hai ahirai ||
141.e: (He said:) “He, who hath put this snake around my neck, he will be bitten by the king of snakes

141.g: ਸਪਤ ਦਿਵਸਨ ਮੈ ਮਰੈ ਯਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਸ੍ਰਾਪ ਸਦਾਇ ॥੬॥੧੬੨॥
141.t: sapat dhivasan mai marai yeh sat sraap sadhai ||6||162||
141.e: “He will die within seven days. This curse of mine will ever be rure.”6.162.

141.g: ਸ੍ਰਾਪ ਕੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਡਰਿਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਮੰਦ੍ਰ ਏਕ ਉਸਾਰ ॥
141.t: sraap ko sun kai ddariyo nirap ma(n)dhr ek usaar ||
141.e: Coming to know about the curse, the king was frightened. He got and Abode constructed.

141.g: ਮਧਿ ਗੰਗ ਰਚਿਯੋ ਧਉਲਹਰਿ ਛੁਇ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਬਿਆਰ ॥
141.t: madh ga(n)g rachiyo dhaulahar chhui sakai na biaar ||
141.e: That palace was constructed within the Ganges, which could not even be touched by air

141.g: ਸਰਪ ਕੀ ਤਹ ਗੰਮਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾਟਿ ਹੈ ਤਿਹ ਜਾਇ ॥
141.t: sarap kee teh ga(n)mataa ko kaaT hai teh jai ||
141.e: How could the snake reach there and bite the king?

141.g: ਕਾਲ ਪਾਇ ਕਟ੍ਯੋ ਤਬੈ ਤਹਿ ਆਨ ਕੈ ਅਹਿਰਾਇ ॥੭॥੧੬੩॥
141.t: kaal pai kaTayo tabai teh aan kai ahirai ||7||163||
141.e: But within the due time, the king snakes came there and bit (the king).7.163.

141.g: ਸਾਠ ਬਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਲਉ ਦੁਇ ਮਾਸ ਯੌ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰ ॥
141.t: saaTh barakh pramaan lau dhui maas yau dhin chaar ||
141.e: (The king Parikshat) ruled for sixty years, two months and four days.

141.g: ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਲੀ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਰਾਜ ਕੀ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥
141.t: jot jot bikhai ralee nirap raaj kee karataar ||
141.e: Then the light of the soul of the king Parikshat merged in the light of the Creator.

141.g: ਭੂਮ ਭਰਥ ਭਏ ਤਬੈ ਜਨਮੇਜ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
141.t: bhoom bharath bhe tabai janamej raaj mahaan ||
141.e: Then the great king Janmeja become the Sustainer of the earth.

141.g: ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਹਠੀ ਤਪੀ ਦਸ ਚਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥੮॥੧੬੪॥
141.t: soorabeer haThee tapee dhas chaar chaar nidhaan ||8||164||
141.e: He was a great hero, headstrong, ascetic and adept in eighteen learinings.8.164.

141.g: ਇਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਛਤ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ਭਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਜਨਮੇਜਾ ਰਾਜ ਪਾਵਤ ਭਏ ॥
141.t: eit raajaa preechhat samaapata(n) bhe raajaa janamejaa raaj paavat bhe ||
141.e: The end of the Episode of King Parikshat.The Rule of King Janmeja begins :

141.g: ਰੂਆਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
141.t: rooaal chha(n)dh ||
141.e: ROOAAL STANZA

141.g: ਰਾਜ ਕੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਨਮੇਜ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
141.t: raaj ko gireh pai kai janamej raaj mahaan ||
141.e: Born in the house of a king, the great king Jammeja

141.g: ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਹਠੀ ਤਪੀ ਦਸ ਚਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
141.t: soorabeer haThee tapee dhas chaar chaar nidhaan ||
141.e: Was a great hero, headstrong, ascetic and adept in eighteen learnings.

141.g: ਪਿਤਰ ਕੇ ਬਧ ਕੋਪ ਤੇ ਸਬ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਲੀਨ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
141.t: pitar ke badh kop te sab bipr leen bulai ||
141.e: Being enraged at the death of his father, he called all the Brahmins

141.g: ਸਰਪ ਮੇਧ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਲਗੇ ਮਖ ਧਰਮ ਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਚਾਇ ॥੧॥੧੬੫॥
141.t: sarap medh kariyo lage makh dharam ke chit chai ||1||165||
141.e: And engaged himself in the performance of the snake-sacrifice in the zest of his mind for Dharma.1.165.

141.g: ਏਕ ਕੋਸ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਲਉ ਮਖ ਕੁੰਡ ਕੀਨ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
141.t: ek kos pramaan lau makh ku(n)dd keen banai ||
141.e: The sacrificial pit was constructed within one kos.

141.g: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਕਤ ਕਰਨੈ ਲਗੇ ਤਹਿ ਹੋਮ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
141.t: ma(n)tr sakat karanai lage teh hom bipr banai ||
141.e: After preparing the fire-altar, the Brahmins began to recite mantras methodically.

141.g: ਆਨ ਆਨ ਗਿਰੈ ਲਗੇ ਤਹਿ ਸਰਪ ਕੋਟ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
141.t: aan aan girai lage teh sarap koT apaar ||
141.e: Millions and innumerable serpents came to fall there in the fire.

141.g: ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਉਠੀ ਜੈਤ ਧੁਨ ਭੂਮ ਭੂਰ ਉਦਾਰ ॥੨॥੧੬੬॥
141.t: jatr tatr uThee jait dhun bhoom bhoor udhaar ||2||166||
141.e: Here, there and everywhere resounded the strain of victory of the pious king.2.166.

141.g: ਹਸਤ ਏਕ ਦੂ ਹਸਤ ਤੀਨ ਚਉ ਹਸਤ ਪੰਚ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ॥
141.t: hasat ek dhoo hasat teen chau hasat pa(n)ch pramaan ||
141.e: The snakes measuring one arm’s length, two arms’ length, and there, four and five arms’ length

142.g: ਬੀਸ ਹਾਥ ਇਕੀਸ ਹਾਥ ਪਚੀਸ ਹਾਥ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
142.t: bees haath ikees haath pachees haath samaan ||
142.e: Twenty arms’ length, twenty one arms length and twenty-five length

142.g: ਤੀਸ ਹਾਥ ਬਤੀਸ ਹਾਥ ਛਤੀਸ ਹਾਥ ਗਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
142.t: tees haath batees haath chhatees haath giraeh ||
142.e: Thirty arms’ length, thirty-two arms’ length and thirty-six arms’ length fell

142.g: ਆਨ ਆਨ ਗਿਰੈ ਤਹਾ ਸਭ ਭਸਮ ਭੂਤ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥੧੬੭॥
142.t: aan aan girai tahaa sabh bhasam bhoot hoi jai ||3||167||
142.e: And began to fall there all and reduced to ashes.3.167.

142.g: ਏਕ ਸੌ ਹਸਤ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਦੋ ਸੌ ਹਸਤ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ॥
142.t: ek sau hasat pramaan dho sau hasat pramaan ||
142.e: Those measuring one hindered arms’ length and two hundred arms’ length

142.g: ਤੀਨ ਸੌ ਹਸਤ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਚਤ੍ਰ ਸੈ ਸੁ ਸਮਾਨ ॥
142.t: teen sau hasat pramaan chatr sai su samaan ||
142.e: Three hundred arms’ length and four hundred arms length

142.g: ਪਾਚ ਸੈ ਖਟ ਸੈ ਲਗੇ ਤਹਿ ਬੀਚ ਆਨ ਗਿਰੰਤ ॥
142.t: paach sai khaT sai lage teh beech aan gira(n)t ||
142.e: Five hundred and six hundred arms’ length began to fall there within the fire-pit

142.g: ਸਹੰਸ ਹਸਤ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਲਉ ਸਭ ਹੋਮ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਤ ॥੪॥੧੬੮॥
142.t: saha(n)s hasat pramaan lau sabh hom hot ana(n)t ||4||168||
142.e: Even upto one thousand arms’ length and all innumerable ones were burnt and (thus reduced to ashes).4.168.

142.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
142.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||
142.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

142.g: ਰਚਿਯੋ ਸਰਪ ਮੇਧੰ ਬਡੋ ਜਗ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
142.t: rachiyo sarap medha(n) baddo jag raaja(n) ||
142.e: Sovereign (Jammeja) is performing the serpent-sacrifice.

142.g: ਕਰੈ ਬਿਪ ਹੋਮੈ ਸਰੈ ਸਰਬ ਕਾਜੰ ॥
142.t: karai bip homai sarai sarab kaaja(n) ||
142.e: The Brahmins are busy in performing Home ritual whose merit is setting everything right.

142.g: ਦਹੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਰਪੰ ਅਨੰਤੰ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ॥
142.t: dhahe sarab sarapa(n) ana(n)ta(n) prakaara(n) ||
142.e: Innumerable types of snakes are being burnt in the pit.

142.g: ਭੁਜੈ ਭੋਗ ਅਨੰਤੰ ਜੁਗੈ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰੰ ॥੧॥੧੬੯॥
142.t: bhujai bhog ana(n)ta(n) jugai raaj dhuaara(n) ||1||169||
142.e: Innumerable cobras, drawn by the mantras at the gate of the king. Have been burnt.1.169.

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਅਸਟ ਹਸਤੰ ਸਤੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਇ ਨਾਰੰ ॥
142.t: kite asaT hasata(n) sata(n) prai naara(n) ||
142.e: Many snakes of about eight arms’ length and about seven arms’ length, with necks

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਦੁਆਦਿਸੇ ਹਸਤ ਲੌ ਪਰਮ ਭਾਰੰ ॥
142.t: kite dhuaadhise hasat lau param bhaara(n) ||
142.e: Many weighty serpents of twelve arms’ length

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਕਿਤੇ ਜੋਜਨੇਕੰ ॥
142.t: kite dhavai saha(n)sr kite jojaneka(n) ||
142.e: Many of two thousand arms’ length and many of one Yojana length

142.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਹੋਮ ਕੁੰਡੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਅਚੇਤੰ ॥੨॥੧੭੦॥
142.t: gire hom ku(n)dda(n) apaara(n) acheta(n) ||2||170||
142.e: They all fell in the fire-altar pit unconsciously.2.170.

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਜੋਜਨੇ ਦੁਇ ਕਿਤੇ ਤੀਨ ਜੋਜਨ ॥
142.t: kite jojane dhui kite teen jojan ||
142.e: Many serpents of two Yajana length and many of three Yajanas

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਚਾਰ ਜੋਜਨ ਦਹੇ ਭੂਮ ਭੋਗਨ ॥
142.t: kite chaar jojan dhahe bhoom bhogan ||
142.e: Many of four Yajanas length, all these serpents of the earth were burnt

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਮੁਸਟ ਅੰਗੁਸਟ ਗ੍ਰਿਸਟੰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨੰ ॥
142.t: kite musaT a(n)gusaT girasaTa(n) pramaana(n) ||
142.e: Many of the size of a fist and a thumb and the length of a span

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਡੇਢੁ ਗਿਸਟੇ ਅੰਗੁਸਟੰ ਅਰਧਾਨੰ ॥੩॥੧੭੧॥
142.t: kite ddedd gisaTe a(n)gusaTa(n) aradhaana(n) ||3||171||
142.e: And many of the length of one and a half span and many of the size of half a thumb were burnt.3.171.

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਚਾਰ ਜੋਜਨ ਲਉ ਚਾਰ ਕੋਸੰ ॥
142.t: kite chaar jojan lau chaar kosa(n) ||
142.e: Many serpents from the length of four Yajanas upto four kos,

142.g: ਛੁਐ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰੈ ਅਗਨ ਹੋਮੰ ॥
142.t: chhuaai ghirat jaise karai agan homa(n) ||
142.e: Were burnt in the altar-fire, as though the fire was touching the clarified butter.

142.g: ਫਣੰ ਫਟਕੈ ਫੇਣਕਾ ਫੰਤਕਾਰੰ ॥
142.t: fana(n) faTakai fenakaa fa(n)takaara(n) ||
142.e: While burning, the snakes fluttered their hoods, frothed and hissed.

142.g: ਛੁਟੈ ਲਪਟ ਜ੍ਵਾਲਾ ਬਸੈ ਬਿਖਧਾਰੰ ॥੪॥੧੭੨॥
142.t: chhuTai lapaT javaiaalaa basai bikhadhaara(n) ||4||172||
142.e: When they fell in the fire, the flame flared up.4.172.

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਸਪਤ ਜੋਜਨ ਲੌ ਕੋਸ ਅਸਟੰ ॥
142.t: kite sapat jojan lau kos asaTa(n) ||
142.e: Many serpents from the length of seven upto eight Kos,

142.g: ਕਿਤੇ ਅਸਟ ਜੋਜਨ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਸਟੰ ॥
142.t: kite asaT jojan mahaa param pusaTa(n) ||
142.e: Many of the length of eight Yojanas and very fat

142.g: ਭਯੋ ਘੋਰ ਬਧੰ ਜਰੇ ਕੋਟ ਨਾਗੰ ॥
142.t: bhayo ghor badha(n) jare koT naaga(n) ||
142.e: Millions of snakes were thus burnt and there was great killing.

142.g: ਭਜ੍ਯੋ ਤਛਕੰ ਭਛਕੰ ਜੇਮ ਕਾਗੰ ॥੫॥੧੭੩॥
142.t: bhajayo tachhaka(n) bhachhaka(n) jem kaaga(n) ||5||173||
142.e: Takshak, the king of snakes ran away like the crow from the falcon for fear of being eaten.5.173.

142.g: ਕੁਲੰ ਕੋਟ ਹੋਮੈ ਬਿਖੈ ਵਹਿਣ ਕੁੰਡੰ ॥
142.t: kula(n) koT homai bikhai vahin ku(n)dda(n) ||
142.e: Millions of serpents of his clan were burnt in the fire-altar.

142.g: ਬਚੇ ਬਾਧ ਡਾਰੇ ਘਨੇ ਕੁੰਡ ਝੁੰਡੰ ॥
142.t: bache baadh ddaare ghane ku(n)dd jhu(n)dda(n) ||
142.e: Those who were saved, were bound down and collectively thrown in the fire-pit.

142.g: ਭਜ੍ਯੋ ਨਾਗ ਰਾਜੰ ਤਕ੍ਰਯੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕੰ ॥
142.t: bhajayo naag raaja(n) takrayo i(n)dhr loka(n) ||
142.e: The king of Nagas ran away and took sheleter in the world of Indra.

142.g: ਜਰ੍ਯੋ ਬੈਦ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਭਰ੍ਯੋ ਸਕ੍ਰ ਸੋਕੰ ॥੬॥੧੭੪॥
142.t: jarayo baidh ma(n)tra(n) bharayo sakr soka(n) ||6||174||
142.e: With the power of Vedic mantras, the Abode of Indra also began to broil and with this, Indra was in great agony.6.174.

142.g: ਬਧ੍ਯੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੰ ਗਿਰ੍ਯੋ ਭੂਮ ਮਧੰ ॥
142.t: badhayo ma(n)tr ja(n)tra(n) girayo bhoom madha(n) ||
142.e: Bound by mantras and tantras, (Takshak) ultimately fell on the earth.

142.g: ਅੜਿਓ ਆਸਤੀਕੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਸਿਧੰ ॥
142.t: aRio aasateeka(n) mahaa bipr sidha(n) ||
142.e: At that the great adept Brahmin Aasteek resisted the orders of the king.

142.g: ਭਿੜ੍ਰਯੋ ਭੇੜ ਭੂਪੰ ਝਿਣ੍ਰਯੋ ਝੇੜ ਝਾੜੰ ॥
142.t: bhiRrayo bheR bhoopa(n) jhinrayo jheR jhaaRa(n) ||
142.e: He quarreled with the king and in the strife felt offended

142.g: ਮਹਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਉਠ੍ਯੋ ਤਣੀ ਤੋੜ ਤਾੜੰ ॥੭॥੧੭੫॥
142.t: mahaa krodh uThayo tanee toR taaRa(n) ||7||175||
142.e: And rose in great anger, breaking the strings of his clothes.7.175.

142.g: ਤਜ੍ਯੋ ਸ੍ਰਪ ਮੇਧੰ ਭਜ੍ਯੋ ਏਕ ਨਾਥੰ ॥
142.t: tajayo srap medha(n) bhajayo ek naatha(n) ||
142.e: He asked the king to forsake the serpent-sacrifice and meditate on the One Lord

142.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਸੂਝੈ ਸਬੈ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਸਾਜੰ ॥
142.t: kirapaa ma(n)tr soojhai sabai sirasaT saaja(n) ||
142.e: With whose Grace all the mantras and materials of the world come to our mind.

142.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਸਰਦੂਲ ਬਿਦ੍ਯਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ॥
142.t: sunahu raaj saradhool bidhayaa nidhaana(n) ||
142.e: “O the Lion-like monarch and the treasure of learning!

142.g: ਤਪੈ ਤੇਜ ਸਾਵੰਤ ਜੁਆਲਾ ਸਮਾਨੰ ॥੮॥੧੭੬॥
142.t: tapai tej saava(n)t juaalaa samaana(n) ||8||176||
142.e: “Thy Glory will shine like sun and blaze like fire.8.176.

142.g: ਮਹੀ ਮਾਹ ਰੂਪੰ ਤਪੈ ਤੇਜ ਭਾਨੰ ॥
142.t: mahee maeh roopa(n) tapai tej bhaana(n) ||
142.e: “Thy beauty on the earth shall be moonlike and thy splendour sunlike

142.g: ਦਸੰ ਚਾਰ ਚਉਦਾਹ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ॥
142.t: dhasa(n) chaar chaudhaeh bidhiaa nidhaana(n) ||
142.e: “Thou shall be treasure of fourteen learnings.

142.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰਗ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਪਾਨੰ ॥
142.t: sunahu raaj saasatrag saara(n)g paana(n) ||
142.e: “Listen, O wielder of the bow and the monarch with knowledge of the Shastras!

142.g: ਤਜਹੁ ਸਰਪ ਮੇਧੰ ਦਿਜੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਦਾਨੰ ॥੯॥੧੭੭॥
142.t: tajahu sarap medha(n) dhijai moh dhaana(n) ||9||177||
142.e: “Bestow on me this gifts of abandoning the serpents-sacrifice.9.177.

142.g: ਤਜਹੁ ਜੋ ਨ ਸਰਪੰ ਜਰੋ ਅਗਨ ਆਪੰ ॥
142.t: tajahu jo na sarapa(n) jaro agan aapa(n) ||
142.e: “If thou dost not abandon this gift of abandoning the serpent-sacrifice, I shall burn myself in the fire

142.g: ਕਰੋ ਦਗਧ ਤੋ ਕੌ ਦਿਵੌ ਐਸ ਸ੍ਰਾਪੰ ॥
142.t: karo dhagadh to kau dhivau aais sraapa(n) ||
142.e: “Or by giving such curse I shall reduce thee to ashes

142.g: ਹਣ੍ਯੋ ਪੇਟ ਮਧੰ ਛੁਰੀ ਜਮਦਾੜੰ ॥
142.t: hanayo peT madha(n) chhuree jamadhaaRa(n) ||
142.e: “Or I shall pierce my belly with the sharp dagger

142.g: ਲਗੇ ਪਾਪ ਤੋ ਕੋ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਗਾੜੰ ॥੧੦॥੧੭੮॥
142.t: lage paap to ko sunahu raaj gaaRa(n) ||10||178||
142.e: “Listen! O king! thou shalt be causing a great sin for thyself of Brahmin-killing.”10.178.

143.g: ਸੁਨੇ ਬਿਪ ਬੋਲੰ ਉਠਿਯੋ ਆਪ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
143.t: sune bip bola(n) uThiyo aap raaja(n) ||
143.e: Hearing these words of the Brahmin, the king stood up.

143.g: ਤਜਿਯੋ ਸਰਪ ਮੇਧੰ ਪਿਤਾ ਬੈਰ ਕਾਜੰ ॥
143.t: tajiyo sarap medha(n) pitaa bair kaaja(n) ||
143.e: He abandoned the serpent-sacrifice and enmity for the death of his father.

143.g: ਬੁਲ੍ਯੋ ਬ੍ਯਾਸ ਪਾਸੰ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਚਾਰੰ ॥
143.t: bulayo bayaas paasa(n) kariyo ma(n)tr chaara(n) ||
143.e: He called Vyas near him and began consultations.

143.g: ਮਹਾ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਆਕਰਣ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥੧੧॥੧੭੯॥
143.t: mahaa bedh biaakaran bidhiaa bichaara(n) ||11||179||
143.e: Vyas was the great scholar of Vedas and the learning of Grammar.11.179.

143.g: ਸੁਨੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਕਾ ਦੁਇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੰ ਕਾਸਿ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
143.t: sunee putrakaa dhui giraha(n) kaas raaja(n) ||
143.e: The king had heard that she king of Kashi had two daughter

143.g: ਮਹਾ ਸੁੰਦਰੀ ਰੂਪ ਸੋਭਾ ਸਮਾਜੰ ॥
143.t: mahaa su(n)dharee roop sobhaa samaaja(n) ||
143.e: Who were most beautiful and splendour of society.

143.g: ਜਿਣਿਉ ਜਾਇ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਹਣੋ ਦੁਸਟ ਪੁਸਟੰ ॥
143.t: jiniau jai taa ko hano dhusaT pusaTa(n) ||
143.e: He wanted to go there in order to conquer them after killing the mighty tyrant.

143.g: ਕਰਿਯੋ ਧਿਆਨ ਤਾਨੇ ਲਦੇ ਭਾਰ ਉਸਟੰ ॥੧੨॥੧੮੦॥
143.t: kariyo dhiaan taane ladhe bhaar usaTa(n) ||12||180||
143.e: He then left (for that city) with loaded camel.12.180.

143.g: ਚਲੀ ਸੈਨ ਸੂਕਰ ਪਰਾਚੀ ਦਿਸਾਨੰ ॥
143.t: chalee sain sookar paraachee dhisaana(n) ||
143.e: The army moved towards the east like swift wind.

143.g: ਚੜੇ ਬੀਰ ਧੀਰੰ ਹਠੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਨੰ ॥
143.t: chaRe beer dheera(n) haThe sasatr paana(n) ||
143.e: With many heroes, enduring the resolute and weapon-wielders,

143.g: ਦੁਰਿਯੋ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਰਗ ਸੁ ਬਾਰਾਣਸੀਸੰ ॥
143.t: dhuriyo jai dhurag su baaraanaseesa(n) ||
143.e: The king of Kashi concealed himself in his ciadel,

143.g: ਘੇਰ੍ਯੋ ਜਾਇ ਫਉਜੰ ਭਜਿਓ ਏਕ ਈਸੰ ॥੧੩॥੧੮੧॥
143.t: gherayo jai fauja(n) bhajio ek ieesa(n) ||13||181||
143.e: Which was besieged by the army of Janmeja  he meditated only on Shiva.13.181.

143.g: ਮਚਿਯੋ ਜੁਧ ਸੁਧੰ ਬਹੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਘਾਤੰ ॥
143.t: machiyo judh sudha(n) bahe sasatr ghaata(n) ||
143.e: The war began in full swing, there were many slayings with weapons

143.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਅਧੁ ਵਧੰ ਸਨਧੰ ਬਿਪਾਤੰ ॥
143.t: gire adh vadha(n) sanadha(n) bipaata(n) ||
143.e: And the heroes, cut into bits, fell in the field.

143.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰੰ ਸੁ ਬੀਰੰ ਰਜਾਣੰ ॥
143.t: gire heer cheera(n) su beera(n) rajaana(n) ||
143.e: The warriors experienced bloodbath and fell with their clothes filled with blood.

143.g: ਕਟੈ ਅਧੁ ਅਧੰ ਛੁਟੇ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਧ੍ਯਾਨੰ ॥੧੪॥੧੮੨॥
143.t: kaTai adh adha(n) chhuTe rudhr dhayaana(n) ||14||182||
143.e: They were chopped into halves  the contemplation of Shva was interrupted.14.182.

143.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਖੇਤ੍ਰ ਖਤ੍ਰਾਣ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਖਤ੍ਰਾਣੰ ॥
143.t: gire khetr khatraan khatree khatraana(n) ||
143.e: Many Kshatriyas of reputation fell in the battlefield.

143.g: ਬਜੀ ਭੇਰ ਭੁੰਕਾਰ ਦ੍ਰੁਕਿਆ ਨਿਸਾਣੰ ॥
143.t: bajee bher bhu(n)kaar dhrukiaa nisaana(n) ||
143.e: The dreadful sound of kettledrums and trumpets resounded.

143.g: ਕਰੇ ਪੈਜਵਾਰੰ ਪ੍ਰਚਾਰੈ ਸੁ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
143.t: kare paijavaara(n) prachaarai su beera(n) ||
143.e: The heroic warriors were shouting and making pledges, and also striking blows.

143.g: ਫਿਰੇ ਰੁੰਡ ਮੁੰਡੰ ਤਣੰ ਤਛ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੧੫॥੧੮੩॥
143.t: fire ru(n)dd mu(n)dda(n) tana(n) tachh teera(n) ||15||183||
143.e: The trunks and heads, and bodies pierced by arrows were roaming.15.183.

143.g: ਬਿਭੇ ਦੰਤ ਵਰਮੰ ਪ੍ਰਛੇਦੈ ਤਨਾਨੰ ॥
143.t: bibhe dha(n)t varama(n) prachhedhai tanaana(n) ||
143.e: The shafts were penetrating into the steel-armour

143.g: ਕਰੇ ਮਰਦਨੰ ਅਰਦਨੰ ਮਰਦਮਾਨੰ ॥
143.t: kare maradhana(n) aradhana(n) maradhamaana(n) ||
143.e: And the heroic warriors were destroying the pride of others.

143.g: ਕਟੇ ਚਰਮ ਬਰਮੰ ਛੁਟੇ ਚਉਰ ਚਾਰੰ ॥
143.t: kaTe charam barama(n) chhuTe chaur chaara(n) ||
143.e: The bodies and armour were being cut and the flywhicks were being trampled

143.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਬੀਰ ਧੀਰੰ ਛੁਟੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੰ ॥੧੬॥੧੮੪॥
143.t: gire beer dheera(n) chhuTe sasatr dhaara(n) ||16||184||
143.e: And with the blows of weapons, the bold warriors were falling.16.184.

143.g: ਜਿਣ੍ਰਯੋ ਕਾਸਕੀਸੰ ਹਣ੍ਯੋ ਸਰਬ ਸੈਨੰ ॥
143.t: jinrayo kaasakeesa(n) hanayo sarab saina(n) ||
143.e: The king of Kashi was conquered and all his forces were destroyed.

143.g: ਬਰੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਕਾ ਤਾਹ ਕੰਪ੍ਯੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਨੈਨੰ ॥
143.t: baree putrakaa taeh ka(n)payo tiranaina(n) ||
143.e: Both his daughters were wedded by Janmeja, seeing which Shiva, the three-eyed god, trembled.

143.g: ਭਇਓ ਮੇਲ ਗੇਲੰ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
143.t: bhio mel gela(n) mile raaj raaja(n) ||
143.e: Both the kings then became friendly  the conquered kingdom was returned,

143.g: ਭਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਾਰੰ ਸਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਕਾਜੰ ॥੧੭॥੧੮੫॥
143.t: bhiee mitr chaara(n) sare sarab kaaja(n) ||17||185||
143.e: Friendship developed between both the kings and all their works were settled appropriately.17.185.

143.g: ਮਿਲੀ ਰਾਜ ਦਾਜੰ ਸੁ ਦਾਸੀ ਅਨੂਪੰ ॥
143.t: milee raaj dhaaja(n) su dhaasee anoopa(n) ||
143.e: The King janmeja received a unique maid-servant in his dowry,

143.g: ਮਹਾ ਬਿੱਦ੍ਯਵੰਤੀ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਸਰੂਪੰ ॥
143.t: mahaa bi'dhayava(n)tee apaara(n) saroopa(n) ||
143.e: Who was very learned and supremely beautiful.

143.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰੰ ਕਿਤੇ ਸਿਆਉ ਕਰਨੰ ॥
143.t: mile heer cheera(n) kite siaau karana(n) ||
143.e: He also received diamonds, garments and horses of black ears

143.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਮਤ ਦੰਤੀ ਕਿਤੇ ਸੇਤ ਬਰਨੰ ॥੧੮॥੧੮੬॥
143.t: mile mat dha(n)tee kite set barana(n) ||18||186||
143.e: He also got many wanton white-coloured elephants with tusks.18.186.

143.g: ਕਰ੍ਯੋ ਬ੍ਯਾਹ ਰਾਜਾ ਭਇਓ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨੰ ॥
143.t: karayo bayaeh raajaa bhio su prasa(n)na(n) ||
143.e: On his marriage, the king became very happy.

143.g: ਭਲੀ ਭਾਤ ਪੋਖੇ ਦਿਜੰ ਸਰਬ ਅੰਨੰ ॥
143.t: bhalee bhaat pokhe dhija(n) sarab a(n)na(n) ||
143.e: All the Brahmin were satisfied with the grant of all types of corn.

143.g: ਕਰੇ ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤੰ ਮਹਾ ਗਜ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
143.t: kare bhaat bhaata(n) mahaa gaj dhaana(n) ||
143.e: The king gave in charity various of elephants.

143.g: ਭਏ ਦੋਇ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੰ ਮਹਾ ਰੂਪ ਮਾਨੰ ॥੧੯॥੧੮੭॥
143.t: bhe dhoi putra(n) mahaa roop maana(n) ||19||187||
143.e: From both his wives, two very beautiful sons were born.19.187.

143.g: ਲਖੀ ਰੂਪਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਾਰਾਜ ਦਾਸੀ ॥
143.t: lakhee roopava(n)tee mahaaraaj dhaasee ||
143.e: (One day) the king saw the winsome maid-servant.

143.g: ਮਨੋ ਚੀਰ ਕੈ ਚਾਰ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਨਿਕਾਸੀ ॥
143.t: mano cheer kai chaar cha(n)dhraa nikaasee ||
143.e: He felt as if the moonlight hath penetrated out of the moon.

143.g: ਲਹੈ ਚੰਚਲਾ ਚਾਰ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਲਤਾ ਸੀ ॥
143.t: lahai cha(n)chalaa chaar bidhiaa lataa see ||
143.e: He considered her as beautiful lightning and as creeper of learning

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਕੰਜਕੀ ਮਾਝ ਸੋਭਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ ॥੨੦॥੧੮੮॥
143.t: kidhau ka(n)jakee maajh sobhaa prakaasee ||20||188||
143.e: Or the inner glory of the lotus hath manifested itself.20.188.

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਫੂਲ ਮਾਲਾ ਲਖੈ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਸੀ ॥
143.t: kidhau fool maalaa lakhai cha(n)dhramaa see ||
143.e: It seemd as if she was a garland of flowers or the moon itself

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਪਦਮਨੀ ਮੈ ਬਨੀ ਮਾਲਤੀ ਸੀ ॥
143.t: kidhau padhamanee mai banee maalatee see ||
143.e: It may be the flower of Malti or it may be Padmini,

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਪੁਹਪ ਧੰਨਿਆ ਫੁਲੀ ਰਾਇਬੇਲੰ ॥
143.t: kidhau puhap dha(n)niaa fulee raibela(n) ||
143.e: Or it may be Rati (the wife of god of love) or it may be the superb creeper of flowers.

143.g: ਤਜੈ ਅੰਗ ਤੇ ਬਾਸੁ ਚੰਪਾ ਫੁਲੇਲੰ ॥੨੧॥੧੮੯॥
143.t: tajai a(n)g te baas cha(n)paa fulela(n) ||21||189||
143.e: The fragrance of the flowers of champa (Michelia champacca) was emanating from her limbs.21.189.

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਦੇਵ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਥੀ ਲੋਕ ਡੋਲੈ ॥
143.t: kidhau dhev ka(n)niaa pirathee lok ddolai ||
143.e: It seemed as if a heavenly damsel was roaming on the earth,

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਜਛਨੀ ਕਿਨ੍ਰਨੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਲੋਲੈ ॥
143.t: kidhau jachhanee kinranee siau kalolai ||
143.e: Or a Yaksha or Kinnar woman was busy in her frolics,

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਬੀਜੰ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਧਿ ਬਾਲੰ ॥
143.t: kidhau rudhr beeja(n) firai madh baala(n) ||
143.e: Or the semen of god Shiva had strayed in the form of young damsel,

143.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਨੰ ਨਚੈ ਕਉਲ ਨਾਲੰ ॥੨੨॥੧੯੦॥
143.t: kidhau patr paana(n) nachai kaul naala(n) ||22||190||
143.e: Or the drops of water were dancing on the lotus leaf.22.190.

144.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਰਾਗਮਾਲਾ ਰਚੀ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
144.t: kidhau raagamaalaa rachee ra(n)g roopa(n) ||
144.e: It seemed as if a wreath of musical modes was presenting itself in colour and form

144.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਇਸਤ੍ਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਚੀ ਭੂਪ ਭੂਪੰ ॥
144.t: kidhau isatr raajaa rachee bhoop bhoopa(n) ||
144.e: Or the Lord, king of kings, had created her as the Sovereign of beautiful women

144.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਨਾਗ ਕੰਨਿਆ ਕਿਧੌ ਬਾਸਵੀ ਹੈ ॥
144.t: kidhau naag ka(n)niaa kidhau baasavee hai ||
144.e: Or she was the daughter of a Naga or Basve, the wife of Sheshanaga

144.g: ਕਿਧੌ ਸੰਖਨੀ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਨੀ ਪਦਮਨੀ ਹੈ ॥੨੩॥੧੯੧॥
144.t: kidhau sa(n)khanee chitranee padhamanee hai ||23||191||
144.e: Or she was the charming replica of Sankhani, Chitrani or Padmini (9 types of women).23.191.

144.g: ਲਸੈ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਰੂਪੰ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
144.t: lasai chitr roopa(n) bachitra(n) apaara(n) ||
144.e: Her wonderful and infinite beauty glistened like a painting.

144.g: ਮਹਾ ਰੂਪਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਾ ਜੋਬਨਾਰੰ ॥
144.t: mahaa roopava(n)tee mahaa jobanaara(n) ||
144.e: She was most elegant and most youthful.

144.g: ਮਹਾ ਗਿਆਨਵੰਤੀ ਸੁ ਬਿਗਿਆਨ ਕਰਮੰ ॥
144.t: mahaa giaanava(n)tee su bigiaan karama(n) ||
144.e: She was most knowledgeable and adept in scientific works.

144.g: ਪੜੇ ਕੰਠਿ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਸੁ ਬਿਦਿਆਦਿ ਧਰਮੰ ॥੨੪॥੧੯੨॥
144.t: paRe ka(n)Th bidhiaa su bidhiaadh dharama(n) ||24||192||
144.e: She had all learning at her finger ends and was thus an adept in the discipline.24.192.

144.g: ਲਖੀ ਰਾਜ ਕੰਨਿਆਨ ਤੇ ਰੂਪਵੰਤੀ ॥
144.t: lakhee raaj ka(n)niaan te roopava(n)tee ||
144.e: The king considered her more winsome than the light of fire.

144.g: ਲਸੈ ਜੋਤ ਜ੍ਵਾਲਾ ਅਪਾਰੰ ਅਨੰਤੀ ॥
144.t: lasai jot javaiaalaa apaara(n) ana(n)tee ||
144.e: The light of her face shone enormously than the light of fire.

144.g: ਲਖ੍ਯੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਨਮੇਜਏ ਆਪ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
144.t: lakhayo taeh janameje aap raaja(n) ||
144.e: The king Janmeja himself considered her like this,

144.g: ਕਰੇ ਪਰਮ ਭੋਗੰ ਦੀਏ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਜੰ ॥੨੫॥੧੯੩॥
144.t: kare param bhoga(n) dhe'ee sarab saaja(n) ||25||193||
144.e: Therefore he ardently copulated with her and gave her all the royal paraphernalia.25.193.

144.g: ਬਢਿਓ ਨੇਹੁ ਤਾ ਸੋ ਤਜੀ ਰਾਜ ਕੰਨਿਆ ॥
144.t: baddio neh taa so tajee raaj ka(n)niaa ||
144.e: The king was greatly in love with her  he abandoned the king’s daughters (queens)

144.g: ਹੁਤੀ ਸਿਸਟ ਕੀ ਦਿਸਟ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਸਟ ਧੰਨਿਆ ॥
144.t: hutee sisaT kee dhisaT meh pusaT dha(n)niaa ||
144.e: Who were considered eminent and fortunate in the sight of the world.

144.g: ਭਇਓ ਏਕ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੰ ਮਹਾ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
144.t: bhio ek putra(n) mahaa sasatr dhaaree ||
144.e: A son, a great weapon-wielder was born to him

144.g: ਦਸੰ ਚਾਰ ਚਉਦਾਹ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੬॥੧੯੪॥
144.t: dhasa(n) chaar chaudhaeh bidhiaa bichaaree ||26||194||
144.e: He became adept in fourteen learnings.26.194.

144.g: ਧਰਿਓ ਅਸਮੇਧੰ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
144.t: dhario asamedha(n) piratham putr naama(n) ||
144.e: The king named his first son as ASMEDH,

144.g: ਭਇਓ ਅਸਮੇਧਾਨ ਦੂਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੰ ॥
144.t: bhio asamedhaan dhoojo pradhaana(n) ||
144.e: And named his second son as ASMEDHAN.

144.g: ਅਜੈ ਸਿੰਘ ਰਾਖ੍ਯੋ ਰਜੀ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸੂਰੰ ॥
144.t: ajai si(n)gh raakhayo rajee putr soora(n) ||
144.e: The maid-servant’s son was named AJAI SINGH,

144.g: ਮਹਾ ਜੰਗ ਜੋਧਾ ਮਹਾ ਜਸ ਪੂਰੰ ॥੨੭॥੧੯੫॥
144.t: mahaa ja(n)g jodhaa mahaa jas poora(n) ||27||195||
144.e: Who was a great hero, a great warrior and greatly renowned.27.195.

144.g: ਭਇਓ ਤਨ ਦੁਰੁਸਤੰ ਬਲਿਸਟੰ ਮਹਾਨੰ ॥
144.t: bhio tan dhurusata(n) balisaTa(n) mahaana(n) ||
144.e: He was a person of healthy body and great strength.

144.g: ਮਹਾਜੰਗ ਜੋਧਾ ਸੁ ਸਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੰ ॥
144.t: mahaaja(n)g jodhaa su sasatra(n) pradhaana(n) ||
144.e: He was a great warrior in the battlefield and adept in warfare.

144.g: ਹਣੈ ਦੁਸਟ ਪੁਸਟੰ ਮਹਾ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੰ ॥
144.t: hanai dhusaT pusaTa(n) mahaa sasatr dhaara(n) ||
144.e: He killed prominent tyrants with his sharp-edged weapons.

144.g: ਬਡੇ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਜੀਤੇ ਜਿਵੇ ਰਾਵਣਾਰੰ ॥੨੮॥੧੯੬॥
144.t: badde satr jeete jive raavanaara(n) ||28||196||
144.e: He conquered many enemies like Lord Rama, the killer of Ranana.28.196.

144.g: ਚੜਿਓ ਏਕ ਦਿਵਸੰ ਅਖੇਟੰ ਨਰੇਸੰ ॥
144.t: chaRio ek dhivasa(n) akheTa(n) naresa(n) ||
144.e: One day the King Janmeja went hunting.

144.g: ਲਖੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਧਾਯੋ ਗਯੋ ਅਉਰ ਦੇਸੰ ॥
144.t: lakhe mirag dhaayo gayo aaur dhesa(n) ||
144.e: Seeing a deer, he pursued him and went to another country.

144.g: ਸ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਪਰਮ ਬਾਟੰ ਤਕਿਯੋ ਏਕ ਤਾਲੰ ॥
144.t: sramio param baaTa(n) takiyo ek taala(n) ||
144.e: After the long and arduous journey, the king was tired  when he saw a tank,

144.g: ਤਹਾ ਦਉਰ ਕੈ ਪੀਨ ਪਾਨੰ ਉਤਾਲੰ ॥੨੯॥੧੯੭॥
144.t: tahaa dhaur kai peen paana(n) utaala(n) ||29||197||
144.e: He ran there quickly to drink water.29.197.

144.g: ਕਰਿਓ ਰਾਜ ਸੈਨੰ ਕਢਿਓ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਜੰ ॥
144.t: kario raaj saina(n) kaddio baar baaja(n) ||
144.e: Then the king went to sleep. (the destiny) caused a horse to come out of water.

144.g: ਤਕੀ ਬਾਜਨੀ ਰੂਪ ਰਾਜੰ ਸਮਾਜੰ ॥
144.t: takee baajanee roop raaja(n) samaaja(n) ||
144.e: He saw the beautiful royal mare.

144.g: ਲਗ੍ਯੋ ਆਨ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਰਹ੍ਯੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਗਰਭੰ ॥
144.t: lagayo aan taa ko rahayo taeh garabha(n) ||
144.e: He copulated with her and made her pregnant.

144.g: ਭਇਓ ਸਿਯਾਮ ਕਰਣੰ ਸੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਅਦਰਬੰ ॥੩੦॥੧੯੮॥
144.t: bhio siyaam karana(n) su baajee adharaba(n) ||30||198||
144.e: From her an invaluable horse of black ears was born.30.198.

144.g: ਕਰਿਯੋ ਬਾਜ ਮੇਧੰ ਬਡੋ ਜਗ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
144.t: kariyo baaj medha(n) baddo jag raajaa ||
144.e: The king Janmeja began his great horse-sacrifice.

144.g: ਜਿਣੇ ਸਰਬ ਭੂਪੰ ਸਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
144.t: jine sarab bhoopa(n) sare sarab kaajaa ||
144.e: He conquered all the kings and all his errands were set right.

144.g: ਗਡ੍ਰਯੋ ਜਗ ਥੰਭੰ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਹੋਮ ਕੁੰਡੰ ॥
