163.t: paree tachh muchha(n) sabhai a(n)g bha(n)ga(n) ||

163.g: ਮਨੋ ਪਾਨ ਕੈ ਭੰਗ ਪੌਢੇ ਮਲੰਗੰ ॥੧੮॥
163.t: mano paan kai bha(n)g pauadde mala(n)ga(n) ||18||
163.e: The brave fighters, being chopped into bits, began to fall and it appeared that the wrestlers are lying intoxicated after drinking hemp.18.

163.g: ਦਿਸਾ ਮਉ ਨ ਆਈ ਅਨੀ ਦੈਤ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
163.t: dhisaa mau na aaiee anee dhait raaja(n) ||

163.g: ਭਜੈ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਵੰ ਤਜੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਜੰ ॥
163.t: bhajai sarab dheva(n) taje sarab saaja(n) ||
163.e: More forces of demons came from another direction, seeing which the gods, leaving all their paraphernalia, ran away.

163.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਸੰਜ ਪੁੰਜ ਸਿਰੰ ਬਾਹੁ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
163.t: gire sa(n)j pu(n)j sira(n) baahu beera(n) ||

163.g: ਸੁਭੈ ਬਾਨ ਜਿਉ ਚੇਤਿ ਪੁਹਪੰ ਕਰੀਰੰ ॥੧੯॥
163.t: subhai baan jiau chet puhapa(n) kareera(n) ||19||
163.e: The limbs began to fall in great numbers and the arrows looked auspicious in the manner of the flowers of capparis in the month of the Chaitra.19.

164.g: ਜਬੈ ਜੰਗ ਹਾਰਿਯੋ ਕੀਯੋ ਬਿਸਨ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੰ ॥
164.t: jabai ja(n)g haariyo keeyo bisan ma(n)tra(n) ||

164.g: ਭਯੋ ਅੰਤ੍ਰਧ੍ਯਾਨੰ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਜਾਨੁ ਤੰਤੰ ॥
164.t: bhayo a(n)tradhayaana(n) kariyo jaan ta(n)ta(n) ||
164.e: The gods were defeated in the war and Vishnu, thinking over it disappeared, with the help of Tantric science.

164.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਰੂਪ ਧਾਰਿਯੋ ਅਨੂਪੰ ॥
164.t: mahaa mohanee roop dhaariyo anoopa(n) ||

164.g: ਛਕੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੋਊ ਦਿਤਿਯਾਦਿਤਿ ਭੂਪੰ ॥੨੦॥
164.t: chhake dhekh dhouoo dhitiyaadhit bhoopa(n) ||20||
164.e: Then he manifested himself in the unique form of Maha-Mohini, seeing whom, the chief of the demons and gods were highly pleased.20.

164.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਨਰ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਚਤੁਰਥ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੰ ॥੪॥
164.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the nar naarain avataar chaturath sa(n)poorana(n) ||4||
164.e: End of the description of the third incarnation of NAR and the fourth incarnation of NARAYAN in BACHITTAR NATAK.3.4.

164.g: ਅਥ ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
164.t: ath mahaa mohanee avataar kathana(n) ||
164.e: Now begins the description of Maha Mohini Incarnation:

164.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਜੀ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
164.t: sree bhagautee jee sahai ||
164.e: Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.

164.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
164.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||
164.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

164.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਰੂਪ ਧਾਰਿਯੋ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
164.t: mahaa mohanee roop dhaariyo apaara(n) ||
164.e: Vishnu transformed himself into form of Maha Mohini

164.g: ਰਹੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੈ ਦਿਤਿ ਆਦਿਤਿਯਾ ਕੁਮਾਰੰ ॥
164.t: rahe moh kai dhit aadhitiyaa kumaara(n) ||
164.e: Seeing which both and the demons were allured.

164.g: ਛਕੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਜੋਗੰ ਰਹੇ ਰੀਝ ਸਰਬੰ ॥
164.t: chhake prem joga(n) rahe reejh saraba(n) ||
164.e: All of them wanted to please her and thought of sharing her love

164.g: ਤਜੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਦੀਯੋ ਛੋਰ ਗਰਬੰ ॥੧॥
164.t: tajai sasatr asatra(n) dheeyo chhor garaba(n) ||1||
164.e: And all abandoned their weapons and also their prride.1.

164.g: ਫੰਧੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਫਾਧੰ ਭਯੋ ਕੋਪ ਹੀਣੰ ॥
164.t: fa(n)dhe prem faadha(n) bhayo kop heena(n) ||
164.e: All of them, having been entrapped in her noose of love, forsook their anger,

164.g: ਲਗੈ ਨੈਨ ਬੈਨੰ ਧਯੋ ਪਾਨਿ ਪੀਣੰ ॥
164.t: lagai nain baina(n) dhayo paan peena(n) ||
164.e: And rushed towards her in order to relish the wantonness of her eyes and the sweetness of her words

164.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਝੂੰਮਿ ਭੂਮੰ ਛੁਟੇ ਜਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੰ ॥
164.t: gire jhoo(n)m bhooma(n) chhuTe jaan praana(n) ||
164.e: All of them, while swinging, fell on the earth as though they were lifeless

164.g: ਸਭੈ ਚੇਤ ਹੀਣੰ ਲਗੇ ਜਾਨ ਬਾਣੰ ॥੨॥
164.t: sabhai chet heena(n) lage jaan baana(n) ||2||
164.e: All become without consciousness as though they were hit by the arrows.2.

164.g: ਲਖੇ ਚੇਤਹੀਣੰ ਭਏ ਸੂਰ ਸਰਬੰ ॥
164.t: lakhe chetaheena(n) bhe soor saraba(n) ||

164.g: ਛੁਟੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਸਭੈ ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬੰ ॥
164.t: chhuTe sasatr asatra(n) sabhai arab kharaba(n) ||
164.e: Seeing all of the without consciousness, the weapons and arms were discharged by the gods

164.g: ਭਯੋ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਜੋਗੰ ਲਗੇ ਨੈਨ ਐਸੇ ॥
164.t: bhayo prem joga(n) lage nain aaise ||
164.e: The demons began to die and felt that they were considered worthy of love for Mohini.

164.g: ਮਨੋ ਫਾਧਿ ਫਾਧੇ ਮ੍ਰਿਗੀਰਾਜ ਜੈਸੇ ॥੩॥
164.t: mano faadh faadhe mirageeraaj jaise ||3||
164.e: They appeared like the lion entrapped in a snare.3.

164.g: ਜਿਨੈ ਰਤਨ ਬਾਟੇ ਤੁਮਊ ਤਾਹਿ ਜਾਨੋ ॥
164.t: jinai ratan baaTe tumuoo taeh jaano ||

164.g: ਕਥਾ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਤੇ ਬਾਤ ਥੋਰੀ ਬਖਾਨੋ ॥
164.t: kathaa biradh te baat thoree bakhaano ||
164.e: You know the story of thee distribution of the jewels

164.g: ਸਬੈ ਪਾਤਿ ਪਾਤੰ ਬਹਿਠੈ ਸੁ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
164.t: sabai paat paata(n) bahiThai su beera(n) ||
164.e: Therefore for fear of the increase in narration, I relate it only in brief

164.g: ਕਟੰ ਪੇਚ ਛੋਰੇ ਤਜੇ ਤੇਗ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੪॥
164.t: kaTa(n) pech chhore taje teg teera(n) ||4||
164.e: All the warriors, loosening the waist-garments and forsaking the sword, sat in a line.4.

164.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
164.t: chauapiee ||
164.e: CHAUPAI

164.g: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਕੋ ਜੁ ਧਨੰਤਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
164.t: sabh jag ko ju dhana(n)tar dheeaa ||

164.g: ਕਲਪ ਬ੍ਰਿਛੁ ਲਛਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਆ ॥
164.t: kalap birachh lachhamee kar leeaa ||
164.e: Dhanwantri was given for the world and the wish-fulfilling tree and Lakshmi were given to gods.

164.g: ਸਿਵ ਮਾਹੁਰ ਰੰਭਾ ਸਭ ਲੋਕਨ ॥
164.t: siv maahur ra(n)bhaa sabh lokan ||
164.e: Shiva was given the poison and Rambha, the heavenly damsel, was given to al other people

164.g: ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤਾ ਹਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਸੋਕਨ ॥੫॥
164.t: sukh karataa harataa sabh sokan ||5||
164.e: She was the giver of all comforts and the destroyer of sufferings.5.

164.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
164.t: dhoharaa ||
164.e: DOHRA

164.g: ਸਸਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ ਕੇ ਕਰਬੇ ਨਮਿਤ ਮਨਿ ਲਛਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨ ॥
164.t: sas kiras ke karabe namit man lachhamee kar leen ||
164.e: Maha Mohini took the moon in his own hand for giving it to someone and also the gem and Laksmi for keeping it with herself

164.g: ਉਰਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਤਿਹ ਤੇ ਚਮਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦੀਨ ॥੬॥
164.t: aur raakhee teh te chamak pragaT dhikhaiee dheen ||6||
164.e: She concealed the gem and Lakshmi for keeping it with herself

164.g: ਗਾਇ ਰਿਖੀਸਨ ਕਉ ਦਈ ਕਹ ਲਉ ਕਰੋ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
164.t: gai rikheesan kau dhiee keh lau karo bichaar ||
164.e: The wish-fulfilling cow was given to the sages  how far can I describe all these things

164.g: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਧ ਕਬੀਅਨ ਮੁਖਨ ਲੀਜਹੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਸੁਧਾਰ ॥੭॥
164.t: saasatr sodh kabeean mukhan leejahu poochh sudhaar ||7||
164.e: You may improve (their description) by reflecting on the Shastras and asking the poets.7.

164.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
164.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||
164.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

164.g: ਰਹੇ ਰੀਝ ਐਸੇ ਸਬੈ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
164.t: rahe reejh aaise sabai dhev dhaana(n) ||

164.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗੀ ਰਾਜ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੁਨੇ ਨਾਦ ਕਾਨੰ ॥
164.t: miragee raaj jaise sune naadh kaana(n) ||
164.e: Both the gods and demons were swinging like the king of deer, who gets absorbed in the sound of music.

164.g: ਬਟੇ ਰਤਨ ਸਰਬੰ ਗਈ ਛੂਟ ਰਾਰੰ ॥
164.t: baTe ratan saraba(n) giee chhooT raara(n) ||

164.g: ਧਰਿਯੋ ਐਸ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਪੰਚਮ ਵਤਾਰੰ ॥੮॥
164.t: dhariyo aais sree bisan pa(n)cham vataara(n) ||8||
164.e: All the jewels were distributed and the dispute ended  in this way, the fifth incarnation of the Vishnu became apparent.8.

164.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਮਹਾਮੋਹਨੀ ਪੰਚਮੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੫॥
164.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake gra(n)the mahaamohanee pa(n)chamo avataar samaapatam sat subham sat ||5||
164.e: End of the description of the fifth incarnation MAHA MOHNI in BACHITTAR NATAK.5.

164.g: ਅਥ ਬੈਰਾਹ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
164.t: ath bairaeh avataar kathana(n) ||
164.e: Now begins the description of the Boar Incarnation:

164.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
164.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||
164.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

164.g: ਦਯੋ ਬਾਟ ਮਦਿਯੰ ਅਮਦਿਯੰ ਭਗਵਾਨੰ ॥
164.t: dhayo baaT madhiya(n) amadhiya(n) bhagavaana(n) ||

164.g: ਗਏ ਠਾਮ ਠਾਮੰ ਸਬੈ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
164.t: ge Thaam Thaama(n) sabai dhev dhaana(n) ||
164.e: In this way, the god Vishnu distributed the honey and ambrosia  and all gods and demons went away to their places.

164.g: ਪੁਨਰ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਬਢਿਯੋ ਸੁ ਆਪੰ ਮਝਾਰੰ ॥
164.t: punar dhroh baddiyo su aapa(n) majhaara(n) ||

164.g: ਭਜੇ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਦਈਤ ਜਿਤੇ ਜੁਝਾਰੰ ॥੧॥
164.t: bhaje dhevataa dhieet jite jujhaara(n) ||1||
164.e: Again the enmity grew between both of them and the war was waged  in which the gods fled and could not withstand the demons.1.

164.g: ਹਿਰਿਨ੍ਰਯੋ ਹਿਰਿੰਨਾਛਸੰ ਦੋਇ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
164.t: hirinrayo hiri(n)naachhasa(n) dhoi beera(n) ||
164.e: Hiranayaksha and Hiranayakashipu, both the demon brothers,

164.g: ਸਬੈ ਲੋਗ ਕੈ ਜੀਤ ਲੀਨੇ ਗਹੀਰੰ ॥
164.t: sabai log kai jeet leene gaheera(n) ||
164.e: Conquered the tresures of the worlds

165.g: ਜਲੰ ਬਾ ਥਲੇਯੰ ਕੀਯੋ ਰਾਜ ਸਰਬੰ ॥
165.t: jala(n) baa thaleya(n) keeyo raaj saraba(n) ||
165.e: They ruled over all the places in water and on land

165.g: ਭੁਜਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਢਿਯੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਗਰਬੰ ॥੨॥
165.t: bhujaa dhekh bhaaree baddiyo taeh garaba(n) ||2||
165.e: And seeing their own great physical strength, their pride knew no bounds.2.

165.g: ਚਹੈ ਜੁਧ ਮੋ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਆਨਿ ਕੋਊ ॥
165.t: chahai judh mo so kare aan kouoo ||
165.e: They wanted that some brave warriors may come forward to fight with them

165.g: ਬਲੀ ਹੋਏ ਵਾ ਸੋ ਭਿਰੇ ਆਨਿ ਸੋਊ ॥
165.t: balee hoe vaa so bhire aan souoo ||
165.e: But only he could march against them, who could be greatly stronger than them.

165.g: ਚੜਿਯੋ ਮੇਰ ਸ੍ਰਿੰਗ ਪਗੰ ਗੁਸਟ ਸੰਗੰ ॥
165.t: chaRiyo mer sira(n)g paga(n) gusaT sa(n)ga(n) ||
165.e: They climbed to the top of the Sumeru mountain and with the blows of their maces,

165.g: ਹਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਭੂਮੰ ਕੀਏ ਸਰਬ ਭੰਗੰ ॥੩॥
165.t: hare bedh bhooma(n) ke'ee sarab bha(n)ga(n) ||3||
165.e: They took away the Vedas and the earth forcibly and caused the destruction of all natural principles.3.

165.g: ਧਸੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਬੇਦੰ ਰਹੀ ਹੁਐ ਪਤਾਰੰ ॥
165.t: dhasee bhoom bedha(n) rahee huaai pataara(n) ||
165.e: They earth went deep into the nether-world

165.g: ਧਰਿਯੋ ਬਿਸਨ ਤਉ ਦਾੜ ਗਾੜਾਵਤਾਰੰ ॥
165.t: dhariyo bisan tau dhaaR gaaRaavataara(n) ||
165.e: Then Vishnu manifested himself in the form of a Boar of terrible and cruel teeth.

165.g: ਧਸ੍ਰਯੋ ਨੀਰ ਮਧੰ ਕੀਯੋ ਊਚ ਨਾਦੰ ॥
165.t: dhasrayo neer madha(n) keeyo uooch naadha(n) ||
165.e: He penetrated into water and raised a thunderous shout,

165.g: ਰਹੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਪੂਰੰ ਧੁਨੰ ਨਿਰਬਖਾਦੰ ॥੪॥
165.t: rahee dhoor poora(n) dhuna(n) nirabakhaadha(n) ||4||
165.e: Which spread equally throughout the universe.4.

165.g: ਬਜੇ ਡਾਕ ਡਉਰੂ ਦੋਊ ਬੀਰ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
165.t: baje ddaak ddauroo dhouoo beer jaage ||
165.e: Hearing this terrible shout and the resounding of the trumpets, both the brave demons awakened

165.g: ਸੁਣੇ ਨਾਦਿ ਬੰਕੇ ਮਹਾ ਭੀਰ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
165.t: sune naadh ba(n)ke mahaa bheer bhaage ||
165.e: Listening to their thundering voice, the cowards ran away

165.g: ਝਮੀ ਤੇਗ ਤੇਜੰ ਸਰੋਸੰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੰ ॥
165.t: jhamee teg teja(n) sarosa(n) prahaara(n) ||
165.e: The war began and the clattering of the glistening swords and the sound of the furious blows was heard

165.g: ਖਿਵੀ ਦਾਮਿਨੀ ਜਾਣੁ ਭਾਦੋ ਮਝਾਰੰ ॥੫॥
165.t: khivee dhaaminee jaan bhaadho majhaara(n) ||5||
165.e: The luster of the swords looked like the flash of lightning in the month of Bhadon.5.

165.g: ਮੁਖੰ ਮੁਛ ਬੰਕੀ ਬਕੈ ਸੂਰ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
165.t: mukha(n) muchh ba(n)kee bakai soor beera(n) ||

165.g: ਤੜੰਕਾਰ ਤੇਗੰ ਸੜੰਕਾਰ ਤੀਰੰ ॥
165.t: taRa(n)kaar tega(n) saRa(n)kaar teera(n) ||
165.e: The warriors of winsome whiskers are shouting and the sounds of the blows of the swords and arrows are being heard

165.g: ਧਮਕਾਰ ਸਾਗੰ ਖੜਕਾਰ ਖਗੰ ॥
165.t: dhamakaar saaga(n) khaRakaar khaga(n) ||

165.g: ਟੁਟੇ ਟੂਕ ਟੋਪੰ ਉਠੇ ਨਾਲ ਅਗੰ ॥੬॥
165.t: TuTe Took Topa(n) uThe naal aga(n) ||6||
165.e: With the knocking and falling and the sparks are coming out from them.6.

165.g: ਉਠੇ ਨਦ ਨਾਦੰ ਢਮਕਾਰ ਢੋਲੰ ॥
165.t: auThe nadh naadha(n) ddamakaar ddola(n) ||

165.g: ਢਲੰਕਾਰ ਢਾਲੰ ਮੁਖੰ ਮਾਰ ਬੋਲੰ ॥
165.t: ddala(n)kaar ddaala(n) mukha(n) maar bola(n) ||
165.e: With the resounding of trumpets and knocking sound on the shields, the utterance of “kill kill” coming from the mouth is being heard

165.g: ਖਹੇ ਖਗ ਖੂਨੀ ਖੁਲੇ ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤੰ ॥
165.t: khahe khag khoonee khule beer kheta(n) ||

165.g: ਨਚੇ ਕੰਧਿ ਹੀਣੰ ਕਮਧੰ ਨ੍ਰਿਚੇਤੰ ॥੭॥
165.t: nache ka(n)dh heena(n) kamadha(n) niracheta(n) ||7||
165.e: The bloody daggers of the warriors have come out in the battlefield and the headless trunks are dancing in an unconscious state.7.

165.g: ਭਰੇ ਜੋਗਣੀ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਚਉਸਠ ਚਾਰੀ ॥
165.t: bhare joganee patr chausaTh chaaree ||

165.g: ਨਚੀ ਖੋਲਿ ਸੀਸੰ ਬਕੀ ਬਿਕਰਾਰੀ ॥
165.t: nachee khol seesa(n) bakee bikaraaree ||
165.e: The sixty-four female evil spirit (Yoginis) have filled their bowls with blood

165.g: ਹਸੈ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਰਾਲੰ ॥
165.t: hasai bhoot preta(n) mahaa bikaraala(n) ||

165.g: ਬਜੇ ਡਾਕ ਡਉਰੂ ਕਰੂਰੰ ਕਰਾਲੰ ॥੮॥
165.t: baje ddaak ddauroo karoora(n) karaala(n) ||8||
165.e: And loosening their matted hair, they are raising their terrible sound, the most awful ghosts and fiends are laughing and the shrieking sound of the hideous vampires is being heard.8.

165.g: ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੰਤ ਮੁਸਟੰ ਕਰੈ ਪਾਵ ਘਾਤੰ ॥
165.t: prahaara(n)t musaTa(n) karai paav ghaata(n) ||

165.g: ਮਨੋ ਸਿੰਘ ਸਿੰਘੰ ਡਹੇ ਗਜ ਮਾਤੰ ॥
165.t: mano si(n)gh si(n)gha(n) ddahe gaj maata(n) ||
165.e: The warriors are giving the blows of their fists and feet in this way as if the thundering lions have furiously attacked one another

165.g: ਛੁਟੀ ਈਸ ਤਾੜੀ ਡਗਿਯੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੰ ॥
165.t: chhuTee iees taaRee ddagiyo braham dhiaana(n) ||
165.e: Hearing the terrible sound of the war, the attention of gods Shiva and Brahma hath distracted

165.g: ਭਜ੍ਯੋ ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮਾ ਕਾਪ ਭਾਨੰ ਮਧ੍ਯਾਨੰ ॥੯॥
165.t: bhajayo cha(n)dhramaa kaap bhaana(n) madhayaana(n) ||9||
165.e: The moon also trembled and the noonday sun also fled in fear.9.

165.g: ਜਲੇ ਬਾ ਥਲੇਯੰ ਥਲੰ ਤਥ ਨੀਰੰ ॥
165.t: jale baa thaleya(n) thala(n) tath neera(n) ||

165.g: ਕਿਧੋ ਸੰਧਿਯੰ ਬਾਣ ਰਘੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
165.t: kidho sa(n)dhiya(n) baan ragh i(n)dhr beera(n) ||
165.e: There was water everywhere upward and downward and in this atmosphere Vishnu took aim of his arrows on his targets

165.g: ਕਰੈ ਦੈਤ ਆਘਾਤ ਮੁਸਟੰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੰ ॥
165.t: karai dhait aaghaat musaTa(n) prahaara(n) ||

165.g: ਮਨੋ ਚੋਟ ਬਾਹੈ ਘਰਿਯਾਰੀ ਘਰਿਯਾਰੰ ॥੧੦॥
165.t: mano choT baahai ghariyaaree ghariyaara(n) ||10||
165.e: The demons were collectively giving terrible blows of their fists in the way, like a crocodile aiming his blows on another crocodile.10.

165.g: ਬਜੇ ਡੰਗ ਬੰਕੇ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੂਰੰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
165.t: baje dda(n)g ba(n)ke su kraoora(n) karaare ||

165.g: ਮਨੋ ਗਜ ਜੁਟੇ ਦੰਤਾਰੇ ਦੰਤਾਰੇ ॥
165.t: mano gaj juTe dha(n)taare dha(n)taare ||
165.e: The trumpets resounded and the mighty and terrible warriors fought with each other in this way, as if the elephants with long tusks are fighting with each other.

165.g: ਢਮੰਕਾਰ ਢੋਲੰ ਰਣੰਕੇ ਨਫੀਰੰ ॥
165.t: ddama(n)kaar ddola(n) rana(n)ke nafeera(n) ||

165.g: ਸੜਕਾਰ ਸਾਗੰ ਤੜਕਾਰ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੧੧॥
165.t: saRakaar saaga(n) taRakaar teera(n) ||11||
165.e: The sound of the drums and horns was being heard and there was also the clattering of the daggers and the crackling of the arrows.11.

165.g: ਦਿਨੰ ਅਸਟ ਜੁਧੰ ਭਯੋ ਅਸਟ ਰੈਣੰ ॥
165.t: dhina(n) asaT judha(n) bhayo asaT raina(n) ||

165.g: ਡਗੀ ਭੂਮਿ ਸਰਬੰ ਉਠਿਯੋ ਕਾਪ ਗੈਣੰ ॥
165.t: ddagee bhoom saraba(n) uThiyo kaap gaina(n) ||
165.e: The war was waged for eight days and eight nights, in which the earth and the sky trembled.

165.g: ਰਣੰ ਰੰਗ ਰਤੇ ਸਭੈ ਰੰਗ ਭੂਮੰ ॥
165.t: rana(n) ra(n)g rate sabhai ra(n)g bhooma(n) ||

165.g: ਹਣ੍ਯੋ ਬਿਸਨ ਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਗਿਰਿਯੋ ਅੰਤਿ ਝੂਮੰ ॥੧੨॥
165.t: hanayo bisan satra(n) giriyo a(n)t jhooma(n) ||12||
165.e: All the warriors appeared absorbed in warfare in the battle-field, and Vishnu caused the death and fall of the enemy.12.

165.g: ਧਰੇ ਦਾੜ ਅਗ੍ਰੰ ਚਤੁਰ ਬੇਦ ਤਬੰ ॥
165.t: dhare dhaaR agra(n) chatur bedh taba(n) ||

165.g: ਹਠੀ ਦੁਸਟਿ ਜਿਤੇ ਭਜੇ ਦੈਤ ਸਬੰ ॥
165.t: haThee dhusaT jite bhaje dhait saba(n) ||
165.e: Then he placed all the four Vedas on the protruding part of his teeth and caused the death and fall of the persistent inimical demons

165.g: ਦਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਆਗਿਆ ਧੁਨੰ ਬੇਦ ਕੀਯੰ ॥
165.t: dhiee braham aagiaa dhuna(n) bedh keeya(n) ||

165.g: ਸਬੈ ਸੰਤਨੰ ਤਾਨ ਕੋ ਸੁਖ ਦੀਯੰ ॥੧੩॥
165.t: sabai sa(n)tana(n) taan ko sukh dheeya(n) ||13||
165.e: Vishnu commanded Brahma and he created the Dhanur-veda for the happiness of all the saints.13.

165.g: ਧਰਿਯੋ ਖਸਟਮੰ ਬਿਸਨ ਐਸਾਵਤਾਰੰ ॥
165.t: dhariyo khasaTama(n) bisan aaisaavataara(n) ||
165.e: In this way, the sixth partial incarnation of the Visnu manifested himself,

165.g: ਸਬੈ ਦੁਸਟ ਜਿਤੈ ਕੀਯੋ ਬੇਦ ਉਧਾਰੰ ॥
165.t: sabai dhusaT jitai keeyo bedh udhaara(n) ||
165.e: Who destroyed the enemies and protected the Vedas

166.g: ਥਟਿਯੋ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਜੰ ਜਿਤੇ ਦੇਵ ਸਰਬੰ ॥
166.t: thaTiyo dharam raaja(n) jite dhev saraba(n) ||
166.e: There was the victory of Dharma (righteousness) and the gods collectively were Victorious,

166.g: ਉਤਾਰਿਯੋ ਭਲੀ ਭਾਤ ਸੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਗਰਬੰ ॥੧੪॥
166.t: autaariyo bhalee bhaat so taeh garaba(n) ||14||
166.e: And they caused to remove the pride of all in a right way.14.

166.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਬੈਰਾਹ ਖਸਟਮ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੬॥
166.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the bairaeh khasaTam avataar samaapatam sat subham sat ||6||
166.e: End of the description of the sixth BOAR INCARNATION in BACHITTAR NATAK.6.
Now begins the description of Narsingh Incarnation:
Let Shri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.
In this way, Indra, the king of gods ruled and filled the granaries of materials through all modes
When the pride of the gods grew enormously, then in order to shelve their pride, the hard-hearted mighty demons rose again.1.
The kingdom of Indra was seized and this proclamation was made on all sides with the accompaniment of many musical instruments,
That Hiranayakashipu is the emperor at all the places.2.

166.g: ਇਕ ਦ੍ਯੋਸ ਗਯੋ ਨਿਜ ਨਾਰਿ ਤੀਰ ॥
166.t: eik dhayos gayo nij naar teer ||

166.g: ਸਜਿ ਸੁਧ ਸਾਜ ਨਿਜ ਅੰਗਿ ਬੀਰ ॥
166.t: saj sudh saaj nij a(n)g beer ||
166.e: One day, this mighty ruler, bedecking himself, went to his wife,

166.g: ਕਿਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਸ੍ਵਤ੍ਰਿਯ ਮੋ ਭਯੋ ਨਿਰੁਕਤ ॥
166.t: keh bhaat savaitiray mo bhayo nirukat ||

166.g: ਤਬ ਭਯੋ ਦੁਸਟ ਕੋ ਬੀਰਜ ਮੁਕਤ ॥੩॥
166.t: tab bhayo dhusaT ko beeraj mukat ||3||
166.e: And absorbed himself with her so intensely that at the time of his intercourse, his semen was discharged.3.
From that semen Prahlad was born in order to help nad protect the saints.
When the king sent him to school for education, he asked his teacher to write the Name of Lord-God on his tablet.4.

167.g: ਚਿਤਿ ਚੌਕ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਸੁਭਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਤੰ ॥
167.t: chit chauak rahiyo subh dhekh suta(n) ||
167.e: One day the king went to the school and seeing his son, he was startled.

167.g: ਜੋ ਪੜਿਯੋ ਦਿਜ ਤੇ ਸੁਨ ਤਾਹਿ ਰੜੋ ॥
167.t: jo paRiyo dhij te sun taeh raRo ||

167.e: When the king asked, the child told whatever he had learnt and fearlessly began to read the Name of Lord-God.5.

167.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਭਜੋ ਦੁਸਰੰ ॥
167.t: bin moh su kaun bhajo dhusara(n) ||
167.e: On hearing the Name of Lord-God, the demon became furious and said, “Who else is there except me on whom you are meditating?”

167.g: ਜੀਯ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਰੋ ਸਿਸੁ ਯਾਹਿ ਹਨੋ ॥
167.t: jeey maeh dharo sis yaeh hano ||

167.g: ਜੜ ਕਿਉ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ਭਨੋ ॥੬॥
167.t: jaR kiau bhagavaan ko naam bhano ||6||
167.e: He decided to kill this student and said, “O fool  why are you repeating the name of Lord-God?”6.

167.g: ਜਲ ਅਉਰ ਥਲੰ ਇਕ ਬੀਰ ਮਨੰ ॥
167.t: jal aaur thala(n) ik beer mana(n) ||

167.g: ਇਹ ਕਾਹਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਨੰ ॥
167.t: eeh kaeh gupaal ko naam bhana(n) ||
167.e: “Only Hiranayakashipu is considered the mithty-one in water and on land , then why are you repeating the name of Lord-God”?

167.g: ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤਿਹ ਬਾਧਤ ਥੰਮ ਭਏ ॥
167.t: tab hee teh baadhat tha(n)m bhe ||

167.e: Then, as commanded by the king, the demons tied him with the column.7.

167.g: ਗਹਿ ਮੂੜ ਚਲੇ ਸਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਨ ਕੋ ॥
167.t: geh mooR chale sis maaran ko ||

167.e: When those foolish persons advanced to kill this student, the Lord manifested Himself at the same time in order to protect His disciple.
Al those who saw the Lord at that time were astonished, the Lord had manifested Himself by tearing off the doors.8
Seeing Him, all the gods and demons trembled and all the animate and inanimate objects became fearful in their bearts

167.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਰਤ ਕੀਏ ਮੁਖ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਭਰੰ ॥੯॥
167.t: dhirag rat ke'ee mukh sron bhara(n) ||9||
167.e: The Lord in the form of Narsingh (man-lion), with red eyes and the mouth filled with blood, thundered dreadfully.9.

167.g: ਲਖਿ ਦਾਨਵ ਭਾਜ ਚਲੇ ਸਬ ਹੀ ॥
167.t: lakh dhaanav bhaaj chale sab hee ||

167.e: Seeing this and hearing the thunder of Narsingh all the demons fled

167.g: ਇਕ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਠਾਢਿ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਰਣ ਮੈ ॥
167.t: eik bhoopat Thaadd rahiyo ran mai ||

167.g: ਗਹਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਗਦਾ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਮਨ ਮੈ ॥੧੦॥
167.t: geh haath gadhaa nirabhai man mai ||10||
167.e: Only the Emperor, fearlessly holding his mace in his hand, stood firmly in that battlefield.10.
When the Emperor roared loudly, then all the brave warriors trembled and all those warriors came forward in groups before that lion.

167.g: ਜੁ ਗਏ ਸਮੁਹੇ ਛਿਤ ਤੈ ਪਟਕੇ ॥
167.t: j ge samuhe chhit tai paTake ||

167.g: ਰਣਿ ਭੈ ਰਣਧੀਰ ਬਟਾ ਨਟ ਕੇ ॥੧੧॥
167.t: ran bhai ranadheer baTaa naT ke ||11||
167.e: All those who went in front of Narsingh, He caught hold of all those warriors like a juggler and knocked them down of the ground.11.
The warriors shouted loudly at one another and saturated with blood began to fall.

167.g: ਉਮਗੇ ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰਨ ਤੇ ਰਿਪੁ ਯੌ ॥
167.t: aumage chahoo(n) oran te rip yau ||

167.e: The enemies advanced from all the four sides with such intensity like the clouds in the rainy season.12.
Advancing from all the ten directions, the warriors began to shower the arrows and stones
The swords and arrows glistened in the war-field and the brave fighters began to flutter their flags.13.
The persistent warriors with loud shouts are showering a volley of arrows in this way,
As if it is the second cloudburst in the mont of Swan
The flags are fluttering and the horses are neighing
And seeing all this scene, the heart of the demon-king was filled with fear.14.
The horses are neighing and the elephants are roaring

167.g: ਭਟ ਬਾਹ ਕਟੀ ਜਨੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਧੁਜੰ ॥
167.t: bhaT baeh kaTee jan i(n)dhr dhuja(n) ||
167.e: The chopped long arms of the warriors look like the flag of Indra
The warriors are writhing and the elephants are roaring in such a way,

167.g: ਸੁਨ ਕੈ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਾਵਣ ਮੇਘ ਲਜੰ ॥੧੫॥
167.t: sun kai dhun saavan megh laja(n) ||15||
167.e: That the clouds of the month of Sawan are feeling shy.15.

167.g: ਬਿਚਲ੍ਰਯੋ ਪਗ ਦ੍ਵੈਕੁ ਫਿਰਿਯੋ ਪੁਨਿ ਜਿਯੋ ॥
167.t: bichalrayo pag dhavaik firiyo pun jiyo ||
167.e: As soon as the horse of Hiranayakashipu turned a little, he himself deviated and retraced two steps

167.g: ਕਰਿ ਪੁੰਛ ਲਗੇ ਅਹਿ ਕ੍ਰੁਧਤ ਜਿਯੋ ॥
167.t: kar pu(n)chh lage eh krudhat jiyo ||
167.e: But still he was infuriated in the manner of the snake who gets infuriated when its tail is crushed by a foot
His face was shining in the battlefield,
Like the blossoming of the lotus on seeing the sun.16.

168.e: The horses are moving in so much intoxication and creating noise that the attention of Shiva was dissolved, And it seemed that the universe had been displaced

168.g: ਸਰ ਸੇਲ ਸਿਲਾ ਸਿਤ ਐਸ ਬਹੇ ॥
168.t: sar sel silaa sit aais bahe ||

168.g: ਨਭ ਅਉਰ ਧਰਾ ਦੋਊ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧੭॥
168.t: nabh aaur dharaa dhouoo poor rahe ||17||
168.e: The arrows, daggers and stones were flying and filling both the earth and the sky.17.
The Ganas and Gandharvas, seeing both, were pleased and the gods showered flowers.

168.g: ਮਿਲ ਗੇ ਭਟ ਆਪ ਬਿਖੈ ਦੋਊ ਯੋ ॥
168.t: mil ge bhaT aap bikhai dhouoo yo ||

168.e: Two warriors were fighting with each other like the children competing with one another in their play during the night.18.
BELI BINDRAM STANZA
The warriors are thundering in the war and seeing them both the gods and demons are feeling shy
The brave fighters, who have been wounded, are roaming and it appears that the smoke is flying upwards.19.
The brave fighters of many types are fighting bravely with one another.
The lances and arrows are being hurled and the horses of the warriors are advancing hesitantly.20.
TOMAR STANZA
Millions of horses are neighing and the warriors are showering arrows
The bows have slipped and fallen from the hands and in this way the terrible and unique war is being waged.21.
Many types of warriors and innumerable horsemen are fighting with one another
They are striking their swords without any suspicion and in this way, a unique war is going on.22.
DODHAK STANZA

168.g: ਬਾਹਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਣ ਸੁ ਬਾਣ ਭਟ ਗਣ ॥
168.t: baeh kirapaan su baan bhaT gan ||

168.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਗਿਰੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਣਿ ॥
168.t: a(n)t girai pun joojh mahaa ran ||
168.e: After striking their swords and arrows, the brave fighters ultimately fell down during that great war.
The wounded warriors are swinging like the blossomed spring at the end of the month of Phagun.23.
Somewhere the chopped arms of the warriors appear like the trunks of the elephants
The brave fighters appear beautiful like the flowers blooming in the garden.24.
The enemies were dyed with blood like many types of blooming flowers.
After having been wounded with swords the brave soldiers were roaming like the manifestation of anger itself.25.
TOTAK STANZA
Many enemies fell down fighting and Narsingh, the incarnation of Vishnu also received many wounds.
The chopped bits of the warriors were flowing in the stream of blood like the bubbles of foam.26.

168.g: ਸੁਆਮਿ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ਨਿਬਾਹੀ ॥
168.t: suaam ke kaaj kee laaj nibaahee ||
168.e: The fighting soldiers, having been cut into bits, fell down, but none of them put to disrepute the dignity of their master.
Showing the blows of the swords and arrows, the warriors fled away ultimately in great fear.27.
CHAUPAI

169.g: ਤ੍ਯਾਗਿ ਚਲੈ ਰਣ ਕੋ ਸਬ ਬੀਰਾ ॥
169.t: tayaag chalai ran ko sab beeraa ||

169.g: ਲਾਜ ਬਿਸਰ ਗਈ ਭਏ ਅਧੀਰਾ ॥
169.t: laaj bisar giee bhe adheeraa ||
169.e: All the warriors, abandoning their shyness and getting impatient left the battlefield and ran away.

169.g: ਹਿਰਿਨਾਛਸ ਤਬ ਆਪੁ ਰਿਸਾਨਾ ॥
169.t: hirinaachhas tab aap risaanaa ||

169.g: ਬਾਧਿ ਚਲ੍ਯੋ ਰਣ ਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਗਾਨਾ ॥੨੮॥
169.t: baadh chalayo ran ko kar gaanaa ||28||
169.e: Seeing this, Hirnayakashipu himself in great ire, moved forward for waging war.28.

169.g: ਭਰਿਯੋ ਰੋਸ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਸਰੂਪੰ ॥
169.t: bhariyo ros narasi(n)gh saroopa(n) ||

169.g: ਆਵਤ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਮੁਹੇ ਰਣਿ ਭੂਪੰ ॥
169.t: aavat dhekh samuhe ran bhoopa(n) ||
169.e: Seeing the Emperor coming towards him, Narsingh also got infuriated.

169.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਾਵਨ ਕੋ ਰੋਸ ਨ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
169.t: nij ghaavan ko ros na maanaa ||

169.g: ਨਿਰਖਿ ਸੇਵਕਹਿ ਦੁਖੀ ਰਿਸਾਨਾ ॥੨੯॥
169.t: nirakh sevakeh dhukhee risaanaa ||29||
169.e: He did not care for his wounds, because he was in extreme agony of seeing the suffering on his devotees.29.

169.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
169.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||

169.g: ਕੰਪਾਈ ਸਟਾ ਸਿੰਘ ਗਰਜ੍ਯੋ ਕ੍ਰੂਰੰ ॥
169.t: ka(n)paiee saTaa si(n)gh garajayo kraoora(n) ||

169.g: ਉਡ੍ਯੋ ਹੇਰਿ ਬੀਰਾਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਨੂਰੰ ॥
169.t: auddayo her beeraan ke mukh noora(n) ||
169.e: Giving a jeck to his neck, Narsingh raised a terrible thunder and listening to his thunder, the faces of the heroes turned pale.

169.g: ਉਠ੍ਯੋ ਨਾਦ ਬੰਕੇ ਛੁਹੀ ਗੈਣਿ ਰਜੰ ॥
169.t: auThayo naadh ba(n)ke chhuhee gain raja(n) ||

169.g: ਹਸੇ ਦੇਵ ਸਰਬੰ ਭਏ ਦੈਤ ਲਜੰ ॥੩੦॥
169.t: hase dhev saraba(n) bhe dhait laja(n) ||30||
169.e: Because of that dreadful sound, the earth trembled and its dust touched the sky. All the gods began to smile and the heads of the demons bowed down with shame.30.

169.g: ਮਚ੍ਯੰ ਦੁੰਦ ਜੁਧੰ ਮਚੇ ਦੁਇ ਜੁਆਣੰ ॥
169.t: machaya(n) dhu(n)dh judha(n) mache dhui juaana(n) ||

169.g: ਤੜੰਕਾਰ ਤੇਗੰ ਕੜਕੇ ਕਮਾਣੰ ॥
169.t: taRa(n)kaar tega(n) kaRake kamaana(n) ||
169.e: The dreadful war of both the heroic fighters got ablazed, and the clattering sound of the sword and the cracking sound of the bows was heard.

169.g: ਭਿਰਿਯੋ ਕੋਪ ਕੈ ਦਾਨਵੰ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੰ ॥
169.t: bhiriyo kop kai dhaanava(n) sulataana(n) ||

169.g: ਹੜੰ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਚਲੇ ਮਧੰ ਮੁਲਤਾਣੰ ॥੩੧॥
169.t: haRa(n) sron chale madha(n) mulataana(n) ||31||
169.e: The demon-king fought in great fury and there was a flood of blood in the battlefield.31.

169.g: ਕੜਕਾਰ ਤੇਗੰ ਤੜਕਾਰ ਤੀਰੰ ॥
169.t: kaRakaar tega(n) taRakaar teera(n) ||

169.g: ਭਏ ਟੂਕ ਟੂਕੰ ਰਣੰ ਬੀਰ ਧੀਰੰ ॥
169.t: bhe Took Tooka(n) rana(n) beer dheera(n) ||
169.e: With the clattering of swords and the crackling noise of the arrows, the mighty and the enduring heroes were chopped into bits

169.g: ਬਜੇ ਸੰਖ ਭੂਰੰ ਸੁ ਢੋਲੰ ਢਮੰਕੇ ॥
169.t: baje sa(n)kh bhoora(n) su ddola(n) ddama(n)ke ||

169.g: ਰੜੰ ਕੰਕ ਬੰਕੇ ਡਹੈ ਬੀਰ ਬੰਕੇ ॥੩੨॥
169.t: raRa(n) ka(n)k ba(n)ke ddahai beer ba(n)ke ||32||
169.e: The conches, clarionets and drums resounded and the wanton soldiers, riding on the sharp horses stood firmly in the battlefield.32.

169.g: ਭਜੇ ਬਾਜਿ ਗਾਜੀ ਸਿਪਾਹੀ ਅਨੇਕੰ ॥
169.t: bhaje baaj gaajee sipaahee aneka(n) ||

169.g: ਰਹੇ ਠਾਢਿ ਭੂਪਾਲ ਆਗੇ ਨ ਏਕੰ ॥
169.t: rahe Thaadd bhoopaal aage na eka(n) ||
169.e: Many a warrior riding on the horses and elephants fled away and none of the chiefs could stand against Narsingh.

169.g: ਫਿਰਿਯੋ ਸਿੰਘ ਸੂਰੰ ਸੁ ਕ੍ਰੂਰੰ ਕਰਾਲੰ ॥
169.t: firiyo si(n)gh soora(n) su kraoora(n) karaala(n) ||

170.e: That terrible and dreadful Narsingh moved in the battlefield and began to stir his neck and wag his tail.33.
DOHRA

170.g: ਗਰਜਤ ਰਣਿ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਕੇ ਭਜੇ ਸੂਰ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
170.t: garajat ran narasi(n)gh ke bhaje soor anek ||

170.g: ਏਕ ਟਿਕਿਯੋ ਹਿਰਿਨਾਛ ਤਹ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜੋਧਾ ਏਕੁ ॥੩੪॥
170.t: ek Tikiyo hirinaachh teh avar na jodhaa ek ||34||
170.e: Many warriors fled on the thunder of Narsingh and none could stand in battlefield except Hiranayakashipu.34.
CHAUPAI
The war with fists of both the warriors began and none other except those two could be seen in the battlefield.
The eyes of both had become red and all the groups of gods were seeing this performance form the sky.35.
For eight days and eight nights both these brave heroes, furiously, waged the dreadful war.
After this, the demon-king felt weakness and fell down on the earth like an old tree.36.
Narsingh sprinkled ambrosia and woke him up from the unconscious state and he become alert after coming out of the state of unconsciousness.
Both the heroes began to fight again furiously and a dreadful war began again.37.
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

170.g: ਹਲਾ ਚਾਲ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਪੁਨਰ ਬੀਰ ਢੂਕੇ ॥
170.t: halaa chaal kai kai punar beer ddooke ||

170.g: ਮਚਿਯੋ ਜੁਧ ਜਿਯੋ ਕਰਨ ਸੰਗੰ ਘੜੂਕੇ ॥
170.t: machiyo judh jiyo karan sa(n)ga(n) ghaRooke ||
170.e: After challenging each other, both the heroes began to fight again, and a dreadful war ensued between them for gaining victory over the other.

170.g: ਨਖੰ ਪਾਤ ਦੋਊ ਕਰੇ ਦੈਤ ਘਾਤੰ ॥
170.t: nakha(n) paat dhouoo kare dhait ghaata(n) ||

170.g: ਮਨੋ ਗਜ ਜੁਟੇ ਬਨੰ ਮਸਤਿ ਮਾਤੰ ॥੩੮॥
170.t: mano gaj juTe bana(n) masat maata(n) ||38||
170.e: Both of them were giving destructive blows to one another with their nails and appeared like two intoxicated elephants fighting each other in the forest.38.
Narsingh again threw Hiranayakashipu on the earth just as the old Palas tree (Butea frondosa) falls down on the earth with a gust of wind.

170.g: ਹਨ੍ਯੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੁਸਟੰ ਭਈ ਪੁਹਪ ਬਰਖੰ ॥
170.t: hanayo dhekh dhusaTa(n) bhiee puhap barakha(n) ||

170.g: ਕੀਏ ਦੇਵਤਿਯੋ ਆਨ ਕੈ ਜੀਤ ਕਰਖੰ ॥੩੯॥
170.t: ke'ee dhevatiyo aan kai jeet karakha(n) ||39||
170.e: Seeing that tyrants hath died, sang many types of songs of victory.39.
PAADHARI STANZA
Narsingh destroyed the tyrant and in this way Vishnu manifested his seventh incarnation.
He protected his devotee and spread righteousness on the earth.40.
The canopy was swung over the head of Prahlad and he was made a king, and in this way, the demons, who were darkness-incarnate, were destroyed.
Destroying all the tyrants and vicious people, Narsingh merged his light in the Supreme Light.41.
By killing them, all the tyrants were put to shame,
And that Imperceptible Lord-God merged again in His Own Self.
The poet, according to his own understanding, after reflection, hath uttered the above-mentioned saying,
That in this way, Vishnu manifested himself in his seventh incarnation.42.

170.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਸਪਤਮੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸਮਾਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੭॥
170.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the narasi(n)gh sapatamo avataar samaatam sat subham sat ||7||
170.e: End of the description of the seventh incarnation of NARSINGH.7.
Now begins the description of Bawan (Vaman) Incarnation:
Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpfrul.
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

170.g: ਪੁਨਰ ਭੂਮਿ ਮੋ ਪਾਪਾ ਬਾਢ੍ਯੋ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
170.t: punar bhoom mo paapaa baaddayo apaara(n) ||
170.e: After passing away of the epoch of Narsingh incarnation, the sins began to grow in intensity on the earth again.

170.g: ਕਰੇ ਲਾਗ ਜਗੰ ਪੁਨਰ ਦੈਤ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
170.t: kare laag jaga(n) punar dhait dhaana(n) ||

170.g: ਬਲਿ ਰਾਜ ਕੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਬਢਿਯੋ ਗੁਮਾਨੰ ॥੧॥
170.t: bal raaj kee dheh baddiyo gumaana(n) ||1||
170.e: The demons began to perform Yajnsas (sacrificial rituals) again and the king Bali became proud of his greatness.1.

170.g: ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਲੰ ਦੇਵਤਾ ਜਗ ਬਾਸੰ ॥
170.t: n paavai bala(n) dhevataa jag baasa(n) ||

171.e: There was no position of gods in the Yajnas of king Bali and the capital of Indra was also destroyed.
In great agony, all the gods meditated on the Lord, by which the Supreme Destroyer Purusha was pleased.2.
The Non-temporal Lord asked Vishnu out of all gods to assume his eighth manifestation in the form of Vaman incarnation.

171.g: ਲਈ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਆਗਿਆ ਚਲਿਯੋ ਧਾਇ ਐਸੇ ॥
171.t: liee bisan aagiaa chaliyo dhai aaise ||

171.e: Vishnu after seeking permission of the Lord, moved like a servant at the command of a king.3.
NARAAJ STANZA
He transformed himself ad a dwarf and after some reflection, he moved towards the court of the king Bali, where, on reaching, he stood firmly.4.
This Brahmin recited all the four Vedas, which the king listened to attentively.
The king Bali then called the Brahmin and got him seated respectfully on a seat of sandalwood.5.
The king quaffed the water, with which the feet of the Brahmin had been washed and offered charities.
Then he circumambulated around the Brahmin several times, after that the king offered millions of charities, but the Brahmin did not touch anything with his hand.6.
The Brahmin said that all those things were of no use to him and all the ostentations offered by the king were false.
He then asked him to give only two and a half steps of the earth  and accept the special eulogy.7.
CHAUPAI
When the Brahmin uttered these words, the king along with the queen could not understand its import.
That Brahmin again said the same thing with determination that he had asked only for two and a half steps of the earth.8.
Shukracharya, the preceptor of the king was with him at that time, and he alongwith all the ministers comprehended the mystery of asking only for earth.

171.g: ਜਿਯੋ ਜਿਯੋ ਦੇਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕਹੈ ॥
171.t: jiyo jiyo dhen pirathavee nirap kahai ||

171.e: As many times the king orders for the donation of the earth, for so many times the preceptor Shukracharya asks him not to agree to it.9.

171.g: ਜਬ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਦੇਨ ਧਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
171.t: jab nirap dhen dharaa man keenaa ||

171.g: ਤਬ ਹੀ ਉਤਰ ਸੁਕ੍ਰ ਇਮ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
171.t: tab hee utar sukr im dheenaa ||
171.e: But when the king made up his mind firmly to give the required earth as alms, then Shukracharya giving his reply said this to the king,

171.g: ਲਘੁ ਦਿਜ ਯਾਹਿ ਨ ਭੂਪ ਪਛਾਨੋ ॥
171.t: lagh dhij yaeh na bhoop pachhaano ||

171.e: “O king! do not consider him a small-sized Brahmin, consider him only as an incarnation of Vishnu.”10.
Hearing this, all the demons laughed and said: “Shukracharya is only thinking of useless thing,”

171.g: ਸਸਿਕ ਸਮਾਨ ਨ ਦਿਜ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਸਾ ॥
171.t: sasik samaan na dhij meh maasaa ||

171.e: “The Brahmin, whose body does not contain the flesh more than a rabbit, how can he destroy the world?”11.
DOHRA
Shukracharya said :

171.g: ਜਿਮ ਚਿਨਗਾਰੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੀ ਗਿਰਤ ਸਘਨ ਬਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
171.t: jim chinagaaree agan kee girat saghan ban maeh ||
171.e: “The manner in which only a spark of fire, falling down, grows immensely in stature

171.g: ਅਧਿਕ ਤਨਿਕ ਤੇ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਤਿਮ ਦਿਜਬਰ ਨਰ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧੨॥
171.t: adhik tanik te hot hai tim dhijabar nar naeh ||12||
171.e: “Likewise this small-sized Brahmin is not a man.”12.
CHAUPAI

171.g: ਸੁਨਹੋ ਸੁਕ੍ਰ ਤੁਮ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
171.t: sunaho sukr tum baat na jaanee ||
171.e: The king Bali, laughingly, said these words to Shukracharya: “O Shukracharya! You are not comprehending it, I shall not regain such an occasion,

172.g: ਫੁਨਿ ਇਹ ਸਮੋ ਸਭੋ ਛਲ ਜੈ ਹੈ ॥
172.t: fun ieh samo sabho chhal jai hai ||

172.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਭਿਛਕ ਐ ਹੈ ॥੧੩॥
172.t: har so fer na bhichhak aai hai ||13||
172.e: “Because I shall not be able to get such a God-like beggar again.”13.

172.g: ਮਨ ਮੋ ਧਰੀ ਨ ਕਿਸੂ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
172.t: man mo dharee na kisoo bataiee ||
172.e: The King decided this general notion in his mind, but perceptibly he did not divulge it to anyone.
He asked the medicant to give his pot, in order to enact such a base deed.14.
Shukracharya understood the notion of the mind of the King, but the ignorant King could not comprehend it.
Shukracharya transformed himself into a small fish and seated himself in the mendicant’s pot.15.
The King took the mendicant’s pot in his hand and the time forgiving alms to the Brahmin arrived.

172.g: ਨਿਕਸ ਨੀਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਆਯੋ ॥੧੬॥
172.t: nikas neer kar taeh na aayo ||16||
172.e: When the King in order to give alms took some water in his hand, no water came out of the pot.16.
Then the Brahmin became furious and told the King to check up the por.
The pipe of the pot was searched with a straw and with this search one eye of Shukracharya was lost.17.
The King took the straw in his hand and revolved it within the pot.
It pierced the eye of Shukrachraya and thus one eye of the preceptor Shukraccharya was lost.18.

173.e: The water that oozed out from the eye of Shukracharya, the King took it in his hand.
Shukracharya did not allow the water to leak and in this way, tried to protect his master from destruction.19.
CHAUPAI
When the water (from the eye) oozed out on the hand of the King, he gave it as alms, notionally, on the hand of the Brahmin.
After this the dwarf expanded his body, which became so huge that it touched the heavens after penetrating through this world.20.
Seeing this, al the people were wonder-struck and visualizing such a huge form of Vishnu, the demons became unconscious.
The feet of Vishnu touched the nether-worlds and the head touched the heavens  all were non-plussed on seeing this.21.
With one step, he measured the nether-world and with the second step he measured the heavens.

173.g: ਤਿਹ ਤੇ ਗਿਰੀ ਗੰਗ ਕੀ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੨੨॥
173.t: teh te giree ga(n)g kee dhaaraa ||22||
173.e: In this way, Vishnu touched the whole universe and the current of Ganges began to flow down from the whole universe.22.

173.g: ਮਨ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਬਚਨ ਚਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੁਐ ਰਹਾ ॥
173.t: man kram bachan chakirat huaai rahaa ||
173.e: In this way, the king was also astonished and remained puzzled in mind, word and deeds.

173.g: ਸੁ ਕੁਛ ਭਯੋ ਜੋਊ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿ ਉਚਾਰਾ ॥
173.t: s kuchh bhayo jouoo sukr uchaaraa ||

173.e: Whatever Shukracharya had said, the same had happened and he himself had seen all this with his own eyes on that day.23.

173.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੈ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਜਸੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
173.t: eeh bidh kai bhoopat jas leenaa ||
173.e: For the remaining half a step, the king Bali got his own body measured and earned approbation.

173.g: ਜਬ ਲਉ ਗੰਗ ਜਮੁਨ ਕੋ ਨੀਰਾ ॥
173.t: jab lau ga(n)g jamun ko neeraa ||

173.g: ਤਬ ਲਉ ਚਲੀ ਕਥਾ ਜਗਿ ਧੀਰਾ ॥੨੪॥
173.t: tab lau chalee kathaa jag dheeraa ||24||
173.e: As long as there is water in the Ganges and Yamuna, till that time the story of his time the story of this enduring king will be narrated.24.
Vishnu was then pleased and manifesting himself said
“O king  I shall be a watchmen and servant at your gate myself

173.g: ਜਬ ਲਗ ਗੰਗ ਜਮੁਨ ਕੋ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੨੫॥
173.t: jab lag ga(n)g jamun ko paanee ||25||
173.e: And as long as there will be water in the Ganges and Yamuna, the story of your charity will be narrate.25.
DOHRA

173.g: ਜਹ ਸਾਧਨ ਸੰਕਟ ਪਰੈ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਭਏ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
173.t: jeh saadhan sa(n)kaT parai teh teh bhe sahai ||
173.e: Wherever the saints are in distress, the Non-temporal Lord comes there for help.

173.g: ਦੁਆਰਪਾਲ ਹੁਐ ਦਰਿ ਬਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਹੇਤ ਹਰਿਰਾਇ ॥੨੬॥
173.t: dhuaarapaal huaai dhar base bhagat het harirai ||26||
173.e: The Lord, coming under the control of His devotee, became his gate-keeper.26.
CHAUPAI
In this way, Vishnu, manifesting himself as the eighth incarnation, gratified all the saints.

173.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਚਿਤ ਲਾਇ ਸੁ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੨੭॥
173.t: sunahu sa(n)t chit lai su dhaaraa ||27||
173.e: Now I describe the ninth incarnation, which may please be listened to and understood correctly by all the saints..27.

173.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਬਾਵਨ ਅਸਟਮੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬਲਿ ਛਲਨ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੮॥
173.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the baavan asaTamo avataar bal chhalan samaapatam sat subham sat ||8||
173.e: End of the description of VAMAN, the eighth incarnation of Vishnu and the deception of the king BALI in BACHITTAR NATAK.8.
Now begins the description of Parashuram Incarnation:
Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.
CHAUPAI
Then a long period of time elapsed and the Kshatriyas conquered all the earth.

173.g: ਬਾਸਵ ਬਲਿ ਕਹੂੰ ਲੈਨ ਨ ਪਾਯੋ ॥੧॥
173.t: baasav bal kahoo(n) lain na paayo ||1||
173.e: They considered themselves as the most high and their strength became unlimited.1.

173.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਸਵ ਪੈ ਗਏ ॥
173.t: mil kar sabh baasav pai ge ||
173.e: Realising this all the gods were worried and went to Indra and said:
“All the demons have transformed themselves as Kshatriyas, O King! Now tell us your view about it.”2.

174.e: All the gods together reflected on this issued and went towards the milk-ocean.

174.g: ਇਮ ਆਗਿਆ ਤਹ ਤੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
174.t: eim aagiaa teh tai tin aaiee ||3||
174.e: There they eulogized KAL, the destroyer Lord and received the following message.3.

174.g: ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਕਰਤ ਅਘਨ ਓਘਨ ਹਤ ॥
174.t: nit uTh karat aghan oghan hat ||
174.e: The Destroyer Lord said, “ A sage named Yamadagni abides on the earth, who always gets up to destroy the sins by his virtuous deeds.
“O Vishnu, manifested yourself in his house and destroy the enemies of Indira.”4.
BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
Hail, hail to the incarnation-like sage Yamadagni, through whose wife Renuka was born the wearer of armour and carrier of axe (that is Parashurama)

174.g: ਧਰਿਯੋ ਛਤ੍ਰੀਯਾ ਪਾਤ ਕੋ ਕਾਲ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
174.t: dhariyo chhatreeyaa paat ko kaal roopa(n) ||

174.e: He manifested himself as death for the Kshatriyas and destroyed the king named Sahasrabadhu.5.

174.g: ਕਹਾ ਗੰਮ ਏਤੀ ਕਥਾ ਸਰਬ ਭਾਖਉ ॥
174.t: kahaa ga(n)m etee kathaa sarab bhaakhau ||

174.g: ਕਥਾ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਤੇ ਥੋਰੀਐ ਬਾਤ ਰਾਖਉ ॥
174.t: kathaa biradh te thoreeaai baat raakhau ||
174.e: I have not the requisite wisdom to describe the whole story, therefore fearing lest it may not become voluminous, I say it very briefly:

174.g: ਤਿਨੈ ਨਾਸ ਕੋ ਪਾਣਿ ਧਾਰਿਯੋ ਕੁਠਾਰੰ ॥੬॥
174.t: tinai naas ko paan dhaariyo kuThaara(n) ||6||
174.e: The Kshatriya king had been intoxicated with pride and in order to destroy them, Parashurama held up the axe in his hand.6.

174.g: ਹੁਤੀ ਨੰਦਨੀ ਸਿੰਧ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੁਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ॥
174.t: hutee na(n)dhanee si(n)dh jaa kee suputree ||

174.e: Nandini, the wish-fulfilling cow like the daughter of Yamadagni and the Kshatriya Sahasrabahu had got tired in begging it from the sage.

174.g: ਲੀਯੋ ਛੀਨ ਗਾਯੰ ਹਤਿਯੋ ਰਾਮ ਤਾਤੰ ॥
174.t: leeyo chheen gaaya(n) hatiyo raam taata(n) ||

174.g: ਤਿਸੀ ਬੈਰ ਕੀਨੇ ਸਬੈ ਭੂਪ ਪਾਤੰ ॥੭॥
174.t: tisee bair keene sabai bhoop paata(n) ||7||
174.e: Ultimately, he snatched away the cow and killed Yamadagni and in order to wreak his vengeance, Parashurama destroyed all the Kshatriya kings.7.

174.g: ਗਈ ਬਾਲ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਲੀਯੋ ਸੋਧ ਤਾ ਕੋ ॥
174.t: giee baal taa te leeyo sodh taa ko ||

174.g: ਹਨਿਯੋ ਤਾਤ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਹੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾ ਕੋ ॥
174.t: haniyo taat mero kaho naam vaa ko ||
174.e: Form the very childhood Parashurama had been quite inquisitive in his mind about the identity of the killer of his father

174.g: ਗਹੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਚਲਿਯੋ ਤਉਨ ਠਾਮੰ ॥੮॥
174.t: gahe sasatr asatra(n) chaliyo taun Thaama(n) ||8||
174.e: And when he came to know that it was the king Sahasrabahu, he moved towards his place with his arms and weapons.8.

174.g: ਕਹੋ ਰਾਜ ਮੇਰੋ ਹਨਿਯੋ ਤਾਤ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
174.t: kaho raaj mero haniyo taat kaise ||
174.e: Parashurama said to the king, “O king how have you killed my father?"

174.g: ਅਬੈ ਜੁਧ ਜੀਤੋ ਹਨੋ ਤੋਹਿ ਤੈਸੇ ॥
174.t: abai judh jeeto hano toh taise ||
174.e: "Now I want to wage war with you in order to kill you”

174.g: ਕਹਾ ਮੂੜ ਬੈਠੋ ਸੁ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਸੰਭਾਰੋ ॥
174.t: kahaa mooR baiTho su asatra(n) sa(n)bhaaro ||

174.g: ਚਲੋ ਭਾਜ ਨਾ ਤੋ ਸਬੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਡਾਰੋ ॥੯॥
174.t: chalo bhaaj naa to sabai sasatr ddaaro ||9||
174.e: He also said, “O fool, hold your weapons, otherwise forsaking them, run away from this place.”9.

174.g: ਸੁਣੇ ਬੋਲ ਬੰਕੇ ਭਰਿਯੋ ਭੂਪ ਕੋਪੰ ॥
174.t: sune bol ba(n)ke bhariyo bhoop kopa(n) ||

174.g: ਉਠਿਯੋ ਰਾਜ ਸਰਦੂਲ ਲੈ ਪਾਣਿ ਧੋਪੰ ॥
174.t: auThiyo raaj saradhool lai paan dhopa(n) ||
174.e: Hearing these ironical words, the king was filled with fury and holding his weapons in his hands, got up like a lion.

174.g: ਹਠਿਯੋ ਖੇਤਿ ਖੂਨੀ ਦਿਜੰ ਖੇਤ੍ਰ ਹਾਯੋ ॥
174.t: haThiyo khet khoonee dhija(n) khetr haayo ||

174.g: ਚਹੇ ਆਜ ਹੀ ਜੁਧ ਮੋ ਸੋ ਮਚਾਯੋ ॥੧੦॥
174.t: chahe aaj hee judh mo so machaayo ||10||
174.e: He came to the arena of battle with determination, knowing that the Brahmin Parashurama was desirous of fighting with him on the same day.10.

174.g: ਧਏ ਸੂਰ ਸਰਬੰ ਸੁਨੇ ਬੈਨ ਰਾਜੰ ॥
174.t: dhe soor saraba(n) sune bain raaja(n) ||

174.g: ਚੜਿਯੋ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਜੁਧੰ ਸ੍ਰਜੇ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਜੰ ॥
174.t: chaRiyo krudh judha(n) sraje sarab saaja(n) ||
174.e: Hearing the furious words of the king, his warriors in great ire, decorating themselves (with their weapon) marched forward
Holding firmly on to their tridents, lances, maces etc., the great canopied kings moved forward for waging war.11.
NARAAJ STANZA
Holding their swords in their hands, the mighty warriors marched forward with loud shouts
They uttered “kill, kill” and their arrows were drinking blood.12.
Wearing their armour and holding their daggers, the warriors in great ire moved forward.
The blows of whips horses produced knocking sounds and thousands of arrows flew out (from the bows).13.
RASAAVAL STANZA

175.e: All the warriors ran and gathered at one place.
And the besieged Parashurama, just as the clouds besiege the sun.14.
With the crackling of bows a queer sound was produced,
And the army swarmed like the dark clouds.15.
With the clattering of the daggers, a queer sound was produced,
The elephants began to roar in groups and bedecked with armour, the warriors seemed impressive.16.
Gathering from all the four sides, the groups of elephants began a fight.
The volleys of arrows were shot and the heads of the kings were shattered. 17.
The frightful sound emanated and all the kings got infuriated.
Parashurama was besieged by the army like Shiva encircled by the forces of Cupid.18.
All being absorbed and dyed with the dye of war, feared the glory of others.
So much dust arose by (the movement of the) army that the sky was filled with dust.19.
The drums resounded violently and the mighty warriors began to roar.
The warriors were fighting each other like the freely roaming lions.20.
With the shouts of “kill, kill”, the warriors were uttering dreadful words.
The chopped limbs of the warriors are falling and it appeared that there is fire on all the four sides.21.
The weapons began to fall from the hands and the warriors began to run away empty-handed.
The horses were neighing and were running hither and thither with swiftness.22.
The warriors are wounding the enemy by showering their arrows  they were also patting their arms.
The warriors by planting their daggers, increasing their inimical intentions, are waging a terrible war. 23
Many wounds are being inflicted and the wounded warriors appear to be playing Holi
Showering their arrows, all are desirous of the victory.24.
The warriors are roaming and falling like the swinging, after the breaking of their weapons and becoming trees armless, the warriors sped away.25.

176.g: ਤਿਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਘਾਏ ॥
176.t: tite raam ghaae ||

176.g: ਚਲੇ ਭਾਜਿ ਸਰਬੰ ॥
176.t: chale bhaaj saraba(n) ||

176.g: ਭਯੋ ਦੂਰ ਗਰਬੰ ॥੨੬॥
176.t: bhayo dhoor garaba(n) ||26||
176.e: All the enemies who came in front of him, Parashurama killed them all. Ultimately all of them ran away and their pride was shattered.26.

176.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
176.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||

176.g: ਮਹਾ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਾਰੇ ਚਲਿਯੋ ਆਪ ਭੂਪੰ ॥
176.t: mahaa sasatr dhaare chaliyo aap bhoopa(n) ||

176.g: ਲਏ ਸਰਬ ਸੈਨਾ ਕੀਏ ਆਪ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
176.t: le sarab sainaa ke'ee aap roopa(n) ||
176.e: Wearing his important weapons, the king himself, taking the mighty warriors with him, marched forward to wage the war.

176.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਛੋਰੇ ਭਯੋ ਜੁਧੁ ਮਾਨੰ ॥
176.t: ana(n)t asatr chhore bhayo judh maana(n) ||

176.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਕਾਲ ਮਾਨੋ ਸਭੈ ਰਸਮਿ ਭਾਨੰ ॥੨੭॥
176.t: prabhaa kaal maano sabhai rasam bhaana(n) ||27||
176.e: Forsaking his innumerable weapons, he waged a terrible war. The king himself seemed like the rising sun at dawn.27.

176.g: ਭੁਜਾ ਠੋਕਿ ਭੂਪੰ ਕੀਯੋ ਜੁਧ ਐਸੇ ॥
176.t: bhujaa Thok bhoopa(n) keeyo judh aaise ||

176.g: ਮਨੋ ਬੀਰ ਬ੍ਰਿਤਰਾਸੁਰੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
176.t: mano beer birataraasure i(n)dhr jaise ||
176.e: Patting his arms, the king firmly waged the war, like the war waged by Vrittasura with Indra

176.g: ਸਬੈ ਕਾਟ ਰਾਮੰ ਕੀਯੋ ਬਾਹਿ ਹੀਨੰ ॥
176.t: sabai kaaT raama(n) keeyo baeh heena(n) ||

176.g: ਹਤੀ ਸਰਬ ਸੈਨਾ ਭਯੋ ਗਰਬ ਛੀਨੰ ॥੨੮॥
176.t: hatee sarab sainaa bhayo garab chheena(n) ||28||
176.e: Parashurama made him armless by chopping away all his arms, and shattered his pride by destroying all his army.28.

176.g: ਗਹਿਯੋ ਰਾਮ ਪਾਣੰ ਕੁਠਾਰੰ ਕਰਾਲੰ ॥
176.t: gahiyo raam paana(n) kuThaara(n) karaala(n) ||

176.g: ਕਟੀ ਸੁੰਡ ਸੀ ਰਾਜਿ ਬਾਹੰ ਬਿਸਾਲੰ ॥
176.t: kaTee su(n)dd see raaj baaha(n) bisaala(n) ||
176.e: Parashurama held up his dreadful axe in his hand and chopped the arm of king like the trunk of the elephant.

176.g: ਭਏ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗੰ ਕਰੰ ਕਾਲ ਹੀਣੰ ॥
176.t: bhe a(n)g bha(n)ga(n) kara(n) kaal heena(n) ||

176.g: ਗਯੋ ਗਰਬ ਸਰਬੰ ਭਈ ਸੈਣ ਛੀਣੰ ॥੨੯॥
176.t: gayo garab saraba(n) bhiee sain chheena(n) ||29||
176.e: In this way becoming limbless, the whole army of the king was destroyed and his ego was shattered.29.

176.g: ਰਹਿਯੋ ਅੰਤ ਖੇਤੰ ਅਚੇਤੰ ਨਰੇਸੰ ॥
176.t: rahiyo a(n)t kheta(n) acheta(n) naresa(n) ||

176.g: ਬਚੇ ਬੀਰ ਜੇਤੇ ਗਏ ਭਾਜ ਦੇਸੰ ॥
176.t: bache beer jete ge bhaaj dhesa(n) ||
176.e: Ultimatley, becoming unconscious the king fell down in the battlefield, and all his warriors, who remained alive, fled away to their own countries.

176.g: ਲਈ ਛੀਨ ਛਉਨੀ ਕਰੈ ਛਤ੍ਰਿ ਘਾਤੰ ॥
176.t: liee chheen chhaunee karai chhatr ghaata(n) ||

176.g: ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੀ ਲੋਕ ਮਾਤੰ ॥੩੦॥
176.t: chira(n)kaal poojaa karee lok maata(n) ||30||
176.e: Parashurama seized his capital and destroyed the Kshatriyas and for a long time, the people worshipped him.30.

176.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
176.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||

176.g: ਲਈ ਛੀਨ ਛਉਨੀ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਪ ਭੂਪੰ ॥
176.t: liee chheen chhaunee karai bip bhoopa(n) ||

176.g: ਹਰੀ ਫੇਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰਿਨ ਦਿਜੰ ਜੀਤਿ ਜੂਪੰ ॥
176.t: haree fer chhatiran dhija(n) jeet joopa(n) ||
176.e: After seizing the capital, Parashurama made a Brahmin the king, but again the Kshatriyas, conquering all the Brahmins, snatched their city.

176.g: ਦਿਜੰ ਆਰਤੰ ਤੀਰ ਰਾਮੰ ਪੁਕਾਰੰ ॥
176.t: dhija(n) aarata(n) teer raama(n) pukaara(n) ||

177.g: ਚਲਿਯੋ ਰੋਸ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਲੀਨੇ ਕੁਠਾਰੰ ॥੩੧॥
177.t: chaliyo ros sree raam leene kuThaara(n) ||31||
177.e: The Brahmin, in great agony called Parashurama, who, holding his axe, moved with great fury.31.

177.g: ਸੁਨ੍ਯੋ ਸਰਬ ਭੂਪੰ ਹਠੀ ਰਾਮ ਆਏ ॥
177.t: sunayo sarab bhoopa(n) haThee raam aae ||

177.g: ਸਭੰ ਜੁਧੁ ਕੋ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਬਨਾਏ ॥
177.t: sabha(n) judh ko sasatr asatra(n) banaae ||
177.e: When all the kings heard that taking a vow of killing Kshatriyas, the persistent Parashurama had arrived, then all of them prepared for war, taking all their weapons.

177.g: ਚੜੇ ਚਉਪ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਕੀਏ ਜੁਧ ਐਸੇ ॥
177.t: chaRe chaup kai kai ke'ee judh aaise ||

177.g: ਮਨੋ ਰਾਮ ਸੋ ਰਾਵਣੰ ਲੰਕ ਜੈਸੇ ॥੩੨॥
177.t: mano raam so raavana(n) la(n)k jaise ||32||
177.e: In great ire, all of them came to wage the war like Rana and Ravana in Sri Lanka.32.

177.g: ਲਗੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਲਖੇ ਰਾਮ ਅੰਗੰ ॥
177.t: lage sasatra(n) asatra(n) lakhe raam a(n)ga(n) ||

177.g: ਗਹੇ ਬਾਣ ਪਾਣੰ ਕੀਏ ਸਤ੍ਰ ਭੰਗੰ ॥
177.t: gahe baan paana(n) ke'ee satr bha(n)ga(n) ||
177.e: When Parashurama saw that he was being attacked with arms and weapons, then he took the arrows in hand and killed his enemies

177.g: ਭੁਜਾ ਹੀਣ ਏਕੰ ਸਿਰੰ ਹੀਣ ਕੇਤੇ ॥
177.t: bhujaa heen eka(n) sira(n) heen kete ||

177.g: ਸਬੈ ਮਾਰ ਡਾਰੇ ਗਏ ਬੀਰ ਜੇਤੇ ॥੩੩॥
177.t: sabai maar ddaare ge beer jete ||33||
177.e: Many warriors became armless and many became headless. All those warriors who went in front of Parashurama, he killed all of the,.33.

177.g: ਹਣੇ ਐਸ ਹੀ ਭੂਪ ਸਰਬੰ ਸੁਧਾਰੰ ॥
177.t: hane aais hee bhoop saraba(n) sudhaara(n) ||
177.e: He caused the earth to become without Kshatriyas for twenty-one times and in this way, he destroyed all the kings and their base

177.g: ਕਥਾ ਸਰਬ ਜਉ ਛੋਰ ਤੇ ਲੈ ਸੁਨਾਉ ॥
177.t: kathaa sarab jau chhor te lai sunaau ||

177.g: ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਕੇ ਬਾਢਬੇ ਤੇ ਡਰਾਉ ॥੩੪॥
177.t: hiradhai gra(n)th ke baaddabe te ddaraau ||34||
177.e: And if I describe the complete story from one end to the other, then I fear that the book will become very voluminous.34.
CHAUPAI

177.g: ਕਰਿ ਜਗ ਮੋ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਅਖਾਰਾ ॥
177.t: kar jag mo ieh bhaat akhaaraa ||

177.e: In this way, Vishnu manifested for the ninth time in order to enact the wonderful play.
Now I describe the tenth incarnation, who is the support of the life-breath of the saints.35.

177.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਨਵਮੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਪਰਸਰਾਮ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੯॥
177.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake navamo avataar parasaraam samaapatam sat subham sat ||9||
177.e: End of the description of the ninth incarnation PARASHURAMA in BACHITTAR NATAK.9.
Now begins the description of Brahma Incarnation:
Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.
CHAUPAI
Now I describe that ancient story as to how the knowledgeable Brahma was bron.
The four-headed Brahma was born as the destroyer of sins and the creator of all the universe.1.

177.g: ਜਬ ਜਬ ਬੇਦ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
177.t: jab jab bedh naas hoi jaahee ||

177.e: Whenever the knowledge of Vedas is destroyed, Brahma is then manifested.

177.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਪੁ ਧਰਾ ॥
177.t: taa te bisan braham bap dharaa ||

177.e: For this purpose Vishnu manifested himself ad Brahma and he was known as “Chaturanan” (four-faced) in the world.2.

177.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਬਿਸਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਪੁ ਧਰਾ ॥
177.t: jab hee bisan braham bap dharaa ||

177.g: ਤਬ ਸਬ ਬੇਦ ਪ੍ਰਚੁਰ ਜਗਿ ਕਰਾ ॥
177.t: tab sab bedh prachur jag karaa ||
177.e: When Vishnu manifested himself as Brahma, he propagated the doctrines of the Vedas in the world.
He composed Shastras, Smritis and gave a life-discipline to the beings of the world.3.

177.g: ਜੇ ਜੇ ਹੁਤੇ ਅਘਨ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
177.t: je je hute aghan ke karataa ||

177.g: ਤੇ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਪਾਪ ਤੇ ਹਰਤਾ ॥
177.t: te te bhe paap te harataa ||
177.e: Those people who were there to perform sinful action, after getting the knowledge. From the Vedas, they became the remover of sins.
The sinful actions were explained and all the beings became absorbed in the actions of Dharma ( righteousness).4.
In this way, the Brahma incarnation manifested, who is the remover of all sins.
All the subjects began to tread the path of Dharma and abandoned the sinful actions.5.
DOHRA

177.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰ ਧਰਿਯੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
177.t: eeh bidh prajaa pavitr kar dhariyo braham avataar ||
177.e: In this way, the Brahma incarnation manifested for purifying he subjects

177.g: ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਲਾਗੇ ਸਬੈ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਮ ਕਹ ਡਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
177.t: dharam karam laage sabai paap karam keh ddaar ||6||
177.e: And all the beings began to perform the righteous actions, forsaking the sinful action.6.
CHAUPAI
The tenth incarnation of Vishnu is Brahma, who established the righteous actions in the world.

178.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਸਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
178.t: braham bisan meh bhedh na laheeaai ||

178.g: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭੀਤਰ ਇਮ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੭॥
178.t: saasatr si(n)mirat bheetar im kaheeaai ||7||
178.e: It hath been said in Shastras and Smrities that there is no difference between Brahma and Vishnu.7.

178.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦਸਮੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧੦॥
178.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake brahamaa dhasamo avataar samaapatam sat subham sat ||10||
178.e: End of the description of the tenth incarnation BRAHMA in BACHITTAR NATAK.10.

178.g: ਅਥ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬਰਨਨੰ ॥
178.t: ath rudhr avataar baranana(n) ||
178.e: Now begins the description of Rudra Incarnation:

178.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਜੀ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
178.t: sree bhagautee jee sahai ||
178.e: Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.

178.g: ਤੋਟਕ ਛੰਦ ॥
178.t: toTak chha(n)dh ||
178.e: TOTAK STANZA

178.g: ਸਬ ਹੀ ਜਨ ਧਰਮ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਲਗੇ ॥
178.t: sab hee jan dharam ke karam lage ||

178.g: ਤਜਿ ਜੋਗ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਭਗੇ ॥
178.t: taj jog kee reet kee preet bhage ||
178.e: All the people absorbed themselves in the works of Dharma, but the time came when the discipline of Yoga and Bhakti (devotion) was abandoned

178.g: ਜਬ ਧਰਮ ਚਲੇ ਤਬ ਜੀਉ ਬਢੇ ॥
178.t: jab dharam chale tab jeeau badde ||

178.g: ਜਨੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਕੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗਢੇ ॥੧॥
178.t: jan koT saroop ke braham gadde ||1||
178.e: When the path of Dharma is adopted, all the souls get pleased and practising equality, they visualize One Brahman within all.1.

178.g: ਜਗ ਜੀਵਨ ਭਾਰ ਭਰੀ ਧਰਣੀ ॥
178.t: jag jeevan bhaar bharee dharanee ||

178.g: ਦੁਖ ਆਕੁਲ ਜਾਤ ਨਹੀ ਬਰਣੀ ॥
178.t: dhukh aakul jaat nahee baranee ||
178.e: This earth was pressed under the lord of sufferings of the people of the world and it was impossible to describe its anguish and agony

178.g: ਧਰ ਰੂਪ ਗਊ ਦਧ ਸਿੰਧ ਗਈ ॥
178.t: dhar roop guoo dhadh si(n)dh giee ||

178.g: ਜਗਨਾਇਕ ਪੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਤ ਭਈ ॥੨॥
178.t: jaganaik pai dhukh rot bhiee ||2||
178.e: Then the earth transformed itself into a cow and weeping bitterly, she reached the milk-ocean before the Non-temporal Lord.2.

178.g: ਹਸਿ ਕਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
178.t: has kaal prasa(n)n bhe tab hee ||

178.g: ਦੁਖ ਸ੍ਰਉਨਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਸੁਨਿਯੋ ਜਬ ਹੀ ॥
178.t: dhukh sraunan bhoom suniyo jab hee ||
178.e: When the Lord heard with His own ears the sufferings of the earth, then the Destroyer Lord was pleased and laughed

178.g: ਢਿਗ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਬੁਲਾਇ ਲਯੋ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
178.t: ddig bisan bulai layo apane ||

178.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਤਿਹ ਕੋ ਸੁਪਨੇ ॥੩॥
178.t: eeh bhaat kahiyo teh ko supane ||3||
178.e: He called Vishnu in His presence and said to him in this way.3.

178.g: ਸੁ ਕਹਿਯੋ ਤੁਮ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਧਰੋ ॥
178.t: s kahiyo tum rudhr saroop dharo ||

178.g: ਜਗ ਜੀਵਨ ਕੋ ਚਲਿ ਨਾਸ ਕਰੋ ॥
178.t: jag jeevan ko chal naas karo ||
178.e: The destroyer Lord asked Vishnu to manifest himself as Rudra in order to destroy the beings of the world

178.g: ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤਿਹ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਸਰੂਪ ਧਰਿਯੋ ॥
178.t: tab hee teh rudhr saroop dhariyo ||

178.g: ਜਗ ਜੰਤ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਕੇ ਜੋਗ ਕਰਿਯੋ ॥੪॥
178.t: jag ja(n)t sa(n)ghaar ke jog kariyo ||4||
178.e: Then Vishnu manifested himself as Rudra and destroying the beings of the world, he established Yoga.4.

178.g: ਕਹਿ ਹੋਂ ਸਿਵ ਜੈਸਕ ਜੁਧ ਕੀਏ ॥
178.t: keh ho(n) siv jaisak judh ke'ee ||

178.g: ਸੁਖ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੋ ਜਿਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਦੀਏ ॥
178.t: sukh sa(n)tan ko jeh bhaat dhe'ee ||
178.e: I shall describe now as to how Shiva waged wars and gave comfort to the saints

178.g: ਗਨਿਯੋ ਜਿਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਰੀ ਗਿਰਜਾ ॥
178.t: ganiyo jeh bhaat baree girajaa ||

178.g: ਜਗਜੀਤ ਸੁਯੰਬਰ ਮੋ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ॥੫॥
178.t: jagajeet suya(n)bar mo su prabhaa ||5||
178.e: I shall also tell how he wedded Parbati after conquering her in the Swayyamvara (self-selection of a husband from amongst the suitors).5.

178.g: ਜਿਮ ਅੰਧਕ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੁਧੁ ਕਰਿਯੋ ॥
178.t: jim a(n)dhak so har judh kariyo ||

178.g: ਜਿਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਮਨੋਜ ਕੋ ਮਾਨ ਹਰਿਯੋ ॥
178.t: jeh bhaat manoj ko maan hariyo ||
178.e: How Shiva waged a war against Andgakasura? How is effaced the pride of Cupid?

178.g: ਦਲ ਦੈਤ ਦਲੇ ਕਰ ਕੋਪ ਜਿਮੰ ॥
178.t: dhal dhait dhale kar kop jima(n) ||

178.g: ਕਹਿਹੋ ਸਬ ਛੋਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਤਿਮੰ ॥੬॥
178.t: kahiho sab chhor prasa(n)g tima(n) ||6||
178.e: Getting furious, how he mashed the gathering of demons? I shall describe all these anecdotes.6.

178.g: ਪਾਧਰੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
178.t: paadharee chha(n)dh ||
178.e: PADHAARI STANZA

178.g: ਜਬ ਹੋਤ ਧਰਨ ਭਾਰਾਕਰਾਤ ॥
178.t: jab hot dharan bhaaraakaraat ||

178.g: ਤਬ ਪਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਸਾਤਿ ॥
178.t: tab parat naeh teh hiradhai saat ||
178.e: When the earth is pressed by the load of sins, then she cannot have peace in her heart.

178.g: ਤਬ ਦਧ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਿ ਕਰਈ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
178.t: tab dhadh samu(n)dhr kariee pukaar ||

178.g: ਤਬ ਧਰਤ ਬਿਸਨ ਰੁਦ੍ਰਾਵਤਾਰ ॥੭॥
178.t: tab dharat bisan rudhraavataar ||7||
178.e: Then she goes and shouts loudly in the milk-ocean and the Rudra incarnation of Vishnu is manifested.7.

178.g: ਤਬ ਕਰਤ ਸਕਲ ਦਾਨਵ ਸੰਘਾਰ ॥
178.t: tab karat sakal dhaanav sa(n)ghaar ||

178.g: ਕਰਿ ਦਨੁਜ ਪ੍ਰਲਵ ਸੰਤਨ ਉਧਾਰ ॥
178.t: kar dhanuj pralav sa(n)tan udhaar ||
178.e: After manifestation, Rudra destroys the demons and crushing them, he protects the saints.

178.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਸਕਲ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਸਟ ਨਾਸ ॥
178.t: eeh bhaat sakal kar dhusaT naas ||

178.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਕਰਤਿ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਬਾਸ ॥੮॥
178.t: pun karat hiradhai bhagavaan baas ||8||
178.e: In this way, destroying all the tyrants, he then abides in the heart of his devotees.8.

178.g: ਤੋਟਕ ਛੰਦ ॥
178.t: toTak chha(n)dh ||
178.e: TOTAK STANZA

178.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪੁਰੈ ਇਕ ਦੈਤ ਬਢਿਯੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੁਰੰ ॥
178.t: tirapurai ik dhait baddiyo tirapura(n) ||

178.g: ਜਿਹ ਤੇਜ ਤਪੈ ਰਵਿ ਜਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੁਰੰ ॥
178.t: jeh tej tapai rav jiau tirapura(n) ||
178.e: In Trupura State lived a three-eyed demons, whose glory was equal to the glory of the Sun, which spread over the three worlds.

178.g: ਬਰਦਾਇ ਮਹਾਸੁਰ ਐਸ ਭਯੋ ॥
178.t: baradhai mahaasur aais bhayo ||

178.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਚਤੁਰਦਸ ਜੀਤ ਲਯੋ ॥੯॥
178.t: jin lok chaturadhas jeet layo ||9||
178.e: After receiving the boon, that demons become so powerful that he conquered all the fourteen regions of the universe.9.

178.g: ਜੋਊ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਬਾਣ ਹਣੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੁਰੰ ॥
178.t: jouoo ek hee baan hane tirapura(n) ||

178.g: ਸੋਊ ਨਾਸ ਕਰੈ ਤਿਹ ਦੈਤ ਦੁਰੰ ॥
178.t: souoo naas karai teh dhait dhura(n) ||
178.e: (That demon had this boon) that anyone who had the power to kill him with one arrow, he only could kill that terrible demon.

178.g: ਅਸ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਯੋ ਕਬਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਗਨੈ ॥
178.t: as ko pragaTiyo kab taeh ganai ||

178.g: ਇਕ ਬਾਣ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਪੁਰ ਤੀਨ ਹਨੈ ॥੧੦॥
178.t: eik baan hee so pur teen hanai ||10||
178.e: The poet now wants to describe that mighty warrior who could kill that three-eyed demon with one arrow.10.

179.g: ਸਿਵ ਧਾਇ ਚਲਿਯੋ ਤਿਹ ਮਾਰਨ ਕੋ ॥
179.t: siv dhai chaliyo teh maaran ko ||

179.g: ਜਗ ਕੇ ਸਬ ਜੀਵ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਕੋ ॥
179.t: jag ke sab jeev udhaaran ko ||
179.e: For the protection of the beings of the world and the killing of that demon, the god Shiva moved forward.

179.g: ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪਿ ਤਜਿਯੋ ਸਿਤ ਸੁਧ ਸਰੰ ॥
179.t: kar kop tajiyo sit sudh sara(n) ||

179.g: ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ਹੀ ਨਾਸ ਕੀਯੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੁਰੰ ॥੧੧॥
179.t: eik baar hee naas keeyo tirapura(n) ||11||
179.e: In great fury, shot one arrow and only with arrow, he destroyed that demon of Tripura, named Tripura.11.

179.g: ਲਖਿ ਕਉਤੁਕ ਸਾਧ ਸਬੈ ਹਰਖੇ ॥
179.t: lakh kautuk saadh sabai harakhe ||

179.g: ਸੁਮਨੰ ਬਰਖਾ ਨਭ ਤੇ ਬਰਖੇ ॥
179.t: sumana(n) barakhaa nabh te barakhe ||
179.e: Seeing this performance all the saints were pleased and gods showered flowers form heaven.

179.g: ਧੁਨਿ ਪੂਰ ਰਹੀ ਜਯ ਸਦ ਹੂਅੰ ॥
179.t: dhun poor rahee jay sadh hooa(n) ||

179.g: ਗਿਰਿ ਹੇਮ ਹਲਾਚਲ ਕੰਪ ਭੂਅੰ ॥੧੨॥
179.t: gir hem halaachal ka(n)p bhooa(n) ||12||
179.e: The sound of “hail, hail” resound, there was consternation on Himalaya mountain and the earth tembled.12.

179.g: ਦਿਨ ਕੇਤਕ ਬੀਤ ਗਏ ਜਬ ਹੀ ॥
179.t: dhin ketak beet ge jab hee ||

179.g: ਅਸੁਰੰਧਕ ਬੀਰ ਬੀਯੋ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
179.t: asura(n)dhak beer beeyo tab hee ||
179.e: After a long time, another demons named Andhakasura came on the scene

179.g: ਤਬ ਬੈਲਿ ਚੜਿਯੋ ਗਹਿ ਸੂਲ ਸਿਵੰ ॥
179.t: tab bail chaRiyo geh sool siva(n) ||

179.g: ਸੁਰ ਚਉਕਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਕਿਵੰ ॥੧੩॥
179.t: sur chauk chale har kop kiva(n) ||13||
179.e: Mounting his bull and holding his trident, Shiva moved forward (to chastise him). Seeing his terrible form, the gods were also startled.13.

179.g: ਗਣ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਜਛ ਸਬੈ ਉਰਗੰ ॥
179.t: gan ga(n)dhrab jachh sabai uraga(n) ||

179.g: ਬਰਦਾਨ ਦਯੋ ਸਿਵ ਕੋ ਦੁਰਗੰ ॥
179.t: baradhaan dhayo siv ko dhuraga(n) ||
179.e: Shiva marched forward alongwith Ganas, Gandharavas, Yakshas and Nagas and Durga also granted boon to him.

179.g: ਹਨਿਹੋ ਨਿਰਖੰਤ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਸੁਰੰ ॥
179.t: haniho nirakha(n)t muraar sura(n) ||

179.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪੁਰਾਰਿ ਹਨਿਯੋ ਜਿਮ ਕੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੁਰੰ ॥੧੪॥
179.t: tirapuraar haniyo jim kai tirapura(n) ||14||
179.e: The gods began to see that Shiva would kill Andhakasura in the same way as he had killed the demon Tripura.14.

179.g: ਉਹ ਓਰਿ ਚੜੇ ਦਲ ਲੈ ਦੁਜਨੰ ॥
179.t: auh or chaRe dhal lai dhujana(n) ||

179.g: ਇਹ ਓਰ ਰਿਸ੍ਰਯੋ ਗਹਿ ਸੂਲ ਸਿਵੰ ॥
179.t: eeh or risrayo geh sool siva(n) ||
179.e: Form the other side that demons of vicious intellect started. From this side in great fury and holding the trident in his hand, Shiva moved.

179.g: ਰਣ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਣਧੀਰ ਰਣੰ ॥
179.t: ran ra(n)g ra(n)ge ranadheer rana(n) ||

179.g: ਜਨ ਸੋਭਤ ਪਾਵਕ ਜੁਆਲ ਬਣੰ ॥੧੫॥
179.t: jan sobhat paavak juaal bana(n) ||15||
179.e: Intoxicated with war-tactics, the mighty warriors presented the scene like the blazing flames of fire in the forst.15.

179.g: ਦਨੁ ਦੇਵ ਦੋਊ ਰਣ ਰੰਗ ਰਚੇ ॥
179.t: dhan dhev dhouoo ran ra(n)g rache ||

179.g: ਗਹਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਬੈ ਰਸ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਮਚੇ ॥
179.t: geh sasatr sabai ras rudhr mache ||
179.e: Both the demons and gods became absorbed in the war and bedecking themselves with weapons all the warriors enjoyed the relish of anger.

179.g: ਸਰ ਛਾਡਤ ਬੀਰ ਦੋਊ ਹਰਖੈ ॥
179.t: sar chhaaddat beer dhouoo harakhai ||

179.g: ਜਨੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਲੈ ਘਨ ਸੈ ਬਰਖੈ ॥੧੬॥
179.t: jan a(n)t pralai ghan sai barakhai ||16||
179.e: The warriors of both the sides enjoyed the shooting of arrows and the arrows are being showered like the raining of clouds on the doomsday.16.

180.e: RUAAMAL STANZA

180.g: ਘਾਇ ਖਾਇ ਭਜੇ ਸੁਰਾਰਦਨ ਕੋਪੁ ਓਪ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥
180.t: ghai khai bhaje suraaradhan kop op miTai ||

180.g: ਅੰਧਿ ਕੰਧਿ ਫਿਰਿਯੋ ਤਬੈ ਜਯ ਦੁੰਦਭੀਨ ਬਜਾਇ ॥
180.t: a(n)dh ka(n)dh firiyo tabai jay dhu(n)dhabheen bajai ||
180.e: The demons being wounded and becoming weak began to run away and at that time, Andhakasura, resounding his drums turned and moved towards the battlefield.

180.g: ਸੂਲ ਸੈਹਥਿ ਪਰਿਘ ਪਟਸਿ ਬਾਣ ਓਘ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ ॥
180.t: sool saihath parigh paTas baan ogh prahaar ||
180.e: The blows were struck with tridents, swords, arrows and other weapons and arms and the warriors swung and fell

180.g: ਪੇਲਿ ਪੇਲਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਸੁ ਬੀਰਨ ਖੇਲ ਜਾਨੁ ਧਮਾਰ ॥੧੭॥
180.t: pel pel gire su beeran khel jaan dhamaar ||17||
180.e: It seemed that there was a programme of dance and amorous pastime.17.

180.g: ਸੇਲ ਰੇਲ ਭਈ ਤਹਾ ਅਰੁ ਤੇਗ ਤੀਰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ ॥
180.t: sel rel bhiee tahaa ar teg teer prahaar ||

180.g: ਗਾਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ਫਿਰੇ ਫਵਜਨ ਬਾਹਿ ਬਾਹਿ ਹਥਿਯਾਰ ॥
180.t: gaeh gaeh fire favajan baeh baeh hathiyaar ||
180.e: With the blows of swords and arrows, there was consternation in the battlefield and striking their weapons, the warriors were stirring up the armies.

180.g: ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗ ਪਰੇ ਕਹੂੰ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਸ੍ਰੋਨਤ ਪੂਰ ॥
180.t: a(n)g bha(n)g pare kahoo(n) saraba(n)g sronat poor ||
180.e: Somewhere the limbless fighters and somewhere the complete bodies are immersed in blood

180.g: ਏਕ ਏਕ ਬਰੀ ਅਨੇਕਨ ਹੇਰਿ ਹੇਰਿ ਸੁ ਹੂਰ ॥੧੮॥
180.t: ek ek baree anekan her her su hoor ||18||
180.e: The warriors who had attained martyrdom, are wedding the heavenly damsels, after making search for them.18.

180.g: ਚਉਰ ਚੀਰ ਰਥੀ ਰਥੋਤਮ ਬਾਜ ਰਾਜ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
180.t: chaur cheer rathee rathotam baaj raaj ana(n)t ||

180.g: ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਕੀ ਸਰਤਾ ਉਠੀ ਸੁ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਰੂਪ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥
180.t: sron kee sarataa uThee su bia(n)t roop dhura(n)t ||
180.e: The garments, chariots, the chariot-riders and many horses are lying hither and thither and a dreadful stream of blood is flowing in the battlefield.

180.g: ਸਾਜ ਬਾਜ ਕਟੇ ਕਹੂੰ ਗਜ ਰਾਜ ਤਾਜ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
180.t: saaj baaj kaTe kahoo(n) gaj raaj taaj anek ||
180.e: Somewhere the bedecked horses and elephants are lying chopped and

180.g: ਉਸਟਿ ਪੁਸਟਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਕਹੂੰ ਰਿਪੁ ਬਾਚੀਯੰ ਨਹੀ ਏਕੁ ॥੧੯॥
180.t: ausaT pusaT gire kahoo(n) rip baacheeya(n) nahee ek ||19||
180.e: Somewhere there are heaps of warriors lying down  not a single enemy hath remained alive.19.

180.g: ਛਾਡਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਚਲੇ ਤਹਾ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸਾਜ ਬਾਜ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
180.t: chhaadd chhaadd chale tahaa nirap saaj baaj ana(n)t ||

180.g: ਗਾਜ ਗਾਜ ਹਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਵ ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥
180.t: gaaj gaaj hane sadhaa siv soorabeer dhura(n)t ||
180.e: The kings have abandoned their bedecked horses and elephants and gone away and the god Shiva, shouting very loudly, hath destroyed the mighty warriors.

180.g: ਭਾਜ ਭਾਜ ਚਲੇ ਹਠੀ ਹਥਿਆਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
180.t: bhaaj bhaaj chale haThee hathiaar haath bisaar ||

180.g: ਬਾਣ ਪਾਣ ਕਮਾਣ ਛਾਡਿ ਸੁ ਚਰਮ ਬਰਮ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੨੦॥
180.t: baan paan kamaan chhaadd su charam baram bisaar ||20||
180.e: The brave fighters have also abandoned their weapons and gone away, after leaving behind their bows and arrows and steel-armors.20.
All the warriors who go in front of him, Rudra destroys them all, those who will advance, will also be destroyed by Shiva.21.
The blind (headless) trunks are rising in the battlefield and casting special showers of arrows.
Innumerable warriors, shooting arrows from their bows are exhibiting proof of their bravery.22.
RASAAVAL STANZA
Bedecked with the steel-armour, the warriors are thundering on all the four sides.
The wanton mighty heroes are irresistible.23.
The horrible sound of musical instruments is being heard and the bedecked warriors are being seen.
The bows are crackling like the thundering of the clouds.24.
The gods, holding their bows, are also moving,
And all the brave fighters, being pleased, are showering their arrows.25.
Holding their bows in their hands, excessively glorious and proud warriors have marched forward,
And with the clattering of their weapons, the bodies of the enemies are being chopped into two parts.26.
Seeing the fury of Rudra, the weak demons are running away.
Bedecked with their armour, they mighty warriors are thundering.27.

181.e: Holding the Shakti (his power) in his hands the supremely glorious Shiva,
Thundering dreadfully, is absorbed in war, and is looking impressive.28.
The blood is oozing out of the wounds and all the fighters are fighting with enthusiasm.
The vampires are pleased and the horses etc, are rolling in dust.29.
Rudra, in great fury, hath destroyed the demons,
And hath chopped their bodies into bits and killed the army.30.
Shiva, the holder of the trident, is in extreme anger and he hath destroyed the demons.
The arrows are being showered like the raining clouds.31.
When Rudra thundered in the battlefield, then all the demons ran away.
All of them abandoned their weapons and the pride of all was shattered.32.
CHAUPAI
At that time, the mighty Andhakasura, alongwith the army of demons sped towards the fornt.
He discharged many arrows on Nandi, which penetrated through his limbs.33.

181.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਬਾਣ ਲਗੇ ਬਾਹਣ ਤਨਿ ॥
181.t: jab hee baan lage baahan tan ||

181.g: ਰੋਸ ਜਗਿਯੋ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਸਿਵ ਕੇ ਮਨਿ ॥
181.t: ros jagiyo tab hee siv ke man ||
181.e: When the god Shiva saw the infliction of the arrows on his vehicle, then he became violently furious.
With great ire, he discharge his poisonous arrows, which spread over the earth and sky in an instant.34.
When Rudra shot his arrows, the army of demons sped away.
Then Andhakasura came in front of Shiva, a dreadful war ensured.35.
ARIL

181.g: ਬੀਸ ਬਾਣ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ਕੋਪ ਕਰਿ ॥
181.t: bees baan tin siveh prahaare kop kar ||

181.g: ਲਗੇ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਗਾਤ ਗਏ ਓਹ ਘਾਨਿ ਕਰ ॥
181.t: lage rudhr ke gaat ge oh ghaan kar ||
181.e: The demons, highly infuriated, discharged twenty arrows on Shiva, which struck the body of Shiva and wounded it.

181.g: ਗਹਿ ਪਿਨਾਕ ਕਹ ਪਾਣਿ ਪਿਨਾਕੀ ਧਾਇਓ ॥
181.t: geh pinaak keh paan pinaakee dhaio ||

181.g: ਹੋ ਤੁਮੁਲ ਜੁਧੁ ਦੁਹੂੰਅਨ ਰਣ ਮਧਿ ਮਚਾਇਓ ॥੩੬॥
181.t: ho tumul judh dhuhoo(n)an ran madh machaio ||36||
181.e: Shiva also ran forward, holding his bow in his hand and a fearful war began between them.36.

181.g: ਤਾੜਿ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਹ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਪਿਨਾਕੀ ਕੋਪੁ ਹੁਐ ॥
181.t: taaR satr keh bahur pinaakee kop huaai ||

181.g: ਹਣੈ ਦੁਸਟ ਕਹੁ ਬਾਣ ਨਿਖੰਗ ਤੇ ਕਾਢ ਦੁਐ ॥
181.t: hanai dhusaT kahu baan nikha(n)g te kaadd dhuaai ||
181.e: Then Shiva took out tow arrow from his quiver, and aiming them at the tyrant, he discharged them in great anger.

181.g: ਗਿਰਿਯੋ ਭੂਮਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਿਯੋ ॥
181.t: giriyo bhoom bheetar sir satr prahaariyo ||
181.e: The arrows struck the head of the enemy and he fell down on the earth

181.g: ਹੋ ਜਨਕੁ ਗਾਜ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਬੁਰਜ ਕਹੁ ਮਾਰਿਯੋ ॥੩੭॥
181.t: ho janak gaaj kar kop buraj kahu maariyo ||37||
181.e: He fell like a column falling flat on the ground having been hit by lightning.37.
TOTAK STANZA

181.g: ਘਟਿ ਏਕ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਿਪੁ ਚੇਤ ਭਯੋ ॥
181.t: ghaT ek bikhai rip chet bhayo ||

181.g: ਧਨੁ ਬਾਣ ਬਲੀ ਪੁਨਿ ਪਾਣਿ ਲਯੋ ॥
181.t: dhan baan balee pun paan layo ||
181.e: After one ghari (about 24 mintues), the enemy (Andhakasura) regained his senses and that mighty warrior again took bow and arrows in his hands.

181.g: ਸਰ ਧਾਰ ਬਲੀ ਘਨ ਜਿਯੋ ਬਰਖ੍ਰਯੋ ॥੩੮॥
181.t: sar dhaar balee ghan jiyo barakhrayo ||38||
181.e: The bow was pulled in his hands in great anger and a volley of arrows was showered like rain.38.
In great ire, that mighty warrior began to discharge and shower his distinctively powerful arrows, which struck on one side came out from the other side.

182.g: ਤਬ ਕੋਪ ਕਰੰ ਸਿਵ ਸੂਲ ਲੀਯੋ ॥
182.t: tab kop kara(n) siv sool leeyo ||

182.g: ਅਰਿ ਕੋ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੁਖੰਡ ਕੀਯੋ ॥੩੯॥
182.t: ar ko sir kaaT dhukha(n)dd keeyo ||39||
182.e: Then greatly infuriated, Shiva took the trident in his hand, and cut the head of the enemy into two parts.39.

182.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਪਿਨਾਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧਹਿ ਅੰਧਕ ਬਧਹਿ ਰੁਦ੍ਰੋਸਤਤਿ ਧਯਾਇ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧੦॥
182.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake pinaak praba(n)dheh a(n)dhak badheh rudhrosatat dhayai samaapatam sat subham sat ||10||
182.e: End of the description of the killing of the demon ANDHAK and the Eulogy of SHIVA in BACHITTAR NATAK.
Now begins the description of the killing of Parbati:
Let Sri Bhagauti ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.
TOTAK STANZA

182.g: ਸੁਰ ਰਾਜ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਿ ਭਏ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
182.t: sur raaj prasa(n)n bhe tab hee ||

182.g: ਅਰਿ ਅੰਧਕ ਨਾਸ ਸੁਨਿਯੋ ਜਬ ਹੀ ॥
182.t: ar a(n)dhak naas suniyo jab hee ||
182.e: When Indra heard about the destruction of Andhakasura he was very much pleased.

182.g: ਇਮ ਕੈ ਦਿਨ ਕੇਤਕ ਬੀਤ ਗਏ ॥
182.t: eim kai dhin ketak beet ge ||

182.e: In this way, may days elapsed and Shiva also went to Indra’s place.1.
Then Rudra manifested himself in a dreadful form  seeing Shiva, Indra discharged his wapons.

182.g: ਤਬ ਹੀ ਸਿਵ ਕੋਪ ਅਖੰਡ ਕੀਯੋ ॥
182.t: tab hee siv kop akha(n)dd keeyo ||

182.e: Then Shiva was highly infuriated and blazed like a live charcoal.2.

182.g: ਤਿਹ ਤੇਜ ਜਰੇ ਜਗ ਜੀਵ ਸਬੈ ॥
182.t: teh tej jare jag jeev sabai ||

182.g: ਤਿਹ ਡਾਰ ਦਯੋ ਮਧਿ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਤਬੈ ॥
182.t: teh ddaar dhayo madh si(n)dh tabai ||
182.e: With that blaze, all the beings of the world began to burn. Then Shiva in order to pacify his anger threw his weapon and anger into the sea

182.g: ਸੋਊ ਡਾਰ ਦਯੋ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਮਹਿ ਨ ਗਯੋ ॥
182.t: souoo ddaar dhayo si(n)dh meh na gayo ||

182.e: But it could not be drowned and manifested itself in the from of the demon Jalandhar.3.
CHAUPAI
In this way, this demon grew in strength excessively and he also looted the treasure of Kuber.
He caught Brahma and caused him to weep, and conquering Indra, He seized his canopy and swung over his head.4.
After conquering the gods, he caused them to fall at his feet and forced Vishnu and Shiva to abide only within their own cities.l
He gathered all the fourteen jewels in his own house and fixed the polaces on nine planets at his will.5.
DOHRA

182.g: ਜੀਤਿ ਬਸਾਏ ਨਿਜ ਪੁਰੀ ਅਸੁਰ ਸਕਲ ਅਸੁਰਾਰ ॥
182.t: jeet basaae nij puree asur sakal asuraar ||
182.e: The demon-king, conquering all, caused them to live in his own territory.

182.g: ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰੀ ਮਹੇਸ ਕੀ ਗਿਰਿ ਕੈਲਾਸ ਮਧਾਰ ॥੬॥
182.t: poojaa karee mahes kee gir kailaas madhaar ||6||
182.e: The gods went to Kailash mountain and worshipped him.6.
CHAUPAI
They performed various types of mediation, worship and service day and service day and night for a long time.
Now everything depended on the support of Shiva.7.

182.g: ਕਾਪਤ ਭਏ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਰਿ ਜਲ ਥਲ ॥
182.t: kaapat bhe anik ar jal thal ||
182.e: All the enemies on water and land trembled, seeing the innumerable forces of Shiva, the lord of ghosts.

182.g: ਦਸ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਦੁਹਿਤਾ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਘਰ ॥੮॥
182.t: dhas saha(n)sr dhuhitaa taa ke ghar ||8||
182.e: Out of all the kings, the king Daksha was most respected, who had ten thousand daughters in his home.8.
Once that king held a swayyamvara at his place and permitted his ten thousand daughters.

182.g: ਜੋ ਬਰੁ ਰੁਚੇ ਬਰਹੁ ਅਬ ਸੋਈ ॥
182.t: jo bar ruche barahu ab soiee ||

182.e: To wed according to their interest forsaking all thought of high and low in society.9.

182.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਿਸੈ ਰੁਚਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਬਰਾ ॥
182.t: jo jo jisai ruchaa tin baraa ||

182.e: Each one of them wed whomsoever she liked, but all such anecdotes cannot be described
It all of them are narrated in detail, then there will always be the fear of increasing the volume.10.

183.e: Four daughters were given to the sage Kashyap, and many of the daughters married the god Chandrama (moon).
Many of them went to foreign countries, but Guri (Parvait) named and married Shiva.11.

183.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਬ੍ਯਾਹ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਨੀ ॥
183.t: jab hee bayaeh rudhr gireh aanee ||

183.e: When, after wedding, Parvati reached the home of Shiva (Rudra), the many types of narratives became prevalent.
The king called all his daughters and all of them came to their father’s home alongwith their husband.12.
All the kings within and outside the country, began to reach at the house of their father-in-law.
Considering the queer dressing habits of Rudra, no one could think of him.13.
The king Daksha did not invite Gauri  then Gauri heard about it from the mouth of Narad, she got extremely angry in her mind.

183.g: ਬਿਨ ਬੋਲੇ ਪਿਤ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਗਈ ॥
183.t: bin bole pit ke gireh giee ||

183.e: She went to her father’s house without telling anybody, and her body and mind were emotionally blazing.14.

183.g: ਜਗ ਕੁੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਪਰੀ ਉਛਰ ਕਰਿ ॥
183.t: jag ku(n)dd meh paree uchhar kar ||

183.e: Being extremely infuriated, she plunged into the sacrificial pit, and because of her dignified demeanour, the fire cooled down.

183.g: ਤਾ ਤਨ ਕੀਯੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੋ ਨਾਸਾ ॥੧੫॥
183.t: taa tan keeyo praan ko naasaa ||15||
183.e: But Sati (Parvati) lighted her Yoga-fire and with that fire, her body was destroyed.15.
Narad, on the other side, came to Shiva and said, “Why art thou sitting here, having been intoxicated with hemp (and there Guari hath burnt herself alive)?”

183.g: ਗਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸੂਲ ਤਹ ਕੋ ਉਠ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧੬॥
183.t: geh tirasool teh ko uTh bhaagaa ||16||
183.e: Hearing this, Shiva’s meditation was shattered and his heart was filled with rage  he held up his trident and ran towards that side.16.

183.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਭਯੋ ਤਿਹ ਥਲੈ ॥
183.t: jab hee jaat bhayo teh thalai ||

184.e: When Shiva reached the place where Sati had burnt herself, he caught his trident also very firmly.
With blows of various types, he destroyed the merit of the whole Yajna (sacrifice).17.

184.g: ਇਕ ਇਕ ਤੇ ਕਰ ਦੁਇ ਦੁਇ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
184.t: eik ik te kar dhui dhui ddaare ||
184.e: He destroyed many kings and chopped their bodies into bits.

184.g: ਤਾ ਕਹੁ ਮਾਰ ਠਉਰ ਹੀ ਡਾਰਾ ॥੧੮॥
184.t: taa kahu maar Thaur hee ddaaraa ||18||
184.e: On whomsoever the blow of the trident struck, he died there and then.18.

184.g: ਜਗ ਕੁੰਡ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਭਯੋ ਜਬ ਹੀ ॥
184.t: jag ku(n)dd nirakhat bhayo jab hee ||

184.e: When Shiva looked into the sacrificial pit and saw he burnt body of Gauri, he began to pluck his matted hair.
At that time, Virbhandra manifested himself there and after his manifestation, he began to destroy the kings.19.

184.g: ਕੇਤਕ ਪਠੈ ਦਏ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ॥
184.t: ketak paThai dhe jam ke ghar ||
184.e: He chopped several kings into part and sent several of them to the abode of Yama.
Just as with the flooding of the stream, the banks are eroded further, likewise many terrible warriors began to fall on the earth.20.
At that time, Shiva regained his senses and fell on the enemy with his bow in his hand.

184.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਤਾਣਿ ਬਾਣ ਤਨ ਮਾਰਾ ॥
184.t: jaa kai taan baan tan maaraa ||

184.e: Whomsoever Shiva struck his arrow by pulling his bow, he breathed his last there and then.21.
The tabors began to resound and in all the ten directions, the ghosts and fiends began to roar.

184.g: ਝਿਮ ਝਿਮ ਕਰਤ ਅਸਿਨ ਕੀ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
184.t: jhim jhim karat asin kee dhaaraa ||

184.e: The swords glittered and their blows were showered and the headless trunks began to dance on all the four sides.22.
The trumpets and drums resounded and their sound was heard  the warriors fought bravely in the war.

184.g: ਖਹਿ ਖਹਿ ਮਰੇ ਅਪਰ ਰਿਸ ਬਢੇ ॥
184.t: kheh kheh mare apar ris badde ||

184.e: They collided with one another, being filled with great anger, and they were never seen again, riding on their horses.23.
On whomsoever, there was the blow of the trident, held in the fist of Shiva, he was killed there and then,
