Virbhadra foutht such a fierce fight, that in great confusion, the ghosts and fiends were awakened.24.
DOHRA

184.g: ਤੀਰ ਤਬਰ ਬਰਛੀ ਬਿਛੂਅ ਬਰਸੇ ਬਿਸਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
184.t: teer tabar barachhee bichhooa barase bisakh anek ||
184.e: The arrows, daggers, lances and other types of weapons were showered,

184.g: ਸਬ ਸੂਰਾ ਜੂਝਤ ਭਏ ਸਾਬਤ ਬਚਾ ਨ ਏਕ ॥੨੫॥
184.t: sab sooraa joojhat bhe saabat bachaa na ek ||25||
184.e: And all the warriors fell as martyrs and none remained alive.25.
CHAUPAI

184.g: ਬਾਇ ਹਨੇ ਗਿਰਿ ਗੇ ਜਨੁ ਝੰਡਾ ॥
184.t: bai hane gir ge jan jha(n)ddaa ||
184.e: The kings, chopped into bits, were lying the cluster of trees fallen down by the blow of wind.
When Rudra, holding his trident wrought the destruction, then the scence of that place looked very queer.26.
Then the kings, forgetting the Yajna, began to run away to their countries.

184.g: ਜਬ ਰਣ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਹੁਐ ਧਾਏ ॥
184.t: jab ran rudhr rudhr huaai dhaae ||

184.e: When Rudra pursued them as fury-incarnate, then none of the running kings could survive.27.

184.g: ਤਬ ਸਬ ਭਰੇ ਤੇਜ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
184.t: tab sab bhare tej tan raajaa ||

184.e: Then all the kings, becoming alert, were highly activated and the musical instruments resounded from all the sides.

184.g: ਜਮ ਕੋ ਭਰਾ ਛਿਨਕ ਮਹਿ ਧਾਮਾ ॥੨੮॥
184.t: jam ko bharaa chhinak meh dhaamaa ||28||
184.e: Then the war become more intense and the house of Yama began to be filled with the dead.28.

185.e: The kings returned with several kinds of arrows and weapons for waging the war.
They began to strike blows speedily like the strokes on the gong.29.
The mighty warriors began to fall as bits and the nine regions of the world trembled.
Forsaking their swords, the kings began to fall down and there was dreadful scene in the battlefield.30.
NARAAJ STANZA
The warriors riding on the horses, coming down, began to roam, holding their weapons
The arrows were discharged and the bows crackled.31.
The sword began to fall and the dust rose from the earth upwards.
On one side, the sharp arrows are being discharged and on the other side people are repeating request for water.32.
The vultures are swooping down and the warriors equal in strength are fighting.
Durga is laughing and the glittering swords are being struck.33.
BRIDH NARAAJ STANZA

185.g: ਸੁ ਮਾਰੁ ਮਾਰ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਮਾਰ ਕੇ ਚਲੇ ॥
185.t: s maar maar sooramaa pukaar maar ke chale ||

185.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੇ ਗਣੋ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਬੀਰਹਾ ਦਲੇ ॥
185.t: ana(n)t rudhr ke gano bia(n)t beerahaa dhale ||
185.e: The brave fighters marched forward with their shouts of “kill, kill”. And form this side, the ganas of Rudra destroyed innumerable warriors.

185.g: ਘਮੰਡ ਘੋਰ ਸਾਵਣੀ ਅਘੋਰ ਜਿਉ ਘਟਾ ਉਠੀ ॥
185.t: ghama(n)dd ghor saavanee aghor jiau ghaTaa uThee ||

185.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਬਾਣ ਧਾਰ ਸੁਧ ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਕੈ ਬੁਠੀ ॥੩੪॥
185.t: ana(n)t boo(n)dh baan dhaar sudh krudh kai buThee ||34||
185.e: The furious arrows are being showered like the drops from the visible rising dark thundering clouds in the month of Sawan.34.
NARAAJ STANZA
Many warriors are running forward and with their blows are wounding the enemies.
Many warriors, being wounded, are roaming and showering arrows.35.
Bedecked with several arms, the warriors are marching forward and thundering
And striking their blows fearlessly, are shouting “kill, kill”.36.
Preparing themselves like the thundering dark clouds, the brave fighters are marching forward.
Bedecked with weapons, they are looking so beautiful that the daughters of the gods are getting allured by them.37.
They are very selective in wedding the warriors and all the heroes are moving about and looking impressive in the battlefield like Indra, the king of gods.
All those kings, who are frightened, they have been abandoned by the daughters of the gods.38.
BRIDH NARAAJ STANZA

185.g: ਸੁ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਜ ਕੈ ਪਰੇ ਹੁਕਾਰ ਕੈ ਹਠੀ ॥
185.t: s sasatr asatr saj kai pare hukaar kai haThee ||

185.g: ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਬਨਾਇ ਸੈਣ ਏਕਠੀ ॥
185.t: bilok rudhr rudhr ko banai sain ekaThee ||
185.e: The warriors thundering dreadfully and bedecked with arms and weapons fell (on the enemy) and seeing the anger of Rudra, they gathered all the forces.

185.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਘੋਰ ਸਾਵਣੀ ਦੁਰੰਤ ਜਿਯੋ ਉਠੀ ਘਟਾ ॥
185.t: ana(n)t ghor saavanee dhura(n)t jiyo uThee ghaTaa ||

185.g: ਸੁ ਸੋਭ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਨਚੈ ਸੁ ਛੀਨਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਛਟਾ ॥੩੯॥
185.t: s sobh sooramaa nachai su chheen chhatr kee chhaTaa ||39||
185.e: They gathered quickly like the rising and thundering clouds of Sawan and gathering the glory of heaven in themselves, began to dance, being highly intoxicated.39.

185.g: ਕੰਪਾਇ ਖਗ ਪਾਣ ਮੋ ਤ੍ਰਪਾਇ ਤਾਜੀਯਨ ਤਹਾ ॥
185.t: ka(n)pai khag paan mo trapai taajeeyan tahaa ||

186.g: ਜੁਆਨ ਆਨ ਕੇ ਪਰੇ ਸੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਠਾਢਿਬੋ ਜਹਾ ॥
186.t: juaan aan ke pare su rudhr Thaaddibo jahaa ||
186.e: Holding their swords in their hands and galloping their horses, the mighty youthful warriors stopped there, where Rudra was standing.

186.g: ਬਿਅੰਤ ਬਾਣ ਸੈਹਥੀ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ ਆਨ ਕੇ ਕਰੈ ॥
186.t: bia(n)t baan saihathee prahaar aan ke karai ||

186.g: ਧਕੇਲਿ ਰੇਲਿ ਲੈ ਚਲੈ ਪਛੇਲ ਪਾਵ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥੪੦॥
186.t: dhakel rel lai chalai pachhel paav na Tarai ||40||
186.e: The brave fighters began to inflict blows with many types of arrows and weapons and forcibly moved forward, without retracing their steps.40.

186.g: ਸੜਕ ਸੂਲ ਸੈਹਥੀ ਤੜਕ ਤੇਗ ਤੀਰਯੰ ॥
186.t: saRak sool saihathee taRak teg teeraya(n) ||

186.g: ਬਬਕ ਬਾਘ ਜਿਯੋ ਬਲੀ ਭਭਕ ਘਾਇ ਬੀਰਯੰ ॥
186.t: babak baagh jiyo balee bhabhak ghai beeraya(n) ||
186.e: The clattering of daggers and sword is being heard  the warriors are wounding one another, roaring like lions.

186.g: ਅਘਾਇ ਘਾਇ ਕੇ ਗਿਰੇ ਪਛੇਲ ਪਾਵ ਨ ਟਰੇ ॥
186.t: aghai ghai ke gire pachhel paav na Tare ||

186.g: ਸੁ ਬੀਨ ਬੀਨ ਅਛਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਹੁਐ ਬਰੇ ॥੪੧॥
186.t: s been been achharai prabeen dheen huaai bare ||41||
186.e: On getting wounded the warriors are falling down, but are not retracing their steps.41.

186.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੂਝਿ ਗਿਰਿਯੋ ਸਭ ਸਾਥਾ ॥
186.t: eeh bidh joojh giriyo sabh saathaa ||

186.e: In this way, all his companions fell down and Daksha was only left behind.
He called again his remaining fighters and wearing his armour, he caused the resounding of the musical instrument.42.
The king Daksha, moved forward, with the strength of the innumerable warriors.

186.g: ਜਨੁ ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਹੁਐ ਗਯੋ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥੪੩॥
186.t: jan dhin te huaai gayo a(n)dhaaraa ||43||
186.e: Innumerable arrows were discharged from his bow and such a scene was crated that there was darkness during the day.43.
The ghosts and friends began to shout and the tabors resounded from both the sides.
A fierce fighting ensued and it appeared that the war was going on between Rama and Ravana in Sri Lanka.44.

186.g: ਭਯੋ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੋਪੰ ਧਰਿਯੋ ਸੂਲ ਪਾਣੰ ॥
186.t: bhayo rudhr kopa(n) dhariyo sool paana(n) ||

186.e: In great ire, Rudra held his trident in his hand and vacating the saddles of many horses, he killed many warriors.

186.g: ਉਤੇ ਏਕ ਦਛੰ ਇਤੈ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਏਕੰ ॥
186.t: aute ek dhachha(n) itai rudhr eka(n) ||

187.g: ਕਰਿਯੋ ਕੋਪ ਕੈ ਜੁਧ ਭਾਤੰ ਅਨੇਕੰ ॥੪੫॥
187.t: kariyo kop kai judh bhaata(n) aneka(n) ||45||
187.e: On the other side Daksha was alone on this side, Rudra was also alone  both of them highly infuriated, waged the war in many ways.45.

187.g: ਗਿਰਿਯੋ ਦਛ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਟਿਯੋ ਸੀਸ ਸੂਲੰ ॥
187.t: giriyo dhachh taise kaTiyo sees soola(n) ||
187.e: Rudra chopped the head Daksha with his trident and he fell down like an uprooted tree.

187.g: ਪਰਿਯੋ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਜੰ ਭਯੋ ਦੇਹ ਘਾਤੰ ॥
187.t: pariyo raaj raaja(n) bhayo dheh ghaata(n) ||

187.g: ਹਨਿਯੋ ਜਾਨ ਬਜ੍ਰੰ ਭਯੋ ਪਬ ਪਾਤੰ ॥੪੬॥
187.t: haniyo jaan bajra(n) bhayo pab paata(n) ||46||
187.e: Daksha, the king of kings, fell down after his head was cut and he looked like the fallen mountain, whose wings had been cut by Indra with his weapon Vajra.46.
All the pride of Daksha was shattered and the mighty Rudra destroyed him completely.

187.g: ਗਰੇ ਡਾਰ ਅੰਚਰ ਪਰੈ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
187.t: gare ddaar a(n)char parai rudhr paayo ||

187.g: ਅਹੋ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੀਜੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਾਯੰ ॥੪੭॥
187.t: aho rudhr keejai kirapaa kai sahaaya(n) ||47||
187.e: Then Rudra, getting impatient, speedily came to Antaipura, where everyone came with the cloth around his neck and falling at his feet said, “O Rudra  be merciful to us, protect and help us”.47.
CHAUPAI

187.g: ਹਮ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਓਜ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
187.t: ham tumaro har oj na jaanaa ||

187.e: “O Shiva  we have not recognized thee, you are supremely mighty and an ascetic.”
Hearing these words, Rudra become gracious and he caused Daksha to become alive again and get up.48.
Then Rudra meditated upon the Lord and restored the life of all other kings.
He restored the life of the husband of all the princesses and seeing this wonderful performance, all the saints were extremely peeased.49.

187.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸੁੰਭ ਘਨੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
187.t: taa te su(n)bh ghano dhukh paayo ||
187.e: The god of love troubled greatly the god Shiva, who was without his consort, with which Shiva remained in great agony.
Being extremely vexed, once in great fury, Shiva reduced Kamdev (the god of love) to ashes and from that day this god was called Anang (body-less).50.

187.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧ ਦਛ ਬਧਹੀ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਮਹਾਤਮੇ ਗਉਰ ਬਧਹ ਗਿਆਰਵੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸੰਪੂਰਣਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧੧॥
187.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the rudhr praba(n)dh dhachh badhahee rudhr mahaatame gaur badheh giaaravo avataar sa(n)pooranam sat subham sat ||11||
187.e: End of the description of the Killing of Daksha, the greatness of rudra and the Killing of Gauri (Parvati) in the Rudra incarnation.11.
Now begins the description of Jalandhar incarnation:
Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.
CHAUPAI

187.g: ਵਹੁ ਜੋ ਜਰੀ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਰਾ ॥
187.t: vahu jo jaree rudhr kee dhaaraa ||

187.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਹਿਮ ਗਿਰਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਿਯ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
187.t: tin him gir gireh liy avataaraa ||
187.e: After having been burnt and died, the wife of Rudra was born in the house of Himalaya.
After the end of her childhood, when she attained the age of puberty, she was again united with her Lord Shiva.1.

187.g: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਰਾਮ ਸੋ ਸੀਤਾ ॥
187.t: jeh bidh milee raam so seetaa ||

187.e: Just as Sita, on meeting Rama, became one with him  just as Gita and Vedic ideology are one

187.g: ਤਿਯੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਈ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
187.t: tiyo mil giee rudhr kai sa(n)gaa ||2||
187.e: Just as, on meeting the sea, the Ganges becomes one with the sea, in the same manner, Parvati and Shiva became one.2.

187.g: ਜਬ ਤਿਹ ਬ੍ਯਾਹਿ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਘਰਿ ਆਨਾ ॥
187.t: jab teh bayaeh rudhr ghar aanaa ||

187.e: When, after wedding, Rudra brought her to his home, the demon Jalandhar was allured on seeing her
He sent a messenger , saying this: “Go and bring that women, after seizing her from Rudra.”3.
DOHRA
Jalandhar said :

187.g: ਕੈ ਸਿਵ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕੈ ਮਮ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਦੇਹ ਪਠਾਇ ॥
187.t: kai siv naar seegaar kai mam gireh dheh paThai ||

187.g: ਨਾਤਰ ਸੂਲ ਸੰਭਾਰ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਰਹੁ ਮੁਰਿ ਆਇ ॥੪॥
187.t: naatar sool sa(n)bhaar ke sa(n)g larahu mur aai ||4||
187.e: Jalandhar told his messenger to say this to Shiva : “O Shiva, either send your bedecked wife to me, or hold up your trident and wage war with me.”4.
CHAUPAI

187.g: ਕਥਾ ਭਈ ਇਹ ਦਿਸ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਾ ॥
187.t: kathaa bhiee ieh dhis ieh bhaataa ||

187.g: ਅਬ ਕਹੋ ਬਿਸਨ ਤ੍ਰੀਯਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
187.t: ab kaho bisan treeyaa kee baataa ||
187.e: How this story occurred? In this context, I relate the story of the wife of Vishnu :
One day, he cooked the brinjals in her home and at the same time, Vishnu was called by the assembly of demons, where he went.5.

187.g: ਆਇ ਗਯੋ ਤਹ ਨਾਰਦ ਰਿਖਿ ਬਰ ॥
187.t: aai gayo teh naaradh rikh bar ||

188.e: At the same time, the great sage Narada reached the house of Vishnu and he was very hungry.

188.g: ਮਾਗ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਪਰ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਯੋ ॥੬॥
188.t: maag rahiyo par haath na aayo ||6||
188.e: Seeing the cooked vegetable of brinjals, his mind was tempted, but he did not get it even on asking for it.6.
The wife of Vishnu said that she had prepared that food for her lord, therefore it was not possible for her to give it, (she also said:) “I have sent a messenger to call him and the may be coming.”

188.g: ਨਾਰਦ ਖਾਇ ਜੂਠ ਹੋਇ ਜੈ ਹੈ ॥
188.t: naaradh khai jooTh hoi jai hai ||

188.g: ਪੀਅ ਕੋਪਿਤ ਹਮਰੇ ਪਰ ਹੁਐ ਹੈ ॥੭॥
188.t: peea kopit hamare par huaai hai ||7||
188.e: The wife of Vishnu thought that if Narada partook it the food would become impure and her lord wound be angry with.7.
Narada said :

188.g: ਮਾਗ ਥਕਿਯੋ ਮੁਨਿ ਭੋਜ ਨ ਦੀਆ ॥
188.t: maag thakiyo mun bhoj na dheeaa ||

188.g: ਅਧਿਕ ਰੋਸੁ ਮੁਨਿ ਬਰਿ ਤਬ ਕੀਆ ॥
188.t: adhik ros mun bar tab keeaa ||
188.e: “The sage had been repeatedly asking for the food, but you did not give it to him.”

188.g: ਤ੍ਰੀਆ ਹੁਐ ਬਸੋ ਜਲੰਧਰ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ॥੮॥
188.t: treeaa huaai baso jala(n)dhar ke ghar ||8||
188.e: The sage flew into rage and said : “You will live in the house of the demon Jalandhar as wife named Varinda, after getting her body.”8.

188.g: ਦੇ ਕਰ ਸ੍ਰਾਪ ਜਾਤ ਭਯੋ ਰਿਖਿ ਬਰ ॥
188.t: dhe kar sraap jaat bhayo rikh bar ||

188.g: ਆਵਤ ਭਯੋ ਬਿਸਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ॥
188.t: aavat bhayo bisan taa ke ghar ||
188.e: No sooner than the sage departed after cursing her, Vishnu reached his home:

188.g: ਸੁਨਤ ਸ੍ਰਾਪ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
188.t: sunat sraap at hee dhukh paayo ||

188.e: Hearing about the curse, he was greatly agonised and his wife smilingly confirmed (what the sage had said).9.
DOHRA

188.g: ਤ੍ਰੀਯ ਕੀ ਛਾਯਾ ਲੈ ਤਬੈ ਬ੍ਰਿਦਾ ਰਚੀ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
188.t: treey kee chhaayaa lai tabai biradhaa rachee banai ||
188.e: Then Vishnu created Varinda from the shadow of his wife.

188.g: ਧੂਮ੍ਰਕੇਸ ਦਾਨਵ ਸਦਨਿ ਜਨਮ ਧਰਤ ਭਈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥
188.t: dhoomrakes dhaanav sadhan janam dharat bhiee jai ||10||
188.e: She took birth on the earth in the house of the demon Dhumarkesh.10.
CHAUPAI

188.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਬਸੀ ਜਲੰਧਰ ਕੇ ਘਰਿ ॥
188.t: pun nirap basee jala(n)dhar ke ghar ||
188.e: Just as the lotus-leaf in water remains unaffected by the drops of water, in the same manner, Varinda lived in the house of Jalandhar as his wife.
And for her Vishnu manifested himself as Jalandhar and in this way, Vishnu assumed a unique form.11.

188.g: ਕਥਾ ਐਸ ਇਹ ਦਿਸ ਮੋ ਭਈ ॥
188.t: kathaa aais ieh dhis mo bhiee ||

188.g: ਅਬ ਚਲਿ ਬਾਤ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਪਰ ਗਈ ॥
188.t: ab chal baat rudhr par giee ||
188.e: In this way, the story heath taken a new turn and now it hath halted on Rudra.

188.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕੋਪ ਅਸੁਰ ਪਤਿ ਛੁਦ੍ਰਾ ॥੧੨॥
188.t: taa te kop asur pat chhudhraa ||12||
188.e: The demon Jalandhar asked for his wife from Ruda and Rudra did not oblige him, therefore the king of demons flew into rage instantly.12.
The trumpets and drums resounded on all the four sides and the knocking sound of tabors was heard from all the four directions.
The steel collided with the steel dreadfully and the daggers glittered with infinite beauty.13.

188.g: ਗਿਰਿ ਗਿਰਿ ਪਰਤ ਸੁਭਟ ਰਣ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
188.t: gir gir parat subhaT ran maahee ||

188.e: The warriors began to fall in the battlefield and the ghosts and fiends began to run on all the four sides.

188.g: ਜੂਝਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਰਣ ਕੀ ਛਿਤਿ ਅਨਗਣ ॥੧੪॥
188.t: joojh gire ran kee chhit anagan ||14||
188.e: The innumerable riders of elephants, chariots and horses began to fall as martyrs in the battlefield.14.
TOTAK STANZA
The warriors moved in the battlefield in great anger and a dreadful war began.

188.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਾਵਣ ਮੇਘ ਲਜੰ ॥੧੫॥
188.t: sun kai dhun saavan megh laja(n) ||15||
188.e: Hearing the neighing of horses and the trumpeting of the elephants, the clouds of Sawan felt shy.15.
The arrows and the swords were showered in the war and in this may this war was a dreadful and horrible war.
The warriors fall, but in their persistence, they raise dreadful sound. In this way, the forces of the enemy, gathered quickly from all the four sides in the battlefield.16.

188.g: ਚਹੂੰ ਓਰ ਘਿਰਿਯੋ ਸਰ ਸੋਧਿ ਸਿਵੰ ॥
188.t: chahoo(n) or ghiriyo sar sodh siva(n) ||

188.e: Having been besieged from all four sides, held his arrow and flew into rage over the demons.

188.g: ਦੁਹੂੰ ਓਰਨ ਤੇ ਇਮ ਬਾਣ ਬਹੇ ॥
188.t: dhuhoo(n) oran te im baan bahe ||

189.g: ਨਭ ਅਉਰ ਧਰਾ ਦੋਊ ਛਾਇ ਰਹੇ ॥੧੭॥
189.t: nabh aaur dharaa dhouoo chhai rahe ||17||
189.e: The arrows were showered so intensely from both the sides, that there was shade on the earth and over the sky.17.

189.g: ਗਿਰਗੇ ਤਹ ਟੋਪਨ ਟੂਕ ਘਨੇ ॥
189.t: girage teh Topan Took ghane ||

189.g: ਰਹਗੇ ਜਨੁ ਕਿੰਸਕ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਸਨੇ ॥
189.t: rahage jan ki(n)sak sron sane ||
189.e: The helmets broke and fell in eh battlefield like the flowers saturated with blood.

189.g: ਰਣ ਹੇਰਿ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਨੂਪ ਹਰੰ ॥
189.t: ran her aga(n)m anoop hara(n) ||

189.g: ਜੀਯ ਮੋ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਕਰੰ ॥੧੮॥
189.t: jeey mo ieh bhaat bichaar kara(n) ||18||
189.e: The unapproachable and unique Shiva thought over in this way in his mind.18.

189.g: ਜੀਯ ਮੋ ਸਿਵ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹਾ ਚਕ ਕੈ ॥
189.t: jeey mo siv dhekh rahaa chak kai ||

189.g: ਦਲ ਦੈਤਨ ਮਧਿ ਪਰਾ ਹਕ ਕੈ ॥
189.t: dhal dhaitan madh paraa hak kai ||
189.e: And perplexed in his heart, Shiva, shouting loudly, jumped into the forces of the demons.

189.g: ਰਣਿ ਸੂਲ ਸੰਭਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ ਕਰੰ ॥
189.t: ran sool sa(n)bhaar prahaar kara(n) ||

189.g: ਸੁਣ ਕੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਡਰੰ ॥੧੯॥
189.t: sun ke dhun dhev adhev ddara(n) ||19||
189.e: Holding his trident, he began to strike blows and hearing the sound of his blows, both the gods and demons were all filled with fear.19.

189.g: ਜੀਯ ਮੋ ਸਿਵ ਧ੍ਯਾਨ ਧਰਾ ਜਬ ਹੀ ॥
189.t: jeey mo siv dhayaan dharaa jab hee ||

189.g: ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨਿ ਭਏ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
189.t: kal kaal prasa(n)n bhe tab hee ||
189.e: When Shiva meditated in his mind on the non-temporal Lord, the Lord was pleased at the same time.

189.g: ਕਹਿਯੋ ਬਿਸਨ ਜਲੰਧਰ ਰੂਪ ਧਰੋ ॥
189.t: kahiyo bisan jala(n)dhar roop dharo ||

189.g: ਪੁਨਿ ਜਾਇ ਰਿਪੇਸ ਕੋ ਨਾਸ ਕਰੋ ॥੨੦॥
189.t: pun jai ripes ko naas karo ||20||
189.e: Vishnu was ordered to manifest himself as Jalndhar and in this way destroy the king of enemies.20.

189.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
189.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||

189.g: ਦਈ ਕਾਲ ਆਗਿਆ ਧਰਿਯੋ ਬਿਸਨ ਰੂਪੰ ॥
189.t: dhiee kaal aagiaa dhariyo bisan roopa(n) ||

189.g: ਸਜੇ ਸਾਜ ਸਰਬੰ ਬਨਿਯੋ ਜਾਨ ਭੂਪੰ ॥
189.t: saje saaj saraba(n) baniyo jaan bhoopa(n) ||
189.e: The Destroyer Lord commanded and Vishnu manifested himself in the form of Jalandhar, and bedecked in all manner, he appeared as a kiing.

189.g: ਕਰਿਯੋ ਨਾਥ ਯੋ ਆਪ ਨਾਰੰ ਉਧਾਰੰ ॥
189.t: kariyo naath yo aap naara(n) udhaara(n) ||

189.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਰਾਜ ਬ੍ਰਿੰਦਾ ਸਤੀ ਸਤ ਟਾਰੰ ॥੨੧॥
189.t: tirayaa raaj bira(n)dhaa satee sat Taara(n) ||21||
189.e: Vishnu manifested himself in this form in order to protect his wife, and in this way, he defiled the chastity of the extremely chaste Varinda.21.

189.g: ਤਜਿਯੋ ਦੇਹਿ ਦੈਤੰ ਭਈ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਨਾਰੰ ॥
189.t: tajiyo dheh dhaita(n) bhiee bisan naara(n) ||

189.g: ਧਰਿਯੋ ਦੁਆਦਸਮੋ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਦਈਤਾਵਤਾਰੰ ॥
189.t: dhariyo dhuaadhasamo bisan dhieetaavataara(n) ||
189.e: Abandoning the body of demoness, Varinda again manifested herself as Lakshmi, the wife of Vishnu and in this way Vishnu assumed the twelfth incarnation in the form of a demon.

189.g: ਪੁਨਰ ਜੁਧੁ ਸਜਿਯੋ ਗਹੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਣੰ ॥
189.t: punar judh sajiyo gahe sasatr paana(n) ||

189.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਭੂਮਿ ਮੋ ਸੂਰ ਸੋਭੇ ਬਿਮਾਣੰ ॥੨੨॥
189.t: gire bhoom mo soor sobhe bimaana(n) ||22||
189.e: The war continued again and the warriors held their weapons in their hands  the brave fighters began to fall in the battlefield and also the air-vehicles came down in order to take away the dead warriors from the battlefield.22.

189.g: ਮਿਟਿਯੋ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਰੰ ਕਟਿਯੋ ਸੈਨ ਸਰਬੰ ॥
189.t: miTiyo sat naara(n) kaTiyo sain saraba(n) ||

189.g: ਮਿਟਿਯੋ ਭੂਪ ਜਾਲੰਧਰੰ ਦੇਹ ਗਰਬੰ ॥
189.t: miTiyo bhoop jaala(n)dhara(n) dheh garaba(n) ||
189.e: On this side, the chastity of woman was defiled and on that side all the army was chopped. By this the pride of Jalandhar was shattered.

190.g: ਪੁਨਰ ਜੁਧ ਸਜਿਯੋ ਹਠੇ ਤੇਜ ਹੀਣੰ ॥
190.t: punar judh sajiyo haThe tej heena(n) ||

190.g: ਭਜੇ ਛਾਡ ਕੈ ਸੰਗ ਸਾਥੀ ਅਧੀਣੰ ॥੨੩॥
190.t: bhaje chhaadd kai sa(n)g saathee adheena(n) ||23||
190.e: But still weak king continued the fight and all his companions and subordinates ran away from the battlefield.23.
CHAUPAI
Both Shiva and Jalandhar fought and there was none other in the battlefield.
The war continued of several month and Jalndhar was filled with great fury for (the action of ) Shiva.24.

190.g: ਤਬ ਸਿਵ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਕਤਿ ਕੌ ਧਰਾ ॥
190.t: tab siv dhiaan sakat kau dharaa ||

190.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਕਤਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰ ਕਰਾ ॥
190.t: taa te sakat kirapaa kar karaa ||
190.e: Then Shiva meditated upon the Shakti (power) and the Power (Shakti) was Gracious towards him.
Now, Rudra getting mightier than before began to wage wr.25.

190.g: ਉਤ ਹਰਿ ਲਯੋ ਨਾਰਿ ਰਿਪ ਸਤ ਹਰਿ ॥
190.t: aut har layo naar rip sat har ||

190.g: ਇਤ ਸਿਵ ਭਯੋ ਤੇਜ ਦੇਬੀ ਕਰਿ ॥
190.t: eit siv bhayo tej dhebee kar ||
190.e: On that side, Vishnu had defiled the chastity of woman, and on this side, Shiva also, having received the effulgence form the goddess, became more powerful.

190.g: ਛਿਨ ਮੋ ਕੀਯੋ ਅਸੁਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
190.t: chhin mo keeyo asur ko naasaa ||

190.e: Therefore he destroyed the demon Jalandhar in and instant  seeing this scene, all were pleased.26.
Those who repeat the Name of Chandika, they know that from that day, Chnadika came to be known as Jalandhari.
By repeating her name, the body becomes pure like taking bath in the Ganges.  ||27||

190.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
190.t: taa te kahee na rudhr kahaanee ||

190.e: Keeping in mind the fear of making the book voluminous, I have not narrated the complete story of Rudra.

190.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਥਾ ਥੋਰਿ ਹੀ ਭਾਸੀ ॥
190.t: taa te kathaa thor hee bhaasee ||

190.g: ਨਿਰਖਿ ਭੂਲਿ ਕਬਿ ਕਰੋ ਨ ਹਾਸੀ ॥੨੮॥
190.t: nirakh bhool kab karo na haasee ||28||
190.e: This story has only been narrated in brief  on knowing this, kindly do not jeer at me.28.

190.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਜਲੰਧਰ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬਾਰ੍ਰਹਵਾ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧੨॥
190.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the jala(n)dhar avataar baarrahavaa samaapatam sat subham sat ||12||
190.e: End of the description of the twelfth i.e. JALANDHAR Incarnation.12.
Now begins the description of the thirteenth i.e. VISHNU Incarnatiion:
Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Power) be helpful.
CHAUPAI
Now I enumerate the incarnations of Vishnu as to what type of incarnations he adopted.
When the earth is distempered with the load of sins, then she manifested her anguish before the Destroyer Lord.1.
When the demons cause the gods to run away and seize their kingdom from them,
Then the earth, pressed under the load of sins, calls for help, and then the destroyer Lord becomes kind.2.
DOHRA

190.g: ਸਬ ਦੇਵਨ ਕੋ ਅੰਸ ਲੈ ਤਤੁ ਆਪਨ ਠਹਰਾਇ ॥
190.t: sab dhevan ko a(n)s lai tat aapan Thaharai ||

190.g: ਬਿਸਨੁ ਰੂਪ ਧਾਰ ਤਤ ਦਿਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਅਦਿਤ ਕੈ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
190.t: bisan roop dhaar tat dhin gireh adhit kai aai ||3||
190.e: Then taking the elements of all the gods and principally merging himself in it, Vishnu manifest himself in different forms and takes birth in the clan of Aditi.3.
CHAUPAI
Incarnating himself in this way, he lifts the burden of Earth.
And destroys demons in various ways.

190.g: ਭੂਮਿ ਭਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਰ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
190.t: bhoom bhaar har sur pur jaiee ||
190.e: After removing Earth's burden, he goes to the abode of the gods again.
He merges himself in the destroyer God. ||4||
If I relate all these stories in detail,
then people will call this the book of Vishnu.
Therefore, I will narrate it in brief.
O Great Actor, protect me from illness and suffering. ||5||

190.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਤੇਰ੍ਰਹਵਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤ ॥੧੩॥
190.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the terrahavaa bisan avataar samaapatam sat subham sat ||13||
190.e: End of the description of the thirteenth incarnation (Vishnu). ||13||

191.e: Now begins the description of the killing of Madhu and Kaitabh :
Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.
DOHRA

191.g: ਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਮੋ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਬਿਸਨ ਮਹੇਸ ॥
191.t: kaal purakh kee dheh mo koTik bisan mahes ||
191.e: In the body of the Immanent Lord, million of Vishnus and Shivas abide.

191.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਕਿਤੇ ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਰਿ ਜਲੇਸ ॥੧॥
191.t: koT i(n)dhr brahamaa kite rav sas kror jales ||1||
191.e: Million of Indras, Brahmas, Suryas, Chandras and Varunas are present thre in His divine body.1.
CHAUPAI

191.g: ਸਿੰਧੁ ਬਿੰਧੁ ਜਹ ਗਨਿਯੋ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
191.t: si(n)dh bi(n)dh jeh ganiyo na jaiee ||
191.e: Fatigued by his work, Vishnu remains merged in Him and within that Immanent Lord, there are unaccountable oceans and worlds.
The bed of Great serpent, on which that Immanent Lord sleeps, millions of Sheshanagas appear graceful near it.2.

191.g: ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਸੀਸ ਤਬ ਧਰ ਤਨ ਜੰਗਾ ॥
191.t: saha(n)sr sees tab dhar tan ja(n)gaa ||

191.e: He hath thousands of heads, trunks and legs  He hath thousands of hands and feet, He, the Invincible Lord
He hath thousands of eyes and al types of excellences kiss his feet.3.
DOHRA

191.g: ਮਧੁ ਕੀਟਭ ਕੇ ਬਧ ਨਮਿਤ ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਜਗਤ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
191.t: madh keeTabh ke badh namit jaa dhin jagat muraar ||
191.e: The day on which Vishnu manifested himself for the killing of Madhu and Kaitabh,

191.g: ਸੁ ਕਬਿ ਸ੍ਯਾਮ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਚੌਦਸਵੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੪॥
191.t: s kab sayaam taa ko kahai chauadhasavo avataar ||4||
191.e: The poet Shyam knows him as fourteenth incarnation.4.
CHAUPAI
From the dross of the ear, the demons were born and were considered glorious like Chandra and Surya.

191.g: ਮਾਯਾ ਤਜਤ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਕਹੁ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
191.t: maayaa tajat bisan kahu tab hee ||

191.g: ਕਰਤ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਅਸੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਬ ਹੀ ॥੫॥
191.t: karat upaadh asur mil jab hee ||5||
191.e: With the orders of the Immanent Lord, Vishnu abandoned maya and manifested himself at that time, when these demons indulged in riots.5.
Vishnu waged ferocious war with them for five thousand years .
The Immanent Lord then helped Vishnu and in great fury, he destroyed both the demons.6.
DOHRA

191.g: ਧਾਰਤ ਹੈ ਐਸੋ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਚੌਦਸਵੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
191.t: dhaarat hai aaiso bisan chauadhasavo avataar ||

191.g: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਬੂਹਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਨਮਿਤ ਦਾਨਵ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਸੰਘਾਰ ॥੭॥
191.t: sa(n)t sa(n)boohan sukh namit dhaanav dhuhoo(n) sa(n)ghaar ||7||
191.e: In this way, Vishnu manifested himself as the fourteenth incarnation and in order to give comfort to the saints, he destroyed both these demons.7.

191.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਮਧੁ ਕੈਟਭ ਬਧਹ ਚਤਰਦਸਵੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਸਮਾਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧੪॥
191.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the madh kaiTabh badheh chataradhasavo avataar bisan samaatam sat subham sat ||14||
191.e: End of the description of the fourteenth incarnation.14.
Now begins the description of the incarnation named Arhant Dev :
Let Sri Bhaguti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.
CHAUPAI
Whenever the demons extend their rule, then Vishnu comes to destroy them.

191.g: ਸੁਰ ਅਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਏ ॥੧॥
191.t: sur ar gur ma(n)dhar chal ge ||1||
191.e: Once all the demons gathered together  ( seeing them ) the gods and their preceptors went to their abodes.1.
All the demons gathered together and thought out (over this issue), that Vishnu always destroys the demons

191.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਐਸ ਕਰੌ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਾਤਾ ॥
191.t: taa te aais karau kichh ghaataa ||

191.e: And now they should devise some plan, to settle the issue.2.
The preceptor of the demons (Shukracharya) said, “O demons, you have not understood this mystery till now

191.g: ਵੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਗ ਕਰਤ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਾ ॥
191.t: ve mil jag karat bahu bhaataa ||

191.g: ਕੁਸਲ ਹੋਤ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
191.t: kusal hot taa te dhin raataa ||3||
191.e: “The gods gather together and perform Yajnas (sacrifices), therefore thay always remain happy.3.

191.g: ਬਿਜੈ ਹੋਇ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਰਣ ॥
191.t: bijai hoi tumaree taa te ran ||
191.e: You should also perform sacrifices, and then you will be victorious in the battlefield.

192.e: “You should then began the performance of a Yajna, and hearing about it , the people of the region of gods became fearful.4.
All the gods went to meet Vishnu and said, “ O destroyer of demons  take some steps now.”
Vishnu said, “I shall manifest myself in a new body, and destroy the Yajna of the demons.”5.
Vishnu then took bath at various pilgrim-stations, and distributed unlimited alms to the Brahmins.
Brahma, born out of the heart-lotus of Vishnu, propagated the divine knowledge, and Vishnu mediated on the Immanent Lord.6.
The Immanent Lord, then became Merciful and addressed his servant Vishnu with sweet words,
“O Vishnu, manifest yourself in the forms of Arhant, and destroy the kings of the demons.”7.
Vishnu, after receiving the orders of the Immanent Lord, eulogized him.
He manifested himself as Arhant Dev on the earth and started a new religion.8.

192.g: ਜਬ ਅਸੁਰਨ ਕੋ ਭਯੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਈ ॥
192.t: jab asuran ko bhayo gur aaiee ||

192.e: When he became the preceptor of the demons, he started different kinds of sects.
One of the sects he started was Shravak sect (Jainism) and bestowed supreme comfort to the saints.9.
He caused all to hold the forceps for plucking hair and in this way he made many demons devoid of the lock of hair on the crown of the head.

192.g: ਸਿਖਾ ਹੀਣ ਕੋਈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਨ ਫੁਰੈ ॥
192.t: sikhaa heen koiee ma(n)tr na furai ||

192.g: ਜੋ ਕੋਈ ਜਪੈ ਉਲਟ ਤਿਹ ਪਰੈ ॥੧੦॥
192.t: jo koiee japai ulaT teh parai ||10||
192.e: Those without hair or without the lock of hair on the crown of their heads could not remember any mantra and if anyone repeated the mantra, there was negative influence of the mantra on him.10.
Then he ended the performance of Yajnas and made all indifferent to the idea of violence on beings.

192.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਿੰਸਾ ਕੀਅ ਜਗ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
192.t: bin hi(n)saa keea jag na hoiee ||

192.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਜਗ ਕਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧੧॥
192.t: taa te jag kare na koiee ||11||
192.e: There can be no Yajna without the violence on beings, therefore no one performed Yajna now.11.

192.g: ਯਾ ਤੇ ਭਯੋ ਜਗਨ ਕੋ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
192.t: yaa te bhayo jagan ko naasaa ||

192.e: In this way, the practice of performing Yajnas was destroyed and anyone who used to kill beings, he was ridiculed.

192.g: ਜੀਅ ਮਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਗ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
192.t: jeea mare bin jag na hoiee ||

192.e: There could be no Yajna without the killing of beings and if one performed a Yajna, he availed no merit.12.

192.g: ਜਗ ਸਕੈ ਕੋ ਕਰ ਨ ਨਰੇਸਾ ॥
192.t: jag sakai ko kar na naresaa ||
192.e: The Arhant incarnation, instructed all in way, that no king could perform a Yajna.

192.g: ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੋਊ ਕਰਨ ਨ ਪਾਯਾ ॥੧੩॥
192.t: dharam karam kouoo karan na paayaa ||13||
192.e: Everyone was put on a wrong path and no one was performing the action of Dharma.13.
DOHRA

192.g: ਅੰਨਿ ਅੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਹੋਤੁ ਜਿਯੋ ਘਾਸਿ ਘਾਸਿ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
192.t: a(n)n a(n)n te hot jiyo ghaas ghaas te hoi ||
192.e: Just as corn is produced from corn, grass from grass

192.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਮਨੁਛ ਮਨੁਛ ਤੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
192.t: taise manuchh manuchh te avar na karataa koi ||14||
192.e: In the same way the man from man (thus there is no creator-Ishvara). ||14||
CHAUPAI

192.g: ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਕੋਊ ਕਰਨ ਨ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
192.t: dharam karam kouoo karan na paayo ||
192.e: Such a knowledge was given to all that none performed the action of Dharma.

192.g: ਇਹ ਬ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੀਚ ਸਭੋ ਚਿਤ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
192.t: eeh birat beech sabho chit dheenaa ||

192.g: ਅਸੁਰ ਬੰਸ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਭਯੋ ਛੀਨਾ ॥੧੫॥
192.t: asur ba(n)s taa te bhayo chheenaa ||15||
192.e: Everyone’s mind was absorbed in such things and in this way, the clan of demons became weak.15.
Such rules were propagated, that no demon could take a bath now, and without taking bath no one could become pure.

192.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੋਈ ਫੁਰੇ ਨ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
192.t: bin pavitr koiee fure na ma(n)traa ||

193.g: ਨਿਫਲ ਭਏ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਜੰਤ੍ਰਾ ॥੧੬॥
193.t: nifal bhe taa te sabh ja(n)traa ||16||
193.e: Without becoming pure, no mantra could be recited and this way, all the actions became fruitless.16.

193.g: ਦਸ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਬਰਖ ਕੀਅ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
193.t: dhas saha(n)sr barakh keea raajaa ||

193.g: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮੋ ਮਤ ਐਸੁ ਪਰਾਜਾ ॥
193.t: sabh jag mo mat aais paraajaa ||
193.e: In this way, Arhant ruled for ten thousand years and propagated his religion throughout the world.

193.g: ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਯੋ ॥
193.t: dharam karam sab hee miT gayo ||

193.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਛੀਨ ਅਸੁਰ ਕੁਲ ਭਯੋ ॥੧੭॥
193.t: taa te chheen asur kul bhayo ||17||
193.e: The actions of Dharma ended in the word and in this way, the clan of demons became weak.17.

193.g: ਦੇਵ ਰਾਇ ਜੀਅ ਮੋ ਭਲੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
193.t: dhev rai jeea mo bhal maanaa ||

193.g: ਬਡਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਅਬ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਕਰਾਨਾ ॥
193.t: baddaa karam ab bisan karaanaa ||
193.e: Indra, the king of gods, liked all this very much in his mind that Vishnu had done such a great thing for them.

193.g: ਆਨੰਦ ਬਢਾ ਸੋਕ ਮਿਟ ਗਯੋ ॥
193.t: aana(n)dh baddaa sok miT gayo ||

193.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਬਹੂੰ ਬਧਾਵਾ ਭਯੋ ॥੧੮॥
193.t: ghar ghar sabahoo(n) badhaavaa bhayo ||18||
193.e: All of them forsaking grief, were filled with joy and the songs of happiness were sung in every home.18.

193.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
193.t: dhoharaa ||

193.g: ਬਿਸਨ ਐਸ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਦੈ ਸਬ ਹੂੰ ਧਰਮ ਛੁਟਾਇ ॥
193.t: bisan aais upadhes dhai sab hoo(n) dharam chhuTai ||

193.g: ਅਮਰਾਵਤਿ ਸੁਰ ਨਗਰ ਮੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਿਰਾਜਿਯੋ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੯॥
193.t: amaraavat sur nagar mo bahur biraajiyo jai ||19||
193.e: Instructing in this way, Vishnu caused all to abandon the acions of Dharma and went back again to heavens.19.

193.g: ਸ੍ਰਾਵਗੇਸ ਕੋ ਰੂਪ ਧਰਿ ਦੈਤ ਕੁਪੰਥ ਸਬ ਡਾਰਿ ॥
193.t: sraavages ko roop dhar dhait kupa(n)th sab ddaar ||
193.e: Assuming the status of supreme preceptor of Sharvakas and engrossing the demons on the wrong path,

193.g: ਪੰਦ੍ਰਵੇਾਂ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਇਮ ਧਾਰਤ ਭਯੋ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨੦॥
193.t: pa(n)dhraveaa(n) avataar im dhaarat bhayo muraar ||20||
193.e: Vishnu manifested himself as the fifteenth incarnation in this way. ||20||

193.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਅਰਹੰਤ ਪਦ੍ਰਸਵੋਂ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧੫॥
193.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the araha(n)t padhrasavo(n) avataar samaapatam sat subham sat ||15||
193.e: End of the description of ARHANT, the fifteenth incarnation in BACHITTAR NATAK.15.

193.g: ਅਥ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
193.t: ath man raajaa avataar kathana(n) ||
193.e: Now begins the description of the incarnation named King Manu:

193.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਜੀ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
193.t: sree bhagautee jee sahai ||
193.e: Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.

193.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
193.t: chauapiee ||

193.g: ਸ੍ਰਾਵਗ ਮਤ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਜਨ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
193.t: sraavag mat sab hee jan laage ||

193.g: ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਤਜਿ ਭਾਗੇ ॥
193.t: dharam karam sab hee taj bhaage ||
193.e: All the people were absorbed in Shravak Religion (Jainism) and all abandoned the action of Dharma.

193.g: ਤ੍ਯਾਗ ਦਈ ਸਬਹੂੰ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
193.t: tayaag dhiee sabahoo(n) har sevaa ||

193.g: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਨਤ ਭੇ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
193.t: koi na maanat bhe gur dhevaa ||1||
193.e: All of them forsook the service of the Lord and none worshipped the Supreme preceptor (the Immanent Lord).1.

193.g: ਸਾਧ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਬੈ ਹੁਐ ਗਏ ॥
193.t: saadh asaadh sabai huaai ge ||

193.g: ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਸਬ ਹੂੰ ਤਜਿ ਦਏ ॥
193.t: dharam karam sab hoo(n) taj dhe ||
193.e: The saints became devoid of saintliness and all abandoned the action of Dharma

194.e: Then the Immanent Lord ordered Vishnu, who did as commanded.2.
Vishnu manifested himself as king Manu and propagated Manu Smriti in the world.
He brought all the corrupt persons on the right path and cused the people to become devoid of sinful actions.3.

194.g: ਸਰਬ ਹੀ ਸਿਰਜੇ ਧਰਮ ਕੇ ਸਾਜਾ ॥
194.t: sarab hee siraje dharam ke saajaa ||
194.e: Vishnu incarnated himself as the king Manu and established all the actions of Dgarma.

194.g: ਪਾਪ ਕਰਾ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਗਹਿ ਮਾਰਾ ॥
194.t: paap karaa taa ko geh maaraa ||

194.e: If anyone committed a sin, he was now killed and in this way, the king made all his subjects to tread on the right path.4.

194.g: ਪਾਪ ਕਰਾ ਜਾ ਹੀ ਤਹ ਮਾਰਸ ॥
194.t: paap karaa jaa hee teh maaras ||

194.e: The sinner was killed instantly and all the subjects were given instructions on Dharma.
Now all attained the instructions about the Name of the Lord and about virtuous actions like charity etc. And in this way, the king got abandoned the discipline of Sharavaks.5.

194.g: ਜੇ ਜੇ ਭਾਜਿ ਦੂਰ ਕਹੁ ਗਏ ॥
194.t: je je bhaaj dhoor kahu ge ||

194.e: The people who had run away from the kingdom of the king Manu, they only remained adherents of Sharavak Religion.
All the remaining subjects followed the path of Dharma and abandoning the wrong path, acquired the path of Dharma.6.

194.g: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜਗ ਮੋ ਭਲੁ ਸਾਜਾ ॥
194.t: karam dharam jag mo bhal saajaa ||
194.e: The king Manu was the incarnation of Vishnu and he propagated in the right manner the actions of Dharma.
He put all the followers of wrong values on the right path an brought the people towards Dharma, who were absorbed then in sinful action.7.
DOHRA

194.g: ਪੰਥ ਕੁਪੰਥੀ ਸਬ ਲਗੇ ਸ੍ਰਾਵਗ ਮਤ ਭਯੋ ਦੂਰ ॥
194.t: pa(n)th kupa(n)thee sab lage sraavag mat bhayo dhoor ||
194.e: All those who tread on the wrong paths, began to follow the right path and in this way, the Sharvak Religion receded far away.

194.g: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੋ ਜਗਤ ਮੋ ਰਹਿਯੋ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਭਰਪੂਰ ॥੮॥
194.t: man raajaa ko jagat mo rahiyo sujas bharapoor ||8||
194.e: For this work, the king Manu was highly venerated in the whole world.8.

194.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸੋਲ੍ਰਹਵਾ ਸਮਾਪਤਮ ਸਤੁ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥੧੬॥
194.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake gra(n)the man raajaa avataar solrahavaa samaapatam sat subham sat ||16||
194.e: For this work, the king Manu was MANU, the sixteenth incarnation in BACHITTAR BATAK.16.
Now begins the description of the incarnation named Dhanantar Vaid:
Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.
CHAUPAI

194.g: ਏਕ ਨ ਰਹਾ ਤਿਨੋ ਤਨ ਸੋਗਾ ॥
194.t: ek na rahaa tino tan sogaa ||
194.e: The people of all the world grew wealthy and there remained no anxiety on their body and mind.
They began to eat various kinds of foods and consequentsly they suffered form various kinds of ailments.1.
All the people got worried about their ailments and the subjects became extremely distressed.

194.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਪਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
194.t: kirapaa karee tin par har raiee ||2||
194.e: All of them snag the praises of the Immanent Lord and He become Gracious towards all.2.
Vishnu was called by the Supreme Lord and ordered to manifest himself in the form of Dhanwantar.
He also told him to spread Ayurveda and destroy the ailments of the subjects.3.
DOHRA

194.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਦੇਵ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੁਐ ਮਥਯੋ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
194.t: taa te dhev ikatr huaai mathayo samu(n)dhreh jai ||
194.e: Then all the gods gathered and churned the ocean,

194.g: ਰੋਗ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਹਿਤ ਕਢਯੋ ਧਨੰਤਰ ਰਾਇ ॥੪॥
194.t: rog binaasan prajaa hit kaddayo dhana(n)tar rai ||4||
194.e: And for the welfare of the subjects and destruction of their ailments, they acquired Dhanantar from the ocean.4.
CHAUPAI

194.g: ਜਗ ਕੇ ਰੋਗ ਕਰੇ ਸਬ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
194.t: jag ke rog kare sab naasaa ||
194.e: He spread Ayurveda and destroyed the ailments from the whole world.

195.g: ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਅਉਖਧੀ ਬਤਾਵਾ ॥੫॥
195.t: bhi(n)n bhi(n)n aaukhadhee bataavaa ||5||
195.e: He disclosed the Vaidic Shastra and brought it before the people and described various medicines.5.

195.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
195.t: dhoharaa ||
195.e: DOHRA

195.g: ਰੋਗ ਰਹਤ ਕਰ ਅਉਖਧੀ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਕਰਿਯੋ ਜਹਾਨ ॥
195.t: rog rahat kar aaukhadhee sabh hee kariyo jahaan ||
195.e: Administering the medicines to all the world, he made the world devoid of ailments,

195.g: ਕਾਲ ਪਾਇ ਤੱਛਕ ਹਨਿਯੋ ਸੁਰ ਪੁਰ ਕੀਯੋ ਪਯਾਨ ॥੬॥
195.t: kaal pai ta'chhak haniyo sur pur keeyo payaan ||6||
195.e: And departed for heaven after having been stung by Takshak (the king of snakes).6.

195.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਧਨੰਤ੍ਰ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸਤਾਰਵਾ ॥੧੭॥ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤ ॥
195.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake dhana(n)tr avataar sataaravaa ||17|| subham sat ||
195.e: End of the description of the seventeenth incarnation named DHANANTAR in BACHITTAR NATAK. ||17||

195.g: ਅਥ ਸੂਰਜ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
195.t: ath sooraj avataar kathana(n) ||
195.e: Now begins the description of the Suraj (Sun) Incarnation:

195.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਜੀ ਸਹਾਇ ॥
195.t: sree bhagautee jee sahai ||
195.e: Let Sri Bhagauti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.

195.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
195.t: chauapiee ||
195.e: CHAUPAI

195.g: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਢੇ ਦਿਤਿ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਅਤੁਲਿ ਬਲਿ ॥
195.t: bahur badde dhit putr atul bal ||

195.g: ਅਰਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੀਤੇ ਜਿਨ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ॥
195.t: ar anek jeete jin jal thal ||
195.e: The might of demos, the sons of Diti, increased very much and they conquered many enemies in water and on land.

195.g: ਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਕੀ ਆਗਯਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
195.t: kaal purakh kee aagayaa paiee ||

195.g: ਰਵਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਧਰਿਯੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
195.t: rav avataar dhariyo har raiee ||1||
195.e: Receiving the command of the Immanent Lord, Vishnu manifested himself as Suraj incarnation.1.

195.g: ਜੇ ਜੇ ਹੋਤ ਅਸੁਰ ਬਲਵਾਨਾ ॥
195.t: je je hot asur balavaanaa ||

195.g: ਰਵਿ ਮਾਰਤ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਾਨਾ ॥
195.t: rav maarat tin ko bidh naanaa ||
195.e: Wherever the demons become Lord, Vishnu manifested himself as Suraj incarnation kills them in different ways.

195.g: ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਧਰਨੀ ਤੇ ਹਰੇ ॥
195.t: a(n)dhakaar dharanee te hare ||

195.g: ਪ੍ਰਜਾ ਕਾਜ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੇ ਉਠਿ ਪਰੇ ॥੨॥
195.t: prajaa kaaj gireh ke uTh pare ||2||
195.e: The sun destroyed the darkness from the earth and in order to give comfort to the subjects, he used to roam hither and thither.2.

195.g: ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
195.t: naraaj chha(n)dh ||
195.e: NARAAJ STANZA

195.g: ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਆਲਸੰ ਸਭੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤ ਲੋਗ ਜਾਗਹੀਂ ॥
195.t: bisaar aalasa(n) sabhai prabhaat log jaagahee(n) ||

195.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਜਾਪ ਕੋ ਜਪੈਂ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਧਯਾਨ ਪਾਗਹੀਂ ॥
195.t: ana(n)t jaap ko japai(n) bia(n)t dhayaan paagahee(n) ||
195.e: (Seeing the Sun,) all the people abandoned idleness and woke up at dawn and meditating on the Omnipresent Lord, used to repeat His Name in various ways.

195.g: ਦੁਰੰਤ ਕਰਮ ਕੋ ਕਰੈਂ ਅਥਾਪ ਥਾਪ ਥਾਪਹੀਂ ॥
195.t: dhura(n)t karam ko karai(n) athaap thaap thaapahee(n) ||

195.g: ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੰਧਿਯਾਨ ਕੈ ਅਜਾਪ ਜਾਪ ਜਾਪਹੀ ॥੩॥
195.t: gaitree sa(n)dhiyaan kai ajaap jaap jaapahee ||3||
195.e: Working on difficult jobs, they used to stablise in their mind the Uninstallable Lord and used to recite the Gyatri and Sandhya.3.

195.g: ਸੁ ਦੇਵ ਕਰਮ ਆਦਿ ਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤ ਜਾਗ ਕੈ ਕਰੈਂ ॥
195.t: s dhev karam aadh lai prabhaat jaag kai karai(n) ||

195.g: ਸੁ ਜੱਗ ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਹੋਮ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਯਾਕਰਨ ਰਰੈਂ ॥
195.t: s ja'g dhoop dheep hom bedh biyaakaran rarai(n) ||
195.e: All the people, repeating the name of the Lord, used to perform godly deeds and also reflected on the Vedas and Vyakarna etc. alongwith the burning of incense, lighting the earthen lamps and performing Yajnas.

195.g: ਸੁ ਪਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਮ ਹੈਂ ਜਿਤੇ ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਿਤਬ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੋ ਕਰੈਂ ॥
195.t: s pitr karam hai(n) jite so biratabirat ko karai(n) ||

195.g: ਜੁ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਉਚਰੰਤ ਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਧਯਾਨ ਕੋ ਧਰੈਂ ॥੪॥
195.t: j saasatr simirat uchara(n)t su dharam dhayaan ko dharai(n) ||4||
195.e: They used to perform rituals for the manes according to their power and used to concentrate on virtuous actions alongwith the recitation of Shastras, Smritis etc.4.

195.g: ਅਰਧ ਨਿਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
195.t: aradh niraaj chha(n)dh ||
195.e: ARDH NIRAAJ STANZA

195.g: ਸੁ ਧੂੰਮ ਧੂੰਮ ਹੀ ॥
195.t: s dhoo(n)m dhoo(n)m hee ||

195.g: ਕਰੰਤ ਸੈਨ ਭੂੰਮ ਹੀ ॥
195.t: kara(n)t sain bhoo(n)m hee ||
195.e: The smoke of Yajnas was visible on all the four sides and all the people slept on the earth.

195.g: ਬਿਅੰਤ ਧਯਾਨ ਧਯਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
195.t: bia(n)t dhayaan dhayaavahee(n) ||

195.g: ਦੁਰੰਤ ਠਉਰ ਪਾਵਹੀਂ ॥੫॥
195.t: dhura(n)t Thaur paavahee(n) ||5||
195.e: Performing mediation and worship in many ways, they used to work for the growth of distant places.5.

195.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਉਚਰੈਂ ॥
195.t: ana(n)t ma(n)tr ucharai(n) ||

195.g: ਸੁ ਜੋਗ ਜਾਪਨਾ ਕਰੈਂ ॥
195.t: s jog jaapanaa karai(n) ||
195.e: Reciting many mantras, the people performed Yogic discipline and repeated the Name.

195.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਬਾਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਧਯਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
195.t: nirabaan purakh dhayaavahee(n) ||

195.g: ਬਿਮਾਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੀਂ ॥੬॥
195.t: bimaan a(n)t paavahee(n) ||6||
195.e: They meditated on the Detached Supreme Purusha and ultimately they acquired the air-vehicles for transportation to heaven.6.

195.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
195.t: dhoharaa ||
195.e: DOHRA

195.g: ਬਹੁਤ ਕਾਲ ਇਮ ਬੀਤਯੋ ਕਰਤ ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰੁ ਦਾਨ ॥
195.t: bahut kaal im beetayo karat dharam ar dhaan ||

195.g: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਸੁਰਿ ਬਢਿਯੋ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਦੀਰਘੁ ਕਾਇ ਦਤੁ ਮਾਨ ॥੭॥
195.t: bahur asur baddiyo prabal dheeragh kai dhat maan ||7||
195.e: In this way a good deal of time elapsed in performing religious and charitable actions and then a powerful demon named deeraghkaya was born.7.

195.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
195.t: chauapiee ||
195.e: CHAUPAI

195.g: ਬਾਣ ਪ੍ਰਜੰਤ ਬਢਤ ਨਿਤਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਤਨ ॥
195.t: baan praja(n)t baddat nitaprat tan ||

195.g: ਨਿਸ ਦਿਨ ਘਾਤ ਕਰਤ ਦਿਜ ਦੇਵਨ ॥
195.t: nis dhin ghaat karat dhij dhevan ||
195.e: His body increased in length everyday by the length of an arrow and he destroyed the gods and twice-born night and day.

195.g: ਦੀਰਘੁ ਕਾਇਐ ਸੋ ਰਿਪੁ ਭਯੋ ॥
195.t: dheeragh kaiaai so rip bhayo ||

195.g: ਰਵਿ ਰਥ ਹਟਕ ਚਲਨ ਤੇ ਗਯੋ ॥੮॥
195.t: rav rath haTak chalan te gayo ||8||
195.e: On the birth of the enemy like deeraghkaya, even the chariot of the sun hesitated to move.8.

195.g: ਅੜਿਲ ॥
195.t: aRil ||
195.e: ARIL

195.g: ਹਟਕ ਚਲਤ ਰਥੁ ਭਯੋ ਭਾਨ ਕੋਪਿਯੋ ਤਬੈ ॥
195.t: haTak chalat rath bhayo bhaan kopiyo tabai ||

195.g: ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੈ ਚਲਿਯੋ ਸੰਗ ਲੈ ਦਲ ਸਭੈ ॥
195.t: asatr sasatr lai chaliyo sa(n)g lai dhal sabhai ||
195.e: When the chariot of the sun stopped moving, the sun, then in great fury, marched forward alongwith his arms, weapons and forces.

195.g: ਮੰਡਯੋ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਤਹਾ ਰਣ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
195.t: ma(n)ddayo bibidh prakaar tahaa ran jai kai ||

195.g: ਹੋ ਨਿਰਖ ਦੇਵ ਅਰੁ ਦੈਤ ਰਹੇ ਉਰਝਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੯॥
195.t: ho nirakh dhev ar dhait rahe urajhai kai ||9||
195.e: He started various types of war seeing which both gods and demons, experienced a dilemma.9.

195.g: ਗਹਿ ਗਹਿ ਪਾਣ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਣ ਦੁਬਹੀਯਾ ਰਣ ਭਿਰੇ ॥
195.t: geh geh paan kirapaan dhubaheeyaa ran bhire ||

196.g: ਟੂਕ ਟੂਕ ਹੁਐ ਗਿਰੇ ਨ ਪਗ ਪਾਛੇ ਫਿਰੇ ॥
196.t: Took Took huaai gire na pag paachhe fire ||
196.e: Holding their swords in their hands, the warriors of both the side, fought with one another in the battlefield. They fell, having been chopped into bits, but still they did not retrace their steps.

196.g: ਅੰਗਨਿ ਸੋਭੇ ਘਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਬਢੇ ॥
196.t: a(n)gan sobhe ghai prabhaa at hee badde ||

196.g: ਹੋ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਮਨੋ ਛਿਟਕਾਇ ਜਨੇਤੀ ਸੇ ਚਢੇ ॥੧੦॥
196.t: ho basatr mano chhiTakai janetee se chadde ||10||
196.e: Having been wounded, their increased still further and they appeared like the members of the marriage party walking and exhibiting their dressers.10.
Hearing the resounding of the trumpets, the clouds are feeling shy.
The army is swelling forward like the clouds, from all the four side, and it appears that there is a large gathering of peacocks in the forest.11.
The luster of the shields appears like the red roses.
The movement of warriors and the shooting of arrows are creating different distinct sounded.12.
Such a sound is being heard in the battlefield as if the clouds are thundering.
The resounding of the drums and the sound of the empty quivers is also being hard.13.
The warriors are battled and seeing the dreadful war, they are mediating upon the Lord-God.
All are absorbed in the war and are submerged in the thoughts of war.14.
The brave fighters are moving hither and thither and the heavenly damsels are looking at them.

197.e: The heroes have abandoned everything and having been chopped several warriors have played with their lives.15.
The arrows are glittering and the flags are flying
The warriors are fighting face to face very quickly and the blood is oozing out of their chests.16.
Bedecked with the arrows, the brave warriors are roaring
They are ornamented with steel armours and are moving towards heaven.17.
When the superior arrows are discharged, the chests of the enemies are wounded.
The shields being cut are producing knocking sound and the armours are being torn.18.
NARAAJ STANZA

197.g: ਦਿਨੇਸ ਬਾਣ ਪਾਣ ਲੈ ਰਿਪੇਸ ਤਾਕ ਧਾਈਯੰ ॥
197.t: dhines baan paan lai ripes taak dhaieeya(n) ||

197.g: ਅਨੰਤ ਜੁੱਧ ਕ੍ਰੁੱਧ ਸੁੱਧੁ ਭੂਮ ਮੈ ਮਚਾਈਯੰ ॥
197.t: ana(n)t ju'dh kru'dh su'dh bhoom mai machaieeya(n) ||
197.e: Taking his arrow in his hand, Suraj ran towards the enemy Deeraghkaya and in great ire began a dreadful war.

197.g: ਕਿਤੇਕ ਭਾਜ ਚਾਲੀਯੰ ਸੁਰੇਸ ਲੋਗ ਕੋ ਗਏ ॥
197.t: kitek bhaaj chaaleeya(n) sures log ko ge ||

197.g: ਨਿਸੰਤ ਜੀਤ ਜੀਤ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਤ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਲਏ ॥੧੯॥
197.t: nisa(n)t jeet jeet kai ana(n)t sooramaa le ||19||
197.e: Many people came running under the refuge of gods, and Suraj, who ends the night, conquered many warriors.19.

197.g: ਸਮੱਟ ਸੇਲ ਸਾਮੁਹੇ ਸਰੱਕ ਸੂਰ ਝਾੜਹੀਂ ॥
197.t: sama'T sel saamuhe sara'k soor jhaaRahee(n) ||

197.g: ਬਬੱਕ ਬਾਘ ਜਯੋਂ ਬਲੀ ਹਲੱਕ ਹਾਕ ਮਾਰਹੀਂ ॥
197.t: baba'k baagh jayo(n) balee hala'k haak maarahee(n) ||
197.e: The warriors are striking the daggers, holding them tightly and coming face to face and the brave fighters are challenging one another, roaring like the lions.

197.g: ਅਭੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਉਤੰਗ ਜੰਗ ਮੋ ਗਿਰੇ ॥
197.t: abha(n)g a(n)g bha(n)g havai uta(n)g ja(n)g mo gire ||

197.g: ਸੁਰੰਗ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਸਭੈ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਜਾਨ ਕੈ ਅਰੈ ॥੨੦॥
197.t: sura(n)g sooramaa sabhai nisa(n)g jaan kai arai ||20||
197.e: The firm limbs, after swinging continuously, are falling down and the brave and beautiful fighters, fearlessly coming face to face with others are clashing.20.
ARDH NARAAJ STANZA
Listening to the resonance of the trumpets, the clouds are feeling shy.
The fastened trumpets have resounded and haring their sound, the warriors are thundering.21.
Fighting ferociously, the gods and their kings are moving (here and there).
They are roaming by mountain on air-vehicles and the harts of the gods and demons both are feeling envious.22.
BELI BINDRAM STANZA
The sound of he tabors of vampires and the cries of the Yoginis are being heard.
The daggers are glistening and glittering and the elephants and horses are jumping in the battlefield.23.
The resonance of drum is being heard and the luster of swords is glimmering.
Rudra is also dancing there with his loosened matted hair and a dreadful war is being waged there.24.
TOTAK STANZA
The winsome horses of the warriors are jumping in the war and the sword are glistening in their hands like the flash of lightning in the clouds.
The arrows are seen penetrated in the waist of the warriors and they are taking out the blood of one antoher.25.
The flags are fluttering and the brave fighters have become fearful, seeing the glitter of the arrows and the swords, the lightning in the dark clouds is also feeling shy

198.e: And this scene looks like the flash of lightning in the thundering clouds of the month of Sawan.26.
DOHRA

198.g: ਕਥਾ ਬ੍ਰਿਧ ਤੇ ਮੈ ਡਰੋ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੋ ਬਖਯਾਨ ॥
198.t: kathaa biradh te mai ddaro kahaa karo bakhayaan ||
198.e: How far should I narrate the story for fear of lengthening the same

198.g: ਨਿਸਾਹੰਤ ਅਸੁਰੇਸ ਸੋ ਸਰ ਤੇ ਭਯੋ ਨਿਦਾਨ ॥੨੭॥
198.t: nisaaha(n)t asures so sar te bhayo nidhaan ||27||
198.e: Ultimately the arrows of Suraj became the reason for the end of that demon.27.

198.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕੇ ਸੂਰਜ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਸਟ ਦਸਮੋ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਸਮਾਪਤ ॥੧੮॥
198.t: eit sree bachitr naaTake sooraj avataar asaT dhasamo avataar samaapat ||18||
198.e: End of the description of the Eighteenth Incarnation SURAJ in BACHITTAR NATAK.18.
Now begins the description of Chandra Incarnation:
Let Sri Bhaguti Ji (The Primal Lord) be helpful.
DODHAK STANZA
Now I think about Chandrama, how did Vishnu manifest as Chandra incarnation?

198.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਕਬ ਕੁਲ ਸਰਬ ਰਿਝਾਊਾਂ ॥੧॥
198.t: jaa te kab kul sarab rijhaauooaa(n) ||1||
198.e: I an narriating a very ancient story, hearing which all the poets will be pleased.1.
DODHAK STANZA

198.g: ਨੈਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਾ ਕਹੁ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
198.t: naik kirasaa kahu Thaur na hoiee ||

198.e: There was not even a little farming anywhere and the people were dying with hunger.

198.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ ਕਹੂੰ ਹੋਨ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
198.t: taa te kiras kahoo(n) hon na paavai ||2||
198.e: The nights were full of darkness and during the day the sun blazed, therefore nothing grew anywhere.2.
For this reason all the beings were agitated and they were destroyed like the old leaves.

198.g: ਭਾਤ ਹੀ ਭਾਤ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
198.t: bhaat hee bhaat kare har sevaa ||

198.e: Everyone worshipped, adored and served in various ways and the Supreme Preceptor (i.e. the Lord) was pleased.3.

198.g: ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੈਂ ਨਿਜ ਨਾਥੰ ॥
198.t: naar na sev karai(n) nij naatha(n) ||

198.g: ਲੀਨੇ ਹੀ ਰੋਸੁ ਫਿਰੈਂ ਜੀਅ ਸਾਥੰ ॥
198.t: leene hee ros firai(n) jeea saatha(n) ||
198.e: (This was the situation at that time) that the wife did no service to her husband and ever remained displeased with him.

198.g: ਕਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋਊ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੪॥
198.t: kaam binaa kouoo kaam na bhaavai ||4||
198.e: The lust did not overpower the wives and in the absence of sexual instinct, all the works for the growth of the world had ended.4.
TOMAR STANZA
No wife worshipped her husband and always remained in her pride.

198.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਵੈ ਨ ਤਿਨ ਕਹੁ ਕਾਮ ॥
198.t: dhukh vai na tin kahu kaam ||

198.e: She had no grief and did not suffer because of the sexual instinct, therefore, there was no desire for supplication in them.5.

198.g: ਕਰ ਹੈ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
198.t: kar hai na pat kee sev ||

198.e: Neither she served her husband, nor worshipped and abored the preceptors.

198.g: ਧਰ ਹੈਂ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਧਯਾਨ ॥
198.t: dhar hai(n) na har ko dhayaan ||

198.e: Neither she meditated on Lord-God nor she ever took bath.6.
Then the Immanent Lord called Vishnu and giving instruction to him, told, him that,
Without taking any other thing into consideration, he should manifest himself as Chandra incarnation.7.
Then Vishnu bowing his head said with folded hands,
“I shall assume the form of Chandra incarnation, so that the beauty may prosper in the world.8.
Then the extremely glorious Vishnu manifested himself as Chandra (incarnation),
And he shot continuously the arrows of the god of love towards women.9.
Because of this the women became modest and all their pride was shattered.

199.e: They again began to perform service to their husbands and by this all the gods were pleased.10.
Seeing Chandra, people began to do farming to a large extent.
All the thoughts-out works were accomplished, in this manner, Chandra incarnation came into being.11.
In this way Vishnu manifested himself as Chandra incarnation, but Chandra also became egoistic about his own beauty

199.g: ਆਨ ਕਿਸੂ ਕਹੁ ਚਿਤ ਨ ਲਿਆਯੋ ॥
199.t: aan kisoo kahu chit na liaayo ||

199.e: He also abandoned the meditation of any other, therefore he was also blemished.12.

199.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕੀਯ ਮੁਨ ਰੋਸ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
199.t: taa te keey mun ros apaaraa ||
199.e: He was engrossed with the wife of the sage (Gautam), which made th sage highly infuriated in his mind
The sage struck him with his deer-skin, which created a mark on his body and he was thus blemished.13.

199.g: ਸ੍ਰਾਪ ਲਗਯੋ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮੁਨਿ ਸੰਦਾ ॥
199.t: sraap lagayo taa ko mun sa(n)dhaa ||

199.g: ਘਟਤ ਬਢਤ ਤਾ ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਚੰਦਾ ॥
199.t: ghaTat baddat taa dhin te cha(n)dhaa ||
199.e: With the curse of the sage he keeps on decreasing and increasing
Because of this event, he felt extremely ashamed and his pride was extremely shattered.14.
He then performed austerities for a long time, by which the Immanent Lord became merciful towards him
His destructive ailment decayed and by the Grace of the Supreme Immanent Lord, he attained a higher status than the Sun.15.

199.g: ਇਤਿ ਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਉਨੀਸਵੋਂ ॥੧੯॥ ਸੁਭਮ ਸਤੁ ॥
199.t: eit cha(n)dhr avataar uneesavo(n) ||19|| subham sat ||
199.e: End of the description of the Nineteenth Incarnation i.e. CHANDRA. 19.

200.g: ੴ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਫਤਹ ॥
200.t: ikOankaar vaahiguroo jee kee fateh ||
200.e: The Lord is One and the Victory is of the Lord.

200.g: ਅਥ ਬੀਸਵਾ ਰਾਮ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
200.t: ath beesavaa raam avataar kathana(n) ||
200.e: Now begins the description about Ram, the twentieth Incarnation:

200.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
200.t: chauapiee ||
200.e: CHAUPAI

200.g: ਅਬ ਮੈ ਕਹੋ ਰਾਮ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
200.t: ab mai kaho raam avataaraa ||

200.g: ਜੈਸ ਜਗਤ ਮੋ ਕਰਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
200.t: jais jagat mo karaa pasaaraa ||
200.e: Now I describe the incarnation Ram  how he exhibited his performance in the world.

200.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਾਲ ਬੀਤਤ ਭਯੋ ਜਬੈ ॥
200.t: bahut kaal beetat bhayo jabai ||

200.g: ਅਸੁਰਨ ਬੰਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਯੋ ਤਬੈ ॥੧॥
200.t: asuran ba(n)s pragaT bhayo tabai ||1||
200.e: After a long time the family of demons raised its head again.1.

200.g: ਅਸੁਰ ਲਗੇ ਬਹੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਖਾਧਾ ॥
200.t: asur lage bahu karai bikhaadhaa ||

200.g: ਕਿਨਹੂੰ ਨ ਤਿਨੈ ਤਨਕ ਮੈ ਸਾਧਾ ॥
200.t: kinahoo(n) na tinai tanak mai saadhaa ||
200.e: The demons began to perform vicious actions and no one could chastise them.

200.g: ਸਕਲ ਦੇਵ ਇਕਠੇ ਤਬ ਭਏ ॥
200.t: sakal dhev ikaThe tab bhe ||

200.g: ਛੀਰ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਜਹ ਥੋ ਤਿਹ ਗਏ ॥੨॥
200.t: chheer samu(n)dhr jeh tho teh ge ||2||
200.e: The all the gods assembled and went to the milk-ocean.2.

200.g: ਬਹੁ ਚਿਰ ਬਸਤ ਭਏ ਤਿਹ ਠਾਮਾ ॥
200.t: bahu chir basat bhe teh Thaamaa ||

200.g: ਬਿਸਨ ਸਹਿਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਜਿਹ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
200.t: bisan sahit brahamaa jeh naamaa ||
200.e: There they stayed foe a long time with Vishnu and Brahma.

200.g: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਹੀ ਦੁਖਤ ਪੁਕਾਰਤ ॥
200.t: baar baar hee dhukhat pukaarat ||

200.g: ਕਾਨ ਪਰੀ ਕਲ ਕੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਰਤ ॥੩॥
200.t: kaan paree kal ke dhun aarat ||3||
200.e: They cried out in anguish many times and ultimately their consternation was heard by the Lord.3.

200.g: ਤੋਟਕ ਛੰਦ ॥
200.t: toTak chha(n)dh ||
200.e: TOTAK STANZA

200.g: ਬਿਸਨਾਦਕ ਦੇਵ ਲੇਖ ਬਿਮਨੰ ॥
200.t: bisanaadhak dhev lekh bimana(n) ||
200.e: Vishnu and other Gods are written as mere illusions.

200.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਦ ਹਾਸ ਕਰੀ ਕਰ ਕਾਲ ਧੁਨੰ ॥
200.t: miradh haas karee kar kaal dhuna(n) ||
200.e: By the Destroyer Being, who smiled and audibly said to Vishnu:

200.g: ਅਵਤਾਰ ਧਰੋ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ਹਰੰ ॥
200.t: avataar dharo raghunaath hara(n) ||
200.e: "Manifest yourself as Raghunath (Ram)."

200.g: ਚਿਰ ਰਾਜ ਕਰੋ ਸੁਖ ਸੋ ਅਵਧੰ ॥੪॥
200.t: chir raaj karo sukh so avadha(n) ||4||
200.e: "Rule over Oudh for a long time.” ||4||

200.g: ਬਿਸਨੇਸ ਧੁਣੰ ਸੁਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮੁਖੰ ॥
200.t: bisanes dhuna(n) sun braham mukha(n) ||
200.e: Vishnu heard this command from the mouth of the Destroyer Being (and did as ordered).

200.g: ਅਬ ਸੁੱਧ ਚਲੀ ਰਘੁਬੰਸ ਕਥੰ ॥
200.t: ab su'dh chalee raghuba(n)s katha(n) ||
200.e: Now begins the story of the Raghu clan.

200.g: ਜੁ ਪੈ ਛੋਰ ਕਥਾ ਕਵਿ ਯਾਹ ਰਢੈ ॥
200.t: j pai chhor kathaa kav yaeh raddai ||
200.e: The poet narrates this story from the beginning.

200.g: ਇਨ ਬਾਤਨ ਕੋ ਇਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਬਢੈ ॥੫॥
200.t: ein baatan ko ik gra(n)th baddai ||5||
200.e: And with these words the Granth will be enlarged. ||5||

200.g: ਤਿਹ ਤੇ ਕਹੀ ਥੋਰੀਐ ਬੀਨ ਕਥਾ ॥
200.t: teh te kahee thoreeaai been kathaa ||
200.e: Therefore, I compose this significant story in brief.

200.g: ਬਲਿ ਤ੍ਵੈ ਉਪਜੀ ਬੁਧ ਮੱਧਿ ਜਥਾ ॥
200.t: bal tavai upajee budh ma'dh jathaa ||
200.e: According to the intellect given to me by You.

200.g: ਜਹ ਭੂਲਿ ਭਈ ਹਮ ਤੇ ਲਹੀਯੋ ॥
200.t: jeh bhool bhiee ham te laheeyo ||
200.e: I am accountable for any lapses on my part.

200.g: ਸੁ ਕਬੋ ਤਹ ਅੱਛ੍ਰ ਬਨਾ ਕਹੀਯੋ ॥੬॥
200.t: s kabo teh a'chhr banaa kaheeyo ||6||
200.e: Therefore, I pray that You help me compose this poem with eloquent lettering. ||6||

200.g: ਰਘੁ ਰਾਜ ਭਯੋ ਰਘੁ ਬੰਸ ਮਣੰ ॥
200.t: ragh raaj bhayo ragh ba(n)s mana(n) ||
200.e: The Raghu king looked very impressive; like a gem in the necklace of the Raghu clan.

200.g: ਜਿਹ ਰਾਜ ਕਰਯੋ ਪੁਰ ਅਉਧ ਘਣੰ ॥
200.t: jeh raaj karayo pur aaudh ghana(n) ||
200.e: He ruled over Oudh for a long time.

200.g: ਸੋਊ ਕਾਲ ਜਿਣਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਰਾਜ ਜਬੰ ॥
200.t: souoo kaal jinayo niraparaaj jaba(n) ||
200.e: When Death won over the great king,

200.g: ਭੂਅ ਰਾਜ ਕਰਯੋ ਅਜ ਰਾਜ ਤਬੰ ॥੭॥
200.t: bhooa raaj karayo aj raaj taba(n) ||7||
200.e: Then his son, King Aj ruled over the earth. ||7||

200.g: ਅਜ ਰਾਜ ਹਣਯੋ ਜਬ ਕਾਲ ਬਲੀ ॥
200.t: aj raaj hanayo jab kaal balee ||

200.g: ਸੁ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤ ਕਥਾ ਦਸਰਥ ਚਲੀ ॥
200.t: s nirapat kathaa dhasarath chalee ||
200.e: When the king Aj was destroyed by the mighty destroyer Lord, then the story of Raghu clan moved forward through king Dasrath.

200.g: ਚਿਰ ਰਾਜ ਕਰੋ ਸੁਖ ਸੋਂ ਅਵਧੰ ॥
200.t: chir raaj karo sukh so(n) avadha(n) ||

200.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮਾਰ ਬਿਹਾਰ ਬਣੰ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੰ ॥੮॥
200.t: mirag maar bihaar bana(n) su prabha(n) ||8||
200.e: He passed his days in the forest hunting deer. ||8||

200.g: ਜਗ ਧਰਮ ਕਥਾ ਪ੍ਰਚੁਰੀ ਤਬ ਤੇ ॥
200.t: jag dharam kathaa prachuree tab te ||
200.e: Discussion on the righteous way of life was extensively propagated,

200.g: ਸੁਮਿਤ੍ਰੇਸ ਮਹੀਪ ਭਯੋ ਜਬ ਤੇ ॥
200.t: sumitres maheep bhayo jab te ||
200.e: When Dasrath, the Lord of Sumitra, became the king.

200.g: ਦਿਨ ਰੈਣ ਬਨੈਸਨ ਬੀਚ ਫਿਰੈ ॥
200.t: dhin rain banaisan beech firai ||
200.e: The king wandered through the jungles day and night.

200.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਰਾਜ ਕਰੀ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਨੇਤ ਹਰੈ ॥੯॥
200.t: mirag raaj karee mirag net harai ||9||
200.e: He regularly hunted tigers, elephants and deer. ||9||

200.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਥਾ ਉਹ ਠੌਰ ਭਈ ॥
200.t: eeh bhaat kathaa uh Thauar bhiee ||
200.e: In this way, the story of Oudh advances.

200.g: ਅਬ ਰਾਮ ਜਯਾ ਪਰ ਬਾਤ ਗਈ ॥
200.t: ab raam jayaa par baat giee ||
200.e: and now the part of the mother of Ram comes before us.

200.g: ਕੁਹੜਾਮ ਜਹਾ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਸਹਰੰ ॥
200.t: kuhaRaam jahaa suneeaai sahara(n) ||
200.e: There was a brave king in the city of Kuhram.

200.g: ਤਹ ਕੌਸਲ ਰਾਜ ਨ੍ਰਿਪੇਸ ਬਰੰ ॥੧੦॥
200.t: teh kauasal raaj nirapes bara(n) ||10||
200.e: In the kingdom of Kaushal. ||10||

200.g: ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹ ਧਾਮ ਸੁਤਾ ਕੁਸਲੰ ॥
200.t: aupajee teh dhaam sutaa kusala(n) ||
200.e: In his home, a beautiful daughter named Kaushalya was born.

200.g: ਜਿਹ ਜੀਤ ਲਈ ਸਸਿ ਅੰਗ ਕਲੰ ॥
200.t: jeh jeet liee sas a(n)g kala(n) ||
200.e: She conquered all the beauty of the moon.

200.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਾਇ ਸੁਯੰਬ੍ਰ ਕਰਿਓ ॥
200.t: jab hee sudh pai suya(n)br kario ||
200.e: When she grew of age, in the ancient ceremony of Swayamvara,

200.g: ਅਵਧੇਸ ਨਰੇਸਹਿ ਚੀਨ ਬਰਿਓ ॥੧੧॥
200.t: avadhes nareseh cheen bario ||11||
200.e: She selected and married Dasrath, the king of Oudh. ||11||
